defects.desc: 2026 年第一季度 Rightship 检查数据统计分析报告 Statistical analysis report of Rightship inspection defect data in the firstquarter-2026 第一部分: 第一季度 Rightship 检查缺陷数据统计 Part I：Statistics of Rightship inspection defect data in the first quarter. 1 描述：压载水处理系统（BWTS）单元安装在机舱 3 甲板右舷侧，该位置所在的空间是一个独立的封 闭舱室，四周有边界并设有两扇门。但这个舱室并未在封闭空间登记表中被认定为封闭空间。 Description: The ballast water treatment system (BWTS)unit was installed at engine room 3rd deck starboard side, in which space was an independent enclosed compartment surrounding with boundaries and two doors. This compartment was not identified as an enclosed space in the enclosed space register. 根本原因：压载水处理系统（BWTS）的安装空间以前是机舱备件室，但在该空间安装压载水处理系统 （BWTS）后，门仍然留在那里，这会导致有毒气体积聚的风险。 Root Cause: The ballast water treatment system(BWTS) installing space is E/R spare parts room before, but after installing ballast water treatment system(BWTS) in the space ，the door is still remained there, which cause toxic gas accumulation risk. 产生的风险：船员未采取密闭舱室的进入程序进入，极易发生缺氧、中毒、窒息死亡事故。 Risk existed: If crew members enter enclosed compartments without following the entry procedures, they are highly prone to accidents such as oxygen deficiency, poisoning, suffocation, and even death. 关闭要求: 拆卸并移除该空间的门。 Closing Requirements: Dismantle and remove the door for the space. 预防措施:保持空间处于开放状态，以便空气能够流通。 Preventive Measure: Keep space under door removed condition, so the air can circulate for the space. 2 描述：舵机舱的化学品柜中存放着两罐用于重型污水处理系统清洁剂的化学品（产品名称：GAMAZYME 700），但没有关于此类化学品处理的材料安全数据表（MSDS）。 Description: There were two cans of chemical for heavy duty sewage system cleaner (product name: GAMAZYME 700) stowed in chemical locker at the steering gear compartment, the MSDS for handling such chemical was not available . 根本原因：重型污水处理系统清洁剂的化学品已于近日收到。但材料安全数据表（MSDS）副本未能及 时提供。 Root Cause: The chemical for heavy duty sewage system cleaner was received recently. The MSDS copy was not be supply in time. 产生的风险：船员无法及时获取该化学品的安全注意事项与应急消除措施。 Risk existed: The crew could not promptly obtain the safety precautions and emergency elimination measures for this chemical. 关闭要求: 打印该化学品的材料安全数据表，并将其放在货架附近。 Closing Requirements: Print the MSDS of the chemical and keep it near the store shelf. 预防措施:船员应通过培训提高化学品安全意识。收到新化学品后，立即更新化学品安全技术说明书 （MSDS）。 Preventive Measure: The crew should enhance the safety awareness of chemical by training. After receiving new chemical, update the MSDS immediately. 3 描述： 右舷的舷梯没有搭到码头上，而是用钢索悬挂着，并且在舷梯的下部平台上安装了一个短跳板。 Description: Starboard side accommodation ladder was not landed on the wharf, it was rigging by wire falls, and a short brow was fitted to the lower platform of accommodation ladder. 根本原因：由于岸边起重机的导轨限制，码头上右舷侧舷梯的停靠空间有限。 Root Cause: There are limited space for landing starboard side accommodation ladder On the wharf due to the guide rail of the shore crane. 产生的风险：极易造成上下人员踏空、滑倒、坠落入海。 Risk existed: May cause personnel to slip, trip and fall overboard. 关闭要求: 我们对在舷梯下层平台安装跳板进行了风险评估。 Closing Requirements: We made the risk assessment for fitting the short brow on the lower plat form of the accommodation ladder. 预防措施:为了人员在攀爬舷梯时的安全，我们需要将舷梯架设到码头上。 Preventive Measure: We need land the accommodation ladder to the wharf for personnel’s safety when climbing on the accommodation ladder. 4 描述：自 2023 年 10 月 23 日船舶被接管以来，船舶在海上航行时无人机舱（UMS）模式的启动和停 止时间未记录在轮机日志中。机舱一直以无人机舱（UMS）模式运行。 Description: The start and stop times of UMS mode when ship was at sea passage were not recorded in the engine log book since the vessel was taken over on 23/Oct/2023. Engine room was being operated in UMS mode. 根本原因：船员不熟悉最新的要求。 Root Cause: Crew is not familiar with the newest request. 产生的风险：无法追溯机舱运行状态，不符合法规及体系记录要求。 Risk existed: It is impossible to trace the operating status of the engine room, which does not meet the regulatory and system record requirements. 关闭要求: 每天在轮机日志中记录 UMS 的启动和停止时间。 Closing Requirements: - Record the UMS start and stop time in the engine/official log book everyday . 预防措施:开展了关于记录 UMS 内容的培训流程 Preventive Measure: Training procedure about recording content of UMS carried out 5 描述：从机舱二层甲板通往舵机室的逃生门与周围白色的舱壁一样被漆成了白色，在机舱充满烟雾的情 况下，该逃生门无法清晰辨认。 Description: The escape door leading from engine room 2nd deck to steering gear compartment were painted with white colour against the surrounding white bulkhead, not clearly indicated in the event of the engine room being filled with smoke. 根本原因：船员的安全意识薄弱。 Root Cause: Crew ‘s safety awareness is weak. 产生的风险：烟雾环境下无法快速识别逃生门，延误逃生。 Risk existed: In a smoky environment, it is impossible to quickly identify the emergency exit, which delays escape. 关闭要求: 在安全出口门框周围粘贴清晰标识。 Closing Requirements: Paste clearly indicated mark surrounding the escape door’s door case. 预防措施:通过培训提高船员的安全意识，让船员了解紧急情况下逃生门标识的重要性。 Preventive Measure: Enhance the crew’s safety awareness by training, make crew to understand the importance of the escape door’s mark for emergency situationusing . 6 描述：2026 年 2 月 2 日签发了检查艏尖舱的进入封闭处所检查表和许可证和 2026 年 3 月 6 日签发了主 机扫气箱的进入封闭处所检查表和许可证。然而，无证据表明压载泵及其相关液压系统、主机相关管路 系统和电气系统已通过锁闭挂牌程序实现隔离。 Description: Enclosed space permits were issued on 2/Feb/2026 for FPT inspection and on 6/Mar/2026 for M/E scavenge air box inspection. However, there was no evidence that the ballast pumps and associated hydraulic systems, and M/E related pipeline and electrical systems had been isolated using Lock-out/Tag-out (LOTO) procedures. 根本原因： 1.船员在封闭空间作业时未严格遵守上锁挂牌（LOTO）程序。 2.作业许可证及上锁挂牌执行过程的监管不足。 3.船员缺乏针对关键系统的上锁挂牌应用培训。 Root Cause: 1. Crew failed to strictly follow LOTO procedures for enclosed space operations. 2. Insufficient supervision of work permit and LOTO execution. 3. Lack of LOTO application training for crew on critical systems. 产生的风险：人员在检查和保养过程中造成工伤事故。 Risk existed: Work-related injuries occurred to personnel during the inspection and maintenance process. 关闭要求: 1.遵循上锁挂牌（LOTO）检查清单。 2.加强监督管理。 3.在每日班前会上重点强调。 Closing Requirements: 1. Follow the LOTO (Lock-out/Tag-out)checklist. 2.Strengthen supervision. 3. Emphasized at toolbox meeting every day. 预防措施: 对全体船员加强上锁挂牌（LOTO）培训。 Preventive Measure: Strengthen training for all crew members about LOTO (Lock-out/Tag-out). 7 描述：无证据表明，船舶的《国际海运固体散货规则》/《固体散货安全操作规则》船岸安全检查表中， 包含涉及应急程序的装卸工人熟悉环节，也无证据表明每班次至少对货舱进入程序的合规性进行过一次 核实。 Description: There was no evidence that the ship's IMSBC/BLU code ship/shore safety checklist include a stevedore familiarisation section with emergency procedures and verify compliance with cargo hold entry procedures at least once every watch. 根本原因：船岸安全程序的相关要求落实不到位。 Root Cause: Insufficient implementation of the requirements for ship-shore safety procedures. 产生的风险：应急处置能力不足，易引发伤亡事故；流程失控，扩大事故影响范围。 Risk existed: Insufficient emergency response capabilities are likely to cause casualties; loss of process control will expand the scope of accident impacts. 关闭要求: 1.立即修订检查清单，增加码头工人熟悉应急程序的章节。 2.所有值班班次每小时核查货舱进入程序。 3.与码头工人开展联合安全简报会，并讲解应急程序。 Closing Requirements: 1. Revise the checklist immediately, add stevedore familiarization section with emergency procedures. 2. Verify cargo hold entry procedures hourly for all watch shifts. 3. Conduct joint safety briefing with stevedores and emergency procedures. 预防措施: 1.审查并更新所有与《国际海运固体散装货物规则》（IMSBC）/《散装液体货物手册》（BLU）相关的 检查清单。 2.召开装货前船岸联合安全会议，审查检查清单的合规情况及码头工人培训状况。 3.培训并监督值班船员，使其在港口货物作业期间按要求正确执行船岸安全程序。 Preventive Measure: 1. Review and update all IMSBC/BLU related checklists. 2.Hold a pre-loading joint ship-shore safety meeting to review checklist compliance and stevedore training status. 3.Train and supervise the duty crew to properly carry out ship-shore safety procedure as required during cargo operations in port. 8 描述：船舶中桅房内的电焊机的回路线被固定在船体结构上。 Description: The welding machines' return lines in the mid-ship store was observed to be secured to the ship's structure. 根本原因：船员不熟悉焊机回路线的正确要求与操作。 Root Cause: Crew are unfamiliar with the correct requirements and operation of welding machine return lines. 产生的风险：线路因船舶摇晃、振动而松动，易造成短路、漏电或线路磨损引发火灾等风险。 Risk existed: Loosening of wires caused by the ship's rolling and vibration is likely to lead to risks such as short circuits, electric leakage, or fires triggered by wire abrasion. 关闭要求: 1.对负责焊接作业的船员开展现场操作培训。 2.增设回路电缆，确保焊接作业时回路线靠近焊接现场，并缩短回路电流距离。 Closing Requirements: 1. Conduct on-site operational training for crew responsible for welding work. 2. Add loop cables to ensure the return line is near the welding site during welding operations and shorten the loop current distance. 预防措施: 1.加强监督管理。 2.组织相关船员开展焊接设备的使用与操作培训。 Preventive Measure: 1.Strengthen supervision. 2. Organize training for related crew on the use and operation of welding equipment. 9 描述：船舶配备了呼吸装置空气再充注系统。然而，船上可再充注的自给式正压呼吸器及紧急逃生呼吸 装置气瓶的工作压力分别为 300 巴和 200 巴，但呼吸装置压缩机上安装的安全泄压阀，其工作压力为 350 巴。 Description: The vessel equipped with a breathing apparatus air recharging system. Ship's rechargeable SCBA and EEBD bottles working pressure are 300 bar and 200 bar, however, the safety relief valve fitted on BA compressor working pressure is 350 bar. 根本原因： 1.呼吸器（BA）压缩机安全泄压阀在安装 / 维修期间设定压力校准错误。 2.未对所有呼吸器系统组件进行定期压力校验。 Root Cause: 1. Incorrect calibration of BA compressor safety relief valve set pressure during installation/maintenance. 2. No regular pressure verification of all BA system components. 产生的风险：压缩机泄压阀（350 巴）压力高于 SCBA（300 巴）、EEBD（200 巴）气瓶额定值，易 因操作失误致气瓶超压损坏或爆裂；误充 EEBD 会损其组件，还可能掩盖系统故障，影响应急使用。 Risk existed: The BA compressor's relief valve (350 bar) has higher pressure than SCBA (300 bar) and EEBD (200 bar) cylinders. It may cause cylinder overpressure damage/burst due to misoperation, damage EEBD components if misfilled, and hide system faults, affecting emergency use. 关闭要求: 申请紧急逃生呼吸装置（EEBD）气瓶充气时的安全泄压阀，订单清单附后。 Closing Requirements: safety relief valve application carried out for EEBD bottle recharging. Order list is attached hereunder. 预防措施: 1.对自给式呼吸器（SCBA）及应急逃生呼吸装置（EEBD）气瓶进行充气时，每次均确保使用合适的安 全泄压阀。 2.对呼吸器充气系统及其附件进行定期检查与维护。 Preventive Measure: 1.When recharge SCBA & EEBD bottles, ensure the appropriate safety relief valve is used each time. 2.Regular inspection and maintenance shall be conducted on breathing apparatus air recharging system and its accessories. 10 描述：正在使用的舷梯，其上部约 4 米长的区域未设置安全网防护。 Description: The upper section of the in using accommodation ladder approximately 4 meters was not covered by safety net. 根本原因： 1.船舶登船设备的安全使用存在违规情况，船员对登船安全要求的认知不足。 2.未及时检查舷梯安全网的覆盖状况。 Root Cause: 1. Non-compliance in the safe use of ship’s embarkation equipment. Insufficient crew awareness of ship boarding safety requirements. 2. No in timely inspection of accommodation ladder safety net coverage. 产生的风险：舷梯上部未设安全网，易导致人员在上下船时因船舶摇晃、脚步不稳而从高处坠落，尤其 在风浪天气下风险显著升高。 Risk existed: The absence of a safety net on the upper section of the accommodation ladder may easily lead to personnel falling from height when boarding or disembarking the ship due to the ship's rolling or unsteady footsteps, with the risk increasing significantly especially in rough weather. 关闭要求: 安装合适的舷梯安全网，从船舷延伸至码头 / 岸壁并牢固固定。确保船舷与舷梯之间的所有 间隙完全封闭。 Closing Requirements: Install a suitable gangway safety net extending from the ship’s side to the dock/quay wall and securely fastened. Ensure all gaps between the ship’s side and the gangway are fully enclosed. 预防措施: 1.对船员进行船舷通行设备使用前、使用中及使用后的相关知识与注意事项培训。 2.确保所有通行设备状态良好，并定期进行检查。 3.确保所有通行设备按照规定安全、正确地使用。 Preventive Measure: 1. Provide training to the crew on the knowledge and precautions before, during, and after the use of shipboard access equipment. 2. Ensure all access equipment is in good condition and inspected regularly. 3. Ensure all access equipment is used safely, correctly and in accordance with regulations. 11 描述：船舶在生活区前部设有高硫油与低硫油共用管路，但管路冲洗量及冲洗程序未纳入操作员综合安 全管理体系或船上文件中，且无相关风险评估；燃油取样程序及受保护储存（情况）尚未确认。 Description: Vessel was provided with common line for HSFO and LSFO forward of the accommodation, but line flushing volume and procedure were not included in operator's integrated SMS or onboard, no RA available for same; bunker sampling procedure and sheltered storage not confirmed (V). 根本原因： 1.安 全管理体系（SMS）/ 加油计划过时，未更新共用管路的相关细节。 2.燃油共用管路的冲洗与取样无标准程序。 3.缺少与加油作业相关的风险评估（RA）文件。 Root Cause: 1. Outdated SMS/bunkering plan, no updated details of common line. 2. No standard procedures for flushing and sampling of common fuel lines. 3. Missing RA documents related to bunkering operations. 1. 产生的风险：共用管路无冲洗要求，易残留重油杂质污染轻油，致设备故障；无风险评估，难预判管路 混用隐患，事故应对无据；取样与储存未确认，燃油质量难把控，且可能因储存不当引发泄漏、火灾。 1. Risk existed: Without pipeline flushing requirements for the common line, residual HFO impurities may contaminate LSFO and cause equipment failure; No RA means pipeline mixing hazards cannot be predicted, leaving no basis for accident response; Unconfirmed bunkering sampling and storage make fuel quality uncontrollable, and improper storage may cause leakage or fire. 关闭要求: 1.制定重油（HFO）加油管路冲洗程序。 2.开展重油加油管路冲洗程序的培训。 Closing Requirements: 1. Formulate HFO bunker line flushing procedure. 2. HFO bunker line flushing procedure training carried out. 预防措施: 加油作业前，对相关船员开展重油（HFO）加油管路冲洗程序培训。 Preventive Measure: HFO bunker line flushing procedure training carried out for related crews before bunkering. 12 描述：在操作测试过程中，燃油速闭阀未能有效关闭。触发（速闭阀）后，燃油供给压力维持在 0.55 兆 帕（MPa）；过滤器排出约 0.5 升燃油后，压力仍未变化。该问题已在检查期间整改完毕。 Description: During the operational test, the fuel-oil quick-closing valve failed to close effectively. Upon actuation, fuel supply pressure maintained 0.55 MPa; after ~0.5 litre oil drained from filter, pressure unchanged. Rectified during inspection. 根本原因：3 号发电机回油阀在测试过程中发生卡滞。 Root Cause: The return valve of NO.3 generator engine stuck during testing. 1. 产生的风险：紧急时无法切断燃油供给，若遇火灾，燃油持续输送会加剧火势；压力未降表明燃油仍泄 漏，可能引发管路喷油、环境污染，甚至爆炸风险。 1. Risk existed: Failure to cut off fuel supply in emergencies: if a fire occurs, continuous fuel delivery will intensify the fire; Unchanged pressure indicates ongoing fuel leakage, which may cause pipeline oil spray, environmental pollution, or even explosion risks. 关闭要求:

defects.inspected_item: 号发电机回油阀已完成解体检修并恢复正常使用。 1.3 号发电机回油阀已完成解体检修并恢复正常使用。 2.轮机部开展测试程序相关培训。 Closing Requirements: 1. The return valve of NO.3 generator engine overhauled and activated. 2. Test procedure training in engine department. 预防措施: 1.相关设备按要求正确、定期开展测试。 2. 活络调试相关阀件，恢复正常使用。 Preventive Measure: 1.The tested correctly and regularly. 2.The related valves activated. 描述：经检查发现，1、3、5、7 及 9 号货舱舱口围内侧围板上边缘（即舱口围顶部平台流水槽内侧板） 存在锈蚀现象。 Description: Cargo hold
defects.desc: .1, 3, 5, 7 & 9 hatches inboard coamings faces up edges (coaming top table water channel inner plates) were found rusted and corroded. 根本原因：主货舱舱口围板的检查与维护工作未按规定妥善开展。 Root Cause: Inspection and maintenance of main hold coamings not properly carried out. 产生的风险：货舱舱口围板及流水槽内侧板锈蚀，会降低结构强度，易导致漏水、渗水，使货物受潮损 坏；锈蚀扩展可能造成钢板穿孔，影响船舶水密性与结构安全，增加航行及装卸作业隐患。 Risk existed: Rusting and corrosion of cargo hold hatch coamings and water channel inner plates reduce structural strength, easily causing water leakage and cargo damage. Corrosion may lead to steel plate perforation, impairing watertight integrity and structural safety, increasing risks during navigation and cargo handling. 关闭要求: 1.立即对所有货舱舱口围板开展全面检查。 2.清洁所有泄水孔与止回阀，确保其畅通无堵塞。 Closing Requirements: 1. Conduct a thorough inspection of all hold coamings immediately. 2. Clean all drain hole and non-return valves to ensure they are clear and unobstructed. 预防措施: 1.制定货舱舱口围板的定期检查计划，检查范围涵盖舱口围顶板排水槽内板、泄水孔、止回阀及结构完 整性。 2.保持舱口围表面清洁，及时除锈并涂刷防腐涂层；将此项工作纳入即将开展的进坞修理清单，实施永 久性修复。 3.确保泄水孔畅通无堵塞，止回阀功能正常。 Preventive Measure: 1.Establish a regular inspection schedule for hold coamings, including top table water channel inner plates, drain holes, non-return valves, and structural integrity. 2. Keep coaming surfaces clean, remove rust and apply anti-corrosive coating in a timely manner. Add this item to incoming DRY DOCKING REPAIR LIST for permanent restoration. 3. Ensure drain holes are clear and non-return valves function properly. 14 描述：船上左舷前部内侧首缆系泊绞车，其刹车上的打滑点指针设置错误，导致指针无法随刹车杆转动 时正确指示打滑点。 Description: The rendering point was incorrectly set at the fixed point of the brake spindle on forward port side inward head line mooring winch onboard, the pointer cannot move against the signs along the brake spindles. 根本原因： 1.制动打滑点指示器指针被错误地直接固定于制动主轴上。 2.未对绞车制动打滑点的设定值进行定期校验。 Root Cause: 1. The rendering pointer was incorrectly wrongly fixed directly to the brake spindle. 2. No regular verification of winch brake rendering point settings. 产生的风险：无法准确判断刹车松紧程度，易导致系泊张力失控、缆绳受力不均，引发断缆或设备损坏 风险。 Risk existed: Making it impossible to judge brake tightness accurately. This may cause uncontrolled mooring tension, uneven rope stress, and risks of rope breakage, or equipment damage. 关闭要求: 已按要求完成制动力的重新校准，并根据测试结果对制动打滑点指示器指针进行了规范的重 新制作与安装。 Closing Requirements: A recalibration of the brake force was carried out as the requires, and the rendering pointer was properly re‑fabricated and fitted in accordance with the test results. 预防措施: 1.开展制动力测试及指针正确定位安装相关的现场培训。 2.按规定妥善开展系泊设备的定期检查与维护，确保所有设备状态良好、运行安全。 Preventive Measure: 1. On-site training was conducted regarding brake force testing and the correct positioning of the pointer. 2. Regularly inspection and maintenance of mooring equipment shall be properly carried out to ensure all equipment is maintained in good condition and safe for operation. 15. 描述：船尾系泊站的内侧与外侧系泊绞车制动滚筒工作表面，整个宽度均出现锈蚀。 Description: The brake drum running surfaces of the inboard and outboard mooring winches at the aft mooring stations were found to be corroded across their entire width. 根本原因：系泊绞车的检查与维护工作未按规定及时、全面、彻底地开展。 Root Cause: The inspection and maintenance of the mooring winch were not performed in a timely, comprehensive and thorough manner. 产生的风险：刹车滚筒工作面全面锈蚀，会降低刹车摩擦力，易导致制动失效、缆绳打滑、张力失控， 引发断缆、走船等安全事故。 Risk existed: Full-width corrosion on the running surfaces of brake drums reduces friction, which may lead to brake failure, rope slipping, uncontrolled tension, and cause accidents such as rope breakage and vessel drifting. 关闭要求: 1.对船尾系泊站锈蚀的制动鼓工作面开展除锈及表面处理。 2.检查刹车片、销轴与连杆机构，对磨损 / 损坏的部件及时予以更换。 3.维护作业完成后，对船尾系泊绞车的全功能运行状态进行校验。 Closing Requirements: 1. Conduct de-rusting and surface treatment for rusted brake drum running surfaces at aft mooring station. 2. Inspect brake linings, pins and linkages, replace worn/damaged ones in a timely manner. 3. Verify full functional operation of aft mooring winches after maintenance. 预防措施: 1.对系泊设备进行定期检查与维护。 2.采取有效措施，防范设备出现腐蚀、磨损及故障。 3.始终确保系泊系统的结构完整性与运行待用状态。 Preventive Measure: 1.The mooring equipment shall be inspected and maintained on a regular basis. 2. Effective measures shall be taken to prevent corrosion, wear, and malfunction. The integrity and operational readiness of mooring systems shall be ensured at all times. 16. 描述：机舱警报打印机工作正常，但仅能手动打印，无法自动打印；2026 年 1 月警报历史记录缺失。 警报监控系统内存最多可存储 34 页，最早警报记录仅追溯至 2026 年 2 月。 Description: Engine room alarm printer in working condition but it was printing manually rather than automatically, alarm history in January/2026 missing. The alarm monitoring system's memory could store up to 34 pages, with the earliest alarm record dating back to February/2026. 根本原因： 1.报警打印机自动打印功能故障未按规定上报。 2.报警记录与机舱关键记录未建立定期备份机制。 3.轮机部对轮机日志及相关记录的合规性监管不到位。 Root Cause: 1. Malfunction of alarm printer's automatic function not reported. 2. No regular backup system for alarm records and key engine room records. 3. Insufficient supervision of logbook and record compliance in the engine department. 产生的风险：无法自动打印警报，关键历史记录缺失，不利于事故追溯、故障分析及 PSC 检查，影响 机舱安全管理与应急处置。 Risk existed: No automatic alarm printing and missing key history records are not conducive to accident tracing, fault analysis and PSC inspection, affecting engine room safety management and emergency response. 关闭要求: 加强对报警打印机工作状态与模式设置的检查，确保报警触发时，报警打印机同步执行打印。 Closing Requirements: strength check alarm printer working condition and mode setting ,keep alarm printer print synchronously when an alarm activated. 预防措施: 1.确保报警打印机处于正常工作状态。 2.加强值班轮机员交接班环节的监督核查工作。 Preventive Measure: 1. Ensure alarm printer in normal condition. 2. Strengthen duty engineer’s supervision when taken over the watch. 17 描述：机舱围壁内 4 号机舱风机防火挡板在测试时无法完全关闭，与水平位置约有 5° 间隙。 经多次测试，系统气动执行机构的动作状况仍未改善。 该问题已在检查期间整改。 Description: The fire damper for Engine Room No.4 fan located in the engine room casing did not close completely when tested, around 5 degrees gap to the horizontal level. Repeated tests did not improve the performance of the pneumatic actuator used in the system. Rectified during inspection. 根本原因：内部防火网的固定铆钉脱落，导致防火网出现松脱。 Root Cause: due to the detachment of the internal fire proof net's fixed rivets, the fireproof net became loose. 产生的风险：防火挡板关闭不严，火灾时无法有效阻隔烟火蔓延，导致烟火窜入其他舱室，降低船舶防 火分隔效果，扩大事故风险。 Risk existed: Fire damper not fully closed fails to stop spread of fire and smoke effectively, reducing fire compartmentation effect and increasing accident risk. 关闭要求: 内部防火网已采用铆钉固定牢固。 Closing Requirements: Internal fire proof net's fixed with rivets. 预防措施: 加强监督、检查与测试工作。 Preventive Measure: Strengthen supervision, inspection and test. 18 描述：机舱前底舱压载水泵上方的热水管，有约 5 米长的保温层缺失 / 脱落。该问题已在检查期间整 改。 Description: A section of lagging approximately 5 meters on the hot water line located above ballast pumps in engine room bottom deck forward. Rectified during inspection. 根本原因：未按规定对机舱难触及区域的隔热层状态开展定期检查。 Root Cause: No regular inspection of lagging status in hard-to-reach areas of engine room. 产生的风险：热水管保温层缺失，易造成人员烫伤、热量损耗，同时可能产生冷凝水，影响机舱设备安 全与工作环境。 Risk existed: Missing lagging on hot water line may cause scalding, heat loss and condensed water, endangering equipment safety and working environment in engine room. 关闭要求: 确认隔热层的整改（更换）效果，检查热水管路，排查其泄漏 / 破损情况。 Closing Requirements: Confirm the rectification (replacement) effect of lagging, inspect hot water line to identify leakage/damage. 预防措施: 1.将机舱难触及区域隔热层的每周目视检查工作，纳入轮机部日常工作范畴。 2.每季度对机舱所有隔热层开展全面检查，排查是否存在油污浸渍、破损、泄漏情况。 3.船上应配备足量的隔热层备用材料，以便对出现油污浸渍、破损的部件进行即时更换。 Preventive Measure: 1. Incorporate weekly visual inspection of lagging in hard-to-reach areas of engine room into the engine department's daily work. 2.Conduct comprehensive inspection of all engine room lagging quarterly to identify oil impregnation/damage/leakage. 3.Keep sufficient spare lagging materials on board for immediate replacement of oil-impregnated/damaged parts. 19 描述：发现 5 号及 9 号货舱附近的两盏货灯灯罩损坏。 Description: Two cargo lights located near hold No.5 & 9 noted with cover damaged. 根本原因： 1.未按规定对货舱便携式及固定式货舱灯的工作状态开展定期检查。 2.货舱灯灯罩玻璃出现破损，未及时予以维修或更换。 3.甲板部的检查清单中，未针对货舱灯的维护工作设置专项检查项。 Root Cause: 1. No regular inspection of portable/fixed cargo hold light status. 2. Glass damage to cargo hold light covers not repaired/replaced in a timely manner. 3. No special inspection for cargo hold light maintenance in the deck department's inspection checklist. 产生的风险：灯罩破损易导致灯具进水、短路，引发触电或火灾风险，同时影响货舱作业照明，降低装 卸作业安全性。 Risk existed: Damaged lamp covers may cause water ingress and short circuits, leading to electric shock or fire risks. It also reduces cargo hold lighting and endangers handling safety. 关闭要求: 1.立即更换 5 号、9 号货舱的货舱灯。 2.对所有货舱灯开展全面检查，排查灯罩、灯泡及电缆存在的各类缺陷。 Closing Requirements: 1. No.5/9 cargo hold lights were renewed immediately. 2. Fully inspect all cargo hold lights to identify defects in covers, bulbs and cable. 预防措施: 1.制定专项检查清单，并定期开展检查与维护工作。 2.加强值班驾驶员的监督核查工作，对损坏的灯具立即予以更换。 Preventive Measure: 1. Make a checklist and inspection and maintenance regularly. 2. Strengthen duty officer’s supervision and renew the damaged light immediately. 20 描述：机舱车间内弧焊机的回路线用螺栓直接接在船体结构上，未配备工件连接夹的规范布设。 rising Description: Returning cable of ARC welding machine in the engine workshop was used to connected to the ship’s structure by the bolt. The arrangement of work piece connection clamp was not provided. 根本原因：不理解相关规定。 Root Cause: Don’t understand this rule. 产生的风险：线路因船舶摇晃、振动而松动，易造成短路、漏电或线路磨损引发火灾等风险。 Risk existed: Loosening of wires caused by the ship's rolling and vibration is likely to lead to risks such as short circuits, electric leakage, or fires triggered by wire abrasion. 关闭要求:修改回线连接以绕过船体，并安装一个直接连接到工件的夹具。 Closing Requirements: Modify the return wire connection to bypass the hull，and install a clamp that attaches directly to the work piece. 预防措施: 维护此回路连接并使用便携式电焊机。 Preventive Measure: Maintain this return wire connection and use portable welding machine. 21 描述：右舷舷梯锁紧螺母的安全销及锁紧螺栓末端螺纹存在锈蚀。 Description: Safe pin of lock nut and the end thread of locking bolt on the starboard side accommodation ladder found rusty. 根本原因：上个月 PMS 例行检查时，大副已发现问题并安排水手长处理。水手长仅完成了左舷舷梯的 除锈和加油工作，但忘记在右舷进行同样操作。大副在分配工作后未能进行后续复查和验证，导致工作 未能闭环管理。 Root Cause: During routine inspection as PMS last month, CO already found this issue and task to Bosun. Bosun only completed the de-rusting and greasing work on the port side accommodation ladder but forgot to perform the same work on S’Side accommodation ladder. CO failed to conduct a follow-up review and verification after assigning the work. leading to no closed-loop management of the task. 产生的风险：锈蚀会导致销栓失效，引发舷梯坍塌、人员受伤。 Risk existed: Rust may cause failure of lock pin/bolt, leading to accommodation ladder collapse, injury. 关闭要求:立即安排水手长完成除锈工作，并在右舷舷梯的锁紧螺栓螺纹末端涂抹足量润滑脂，同时更 换锁紧螺母的新安全销。 Closing Requirements: Immediately arrange the Bosun to complete de-rusting and apply sufficient grease the end thread of locking bolt and replace new safe pin of lock nut on the S’side accommodation ladder. 预防措施: 1. 建立明确的工作分配与确认制度。 2. 加强工作的闭环管理。 Preventive Measure: 1. Establish a clear work assignment and confirmation system. 2. Strengthen the closed-loop management of work. 22 描述：7 号货舱右舷前部用于调整承重的垫铁脱焊与基座结构分离。 Description: The metal shims which used for adjusting the height of bearing pad, located on the forward starboard side of Cargo Hold No.7, was detached from the base structure. 根本原因：金属垫片在初始安装时焊接强度不足，和/或由于长期振动及舱盖冲击导致的疲劳失效。 Root Cause: The metal shims insufficient welding strength during initial installation and/or fatigue failure caused by long-term vibration and hatch cover impact. 产生的风险：垫片脱落导致承座不稳、设备损坏，存在坍塌隐患。 Risk existed: Detached shims cause bearing pad instability, equipment damage, collapse hazard. 关闭要求: 1. 制作新的金属垫片，确保其尺寸与轴承座及底座结构表面完全吻合。 2. 清洁底座结构表面，将新金属垫片牢固焊接于底座结构。 3. 对焊缝进行无损检测和目视检查，确认垫片连接牢固且满足强度要求；进行水密性测试，确保焊接 不影响密封性能。 Closing Requirements: 1. Fabricate new metal shims and dimensions to ensure it fit the bearing pad and base structure surface thoroughly. 2. Clean the base structure surface, then weld the new metal shims firmly to the base structure. 3. Conduct a non-destructive test and visual inspection of the welded joint to confirm the shims are securely attached and meet strength requirements. Conduct a watertight test to confirm it no affect the sealing requirements. 预防措施: 更新货舱结构检查清单，将承重垫块垫片及其固定状态纳入定期检查项目，确保每个航次都 进行检查。 Preventive Measure: Update the cargo hold structural inspection checklist to include specific checks for the bearing pad shims and their fixation status, ensuring regular inspection during each voyage. 23 描述：在 5 号舱盖右舷前部发现约 10 厘米长的胶条变形。 Description: Deformation sealing rubber approximately 10cm in length was observed on the forward starboard side of hatch cover No.5. 根本原因：在更换 5 号舱盖密封橡胶时，该段约 10 厘米的密封橡胶未被完全压入安装槽，导致安装不 平整并随后变形。安装工作未严格按照标准程序执行，且对密封橡胶安装的最终检查不足，未能及时发 现未完全压入的问题。 Root Cause: During the replacement of the sealing rubber on hatch cover No.5, The approximately 10cm section of the sealing rubber was not fully pressed into the installation groove, resulting in an uneven installation and subsequent deformation of the sealing rubber. The installation work was not carried out in strict accordance with the standard procedure and the final inspection of the sealing rubber installation was insufficient, failing to identify the incomplete pressing issue in a timely manner. 产生的风险：胶条变形会导致货舱进水、造成货损、结构腐蚀等。 Risk existed: Deformation of the rubber seal will result in water ingress into the cargo hold, cargo damage, structural corrosion, etc. 关闭要求: 1. 移除已变形的密封橡胶段，彻底清洁安装槽道，确保无残留物或碎屑。 2. 重新安装密封橡胶，确保橡胶完全嵌入槽道内。 3. 对修复后的密封橡胶进行目视检查及水密性测试，确认其满足密封要求且无变形。 Closing Requirements: 1. Remove the deformed section of the sealing rubber, clean the installation groove thoroughly to ensure no residue or debris remains. 2. Re-install the sealing rubber, ensuring the all rubber fully in the groove. 3. Conduct a visual inspection and a watertight test on the repaired sealing rubber to confirm it meets the sealing requirements and is free of deformation. 预防措施: 1. 规范密封橡胶更换程序：明确密封橡胶需全长压入槽内的要求，并制定分步安装指南供甲板部船员 参考。 2. 加强安装后检查：要求在每次更换后进行 100%的目视检查，确认密封橡胶的平整度和安装完整性， 并将检查结果记录在舱盖维护保养日志中。 Preventive Measure: 1. Standardize the sealing rubber replacement procedure: Clarify the requirement that the entire length of the sealing rubber into the groove, and formulate a step-by-step installation guide for deck crew reference. 2. Strengthen post-installation inspection: require a 100% visual check of the sealing rubber flatness and installation completeness after each replacement. and record the inspection results in the hatch cover maintenance log. 24 描述：艏部右舷系泊站 M1 系泊绞车的刹车片顶紧螺栓，其螺纹与锁紧螺母均已锈蚀。 Description: The jack bolt of breaking brand installed for M1 mooring winch, located at the starboard side of forward mooring station, was corroded on the bolt thread and lock nut. 根本原因： 1. 缺乏对顶推螺栓的定期防腐蚀维护和检查。 2. 顶推螺栓和锁紧螺母材料为碳钢而非不锈钢，在海洋环境中抗腐蚀性能较差。 Root Cause: 1. Lack of regular anti-corrosion maintenance and inspection for the jack bolt. 2. The jack bolt and lock nuts are made of carbon steel not stainless steel, which has poor corrosion resistance in the marine environment. 产生的风险：顶紧螺栓螺纹与锁紧螺母锈蚀可能导致系泊绞车制动失效，引发船舶失控、系泊事故及人 员伤亡，严重危及船舶靠泊安全。 Risk existed: Corrosion of the jack bolt threads and lock nut may result in mooring winch brake malfunction, triggering vessel runaway, mooring incidents, personnel casualties, thereby severely jeopardizing berthing safety. 关闭要求: 1.立即申领 18 套不锈钢螺栓与螺母。 2.拆除已锈蚀的碳钢顶紧螺栓及锁紧螺母，更换为新的不锈钢顶紧螺栓与锁紧螺母，并涂抹润滑脂。 3.依据设备手册要求，调节顶紧螺栓，设定 2 毫米的工作间隙。 Closing Requirements: 1. Immediately raised requisition for 18sets stainless steel bolts & nuts . 2. Removed the corroded carbon steel jack bolt, lock nut. Replaced with new stainless steel jack bolts and lock nuts. Applied grease. 3. Adjusted the jack bolt to set a 2mm working clearance as required by the equipment manual. 预防措施: 1. 为所有系泊绞车刹车装置建立月度检查和维护计划，重点关注顶推螺栓、螺纹和锁紧螺母的锈蚀状 况，并验证 2 毫米的工作间隙，详细记录检查结果。 2. 为刹车装置备足不锈钢材质的顶推螺栓和锁紧螺母备件，以确保在发生锈蚀或损坏时能及时更换。 Preventive Measure: 1. Establish monthly inspection and maintenance schedule for all mooring winch breaking devices, focusing on checking the corrosion condition of jack bolts, threads and lock nuts, as well as verifying the 2mm working clearance, and recording the inspection results in detail. 2. Prepare sufficient spare parts of stainless steel jack bolts and lock nuts for the breaking devices to ensure timely replacement in case of corrosion or damage. 25 描述：应急消防泵未配备防护装置。 Description: The protection guard was not provided on the emergency fire pump. 根本原因：防护罩在上次检查时被拆下，忘记重新安装，被遗落在角落并已生锈。 Root Cause: The protective cover was removed during last inspection and forget to reinstall，it was left in a corner and has rusted. 产生的风险：未设防护装置易引发意外触碰、设备损坏，不符合安全规范，危及消防作业安全。 Risk existed: Lack of protection guard may cause accidental contact, equipment damage, or failure to meet safety regulations, and endangering fire-fighting safety. 关闭要求:用镀锌板制作新的保护罩并安装。 Closing Requirements: Make a new protect cover using galvanized sheet metal and install it. 预防措施: 张贴通知，提醒所有人每次检查和测试后需重新安装防护罩。 Preventive Measure: Put up a notice to remind everyone to refit the guard after every inspection and testing. 26 描述：舵机室内的钢板垂直存放且未有效固定。 Description: Steel plate in the steering gear room stored in vertical position without properly secured. 根本原因：忽视了链条和花篮螺丝的松动，未能及时将其紧固。 Root Cause: Overlook the loosening of the chains and turnbuckles，and failed to tighten them in time. 产生的风险：钢板未有效固定易倾倒，造成人员受伤、设备损坏。 Risk existed: Without properly secured the steel plates may topple over, causing personnel injuries, equipment damage. 关闭要求: 使用角钢，并用大型螺栓固定。 Closing Requirements: Using angle steel secured with large bolt. 预防措施: 加强例行检查，并确保物品使用后螺栓立即被紧固。 Preventive Measure: Strengthen routine inspection and ensure bolts are tightened immediately after use. 27 描述：电瓶间水密胶条槽的右上角外缘发现锈蚀，且缺失约 3 厘米。 Description: Outer edge of Battery room Door sealing rubber channel found corroded on the top right corner with approximately 3cm missing. 根本原因：对蓄电池室风雨密门密封橡胶槽的例行检查不够仔细，导致未能及时发现右上角早期的腐蚀 状况。 Root Cause: During routine inspection of the battery room weather door sealing rubber channel was not conducted carefully, resulting in the failure to detect early corrosion at the top right corner in a timely manner. 产生的风险：胶条槽锈蚀缺失导致水密失效，引发进水、有害气体积聚、火灾爆炸风险。 Risk existed: Corrosion and loss of the rubber channel cause loss of watertight integrity, leading to water ingress, gas accumulation, fire explosion risks. 关闭要求: 1. 将右上角锈蚀缺损的密封橡胶槽道切除，制作新分段并焊接就位。 2. 更换密封橡胶，并进行光照检漏测试，确保其水密性。 Closing Requirements: 1. Cut out the corroded and missing section of the sealing rubber channel at the top right corner, Fabricated a new section and welding. 2. Renew the sealing rubber, and preformed a light leakage test to ensure water tightness. 预防措施: 1.对所有风雨密门进行更加仔细和详细的例行检查，以及时发现腐蚀或损坏的早期迹象。 2.加强船员培训，强调细致检查和及时整改缺陷的重要性，以保持蓄电池室等关键处所的安全和完整性。 Preventive Measure: 1. Conduct more careful and detailed routine inspections all weather doors, to detect early signs of corrosion or damage in a timely manner. 2. Strengthen crew training to emphasize the importance of meticulous inspection and prompt defect rectification, to maintain the safety and integrity of critical spaces such as the battery room. 28 描述：船舶于 2026 年 1 月 25 日驶离博凯港，核查机舱警报管理系统时，无舵机警报测试的证据及记录。 Description: Vessel departed Port De Boke on 25/Jan/2026, there was no evidence / record of steering gear alarms had been tested when reviewing the Engine Room Alarm Management system. 根本原因：离港前 12 小时以上未按公司系统进行舵机报警试验。 Root Cause: The steering gear alarm test is not performed according to the company system more than 12 hours before Departure. 产生的风险：未进行舵机警报测试可能导致故障无法及时发现，引发操舵失控、航行事故。 Risk existed: Failure to test steering gear alarms may result in undetected malfunctions, loss of steering control, navigational accidents. 关闭要求: 根据公司体系要求，已于 2026 年 3 月 22 日烟台港离港前完成舵机警报测试。 Closing Requirements: Steering gear alarm tested before departure YANTAI PORT 22/MAR/2026 according to the company system. 预防措施: 对办公室与工程师加强关于船舶开航前 12 小时内 SHIP-05-04-07 检查表与舵机操作测试的培 训。 Preventive Measure: Strengthen the offices and engineers training about SHIP-05-04-07 Checklist & Test for Steering Gear Operation Within 12 Hours Before Departure. 29 描述：无证据表明气体检测仪在每次使用前进行功能测试。 Description: There was no evidence/ record of bump test had been carried out prior each usage. 根本原因：安全意识不够。 Root Cause: Safe awareness was not enough. 产生的风险：未对气体检测仪执行每次使用前功能测试，无法确认仪器传感器及报警功能有效，易导致 有毒、可燃气体泄漏无法及时预警，引发中毒、爆炸及人员伤亡等安全事故。 Risk existed: No functional test conducted on gas detectors before each use fails to verify the effectiveness of sensors and alarms, which may result in failure to detect toxic or flammable gas leaks timely, causing poisoning, explosion and casualties. 关闭要求: 全体船员进行撞击测试相关要求与程序的培训。 Closing Requirements: All crew training the requirement and procedure of bump test. 预防措施: 1. 加强关于碰撞试验相关要求和操作的安全意识培训。 2. 建立碰撞试验记录。 Preventive Measure: 1.Strength Safe awareness training about relevant requirement and operation of bump test. 2.Establish the record of bump test. 30 描述：船舶中桅房内的电焊机的回路线被固定在船体结构上。 Description: The return line of the welding machine located in the midship store was observed permanently connected to the ship structure 根本原因：缺乏焊机的安全使用意识。 Root Cause: Lack of awareness of the safe use of welding machine. 产生的风险：线路因船舶摇晃、振动而松动，易造成短路、漏电或线路磨损引发火灾等风险。 Risk existed: Loosening of wires caused by the ship's rolling and vibration is likely to lead to risks such as short circuits, electric leakage, or fires triggered by wire abrasion. 关闭要求: 已更换焊机回路线，并在船中部物料间安装接地夹具。 Closing Requirements: Renewed the return line & installed earth clamp of the welding machine at the midship store. 预防措施: 1. 加强机舱船员关于安全使用焊机的培训。 2. 向船队发送提醒，并要求符合< COSWP >。 Preventive Measure: 1.Strengthen ER crews training about the safe use of welding machine. 2.Forward reminder to fleet ship, and require compliance with the < COSWP > 31 描述：已认可的安全设备记录未及时更新，未能体现引航员软梯的材质、制造商以及其制造与测试所依 据的标准。 Description: The Record of Approved Safety Equipment was not updated to reflect the material, manufacturer, and the standard to which the pilot ladder was made and tested. 根本原因：更换新的引水梯后，船级社没有及时收到这一信息。 Root Cause: The information was not promptly notified to the classification society after the new pilot ladder was replaced. 产生的风险：记录未更新无法核实引航梯符合安全标准，易造成结构失效、人员坠落受伤，严重危及引 航员及船员安全。 Risk existed: Outdated records fail to verify pilot ladder compliance with safety standards, leading to potential structural failure, fall accidents, injuries , seriously endangering pilot and crew safety. 关闭要求: 我们已和验船师沟通确认，在下次年检时进行更新。 Closing Requirements: We have already communicated with the surveyor and will make the update during the next annual survey. 预防措施: 今后如遇安全设备更新方面的类似情况，我们将及时通知船级社更新并记录安全证书。 Preventive Measure: In the future, if there are any similar situations regarding the update of safety equipment, we will promptly notify the classification society to update and record the safety certificate. 32 描述： 1.船长及大副未接受过与本船实际型号相符的舱盖检查与维护专项培训，仅由公司管理人员开展过通用 培训。 2.公司安全管理体系（SMS）中未制定程序，以确保舱盖部件间隙测量每六个月定期进行。 Description: 1. The Master and Chief Officer had not undergone a hatch cover inspection and maintenance training course pertinent to the type installed on the vessel being inspected, the generic training were conducted by the Manager. 2. There was no procedure to ensure that the clearance measurements of hatch cover components are carried out regularly every six months in Managers SMS. 根本原因： 1. 由于原始制造商已破产且不再生产舱盖设备，仅开展了舱盖通用性培训。 2. 舱盖测量项目已纳入维护计划，但缺少制造商要求的间隙测试程序。 Root Cause: 1.Only general training on the hatch cover was conducted because the original manufacturer has gone bankrupt and no longer produces hatch cover equipment. 2.The hatch cover measurement has already been included in the maintenance plan, but clearance test required by the manufacturer is lack. 产生的风险：缺乏针对性舱盖培训易导致检查维护不当，引发进水货损；未规定半年间隙测量程序，易 产生结构隐患，违反体系要求。 Risk existed: Lack of targeted hatch cover training may lead to improper inspection and maintenance, causing water ingress and cargo damage. Absence of regular clearance measurement procedures results in potential structural issues, non-compliance with SMS requirements. 关闭要求: 1. 结合舱盖说明书，观看视频与 PPT 学习公司专项培训内容。 2. 依据舱盖说明书技术要求，对舱盖间隙等技术参数进行测试，结果正常，并更新了舱盖年度维护计 划。 Closing Requirements: 1. Watch the video and PPT to learn the special training content company with the hatch cover manual. 2. According to the technical requirements of the hatch cover manual, the technical parameters such as the hatch cover clearance were tested and found to be normal, and the annual maintenance plan for the hatch cover was updated. 预防措施: 1. 根据第 9A.2 章要求，针对舱盖开展专项培训，并为船长和大副更新安全管理体系培训。 2. 安全管理体系已完成修订，现要求所有船舶依据制造商提供的技术规格进行维护保养，包括接触面 间隙等项目。 Preventive Measure: 1.Conduct specialized training on hatch cover and updated SMS training for the master and chief mate in accordance with the requirements of chapter 9A.2 2. The SMS has been updated, and it requires all ships to undergo maintenance in accordance with the technical specifications provided by the manufacturers, including the clearance of contact surfaces, etc. 33 描述：2 号、3 号货舱共计 5 个快速锁紧楔子，分别加装了 3 个和 4 个金属垫片。 Description: Five quick-acting cleats on cargo hatch No.2 and No.3 were fitted with 3 metal washers and 4 metal washers respectively. 根本原因：对快速压紧器的相关规范要求缺乏认知和理解。 Root Cause: Lack of the awareness and knowledge of the requirements of quick-acting cleats. 产生的风险：锁紧楔子加装过多金属垫片易导致受力不均、舱盖锁闭不牢，引发进水货损，不符合安全 要求。 Risk existed: Excessive metal washers fitted on quick-acting cleats may cause uneven stress, insecure hatch cover locking, water ingress, cargo damage and non-compliance with safety requirements. 关闭要求: 拆除快速压紧器上多余的金属垫片。 Closing Requirements: Dismantle the more metal washers of the quick-acting cleats. 预防措施: 1. 依据《舱盖维护手册》要求，加强对快速压紧器规范的培训。 2. 完成全船快速压紧器检查，确保其安装与维护符合标准。 Preventive Measure: 1.Enhanced training on the requirements of quick-acting cleats according to the《Hatch Cover Maintenance》. 2.Inspected all quick-acting cleats onboard to ensure proper install and maintenance. 34 描述：船上安装的是不可分隔式绞车，但在进行绞车打滑点测试计算时，仅按第一层系缆绳进行核算， 未考虑系泊作业中实际常用的缆绳层数。 Description: The undivided winches were fitted on board, however, the first layer of mooring lines was used for the winch rendering test according to the formula adopted for the calculation, and the normal layer in use for most mooring operations was not considered for the calculation. 根本原因：对系泊绞车制动力测试理解不足。 Root Cause: Inadequate understanding of Mooring Winch Brake Rendering Power Test. 产生的风险： 绞车试验仅按第一层缆绳计算，未考虑实际作业层数，易导致超载、绞车故障、缆绳断裂、船舶靠泊失 控，严重危及系泊安全。 Risk existed: Using only the first layer of mooring lines for winch rendering test calculation without considering actual working layers may lead to overloading, winch failure, broken mooring lines, uncontrolled berthing, seriously threatening mooring safety. 关闭要求: 修改绞车松缆测试参数，并重新测试系泊绞车刹车松出性能。 Closing Requirements: Modify the parameters of winch rendering test and retest Mooring Winch Brake Rendering. 预防措施: 1. 加强甲板部与轮机部关于系泊绞车刹车释放测试的培训。 2. 安全管理体系（SMS）中的绞车刹车释放测试记录表已更新，测试将基于绞缆筒上的实际工作缆层 进行。 Preventive Measure: 1.Strengthen the offices and engineers training about the Mooring Winch Brake Rendering test. 2.The Winch Brake Rendering test form have been updated in SMS，the test want to base on the layers on mooring drum. 35 描述：机舱车间内的立式钻床未安装急停装置，车床也未配备防护挡板。 Description: The standing drill was not fitted with an emergency stop installation, also lathe machine was not provided with protective guards in the engine room The areas covered are as follows: 项目 item 缺陷 占比 体系相关 SMS 14 39% 燃油管理 fuel management 2 6% 舱盖和起重设备 hatch cover & lifting equipment 5 14% 系泊设备相关的 mooring equipment 4 11% 机舱相关 engineer room 10 28% 船壳和上层建筑 hull & superstructure 1 3% 第三部分：改进措施 Part III – Improvement Measures 根据上述分析，下述改进措施供大家参考 Based on the above analysis, the following improvement measures are provided for your reference:： 1. 强化体系文件专项培训，重点落实 SHIP-02-05 封闭处所进入安全规定、SHIP-02-21 锁闭挂牌 （LOTO）规定、SHIP-02-08 货舱作业安全规定，确保船员熟练掌握并严格执行。 Strengthen special training on SMS documents, focusing on SHIP-02-05 Safety Rules for Enclosed Space Entry, SHIP-02-21 Regulations on Lock-out and Tag-out (LOTO), and SHIP-02-08 Regulations on Operation in Cargo Holds, to ensure crew members master and strictly implement the requirements. 2. 依据 PRO-19 船舶预防性维护保养程序，完善全船设备维保方案并严格落地执行。 Formulate and rigorously implement the vessel’s equipment maintenance plan in accordance with PRO-19 Ship Preventive Maintenance Procedures. 3. 按照 PRO-10 船舶检查与监督程序常态化开展自查，重点核查封闭空间、应急设备、系泊系统、舱 盖结构及机舱关键部件；坚持举一反三，全船队同步排查同类缺陷，一次性闭环整改。 Conduct regular self-inspections in line with PRO-10 Ship Inspection & Supervision Procedure, with priority checks on enclosed spaces, emergency equipment, mooring systems, hatch cover structures, and key engine room components. Apply lessons learned to similar issues, carry out fleet-wide simultaneous checks, and complete rectification in one closed-loop cycle. 4. 严格执行工作闭环管理，规范任务分配、执行、复查与验证流程，杜绝漏项、未验证等问题。 Strictly enforce closed-loop work management, standardize the processes of task assignment, execution, review, and verification, and eliminate omissions and unvalidated operations.
