defects.desc: 2026 年第一季度 Rightship 检查数据统计分析报告 Statistical analysis report of Rightship inspection defect data in the firstquarter-2026 第一部分: 第一季度 Rightship 检查缺陷数据统计 Part I：Statistics of Rightship inspection defect data in the first quarter. 1 描述：压载水处理系统（BWTS）单元安装在机舱 3 甲板右舷侧，该位置所在的空间是一个独立的封 闭舱室，四周有边界并设有两扇门。但这个舱室并未在封闭空间登记表中被认定为封闭空间。 Description: The ballast water treatment system (BWTS)unit was installed at engine room 3rd deck starboard side, in which space was an independent enclosed compartment surrounding with boundaries and two doors. This compartment was not identified as an enclosed space in the enclosed space register. 根本原因：压载水处理系统（BWTS）的安装空间以前是机舱备件室，但在该空间安装压载水处理系统 （BWTS）后，门仍然留在那里，这会导致有毒气体积聚的风险。 Root Cause: The ballast water treatment system(BWTS) installing space is E/R spare parts room before, but after installing ballast water treatment system(BWTS) in the space ，the door is still remained there, which cause toxic gas accumulation risk. 产生的风险：船员未采取密闭舱室的进入程序进入，极易发生缺氧、中毒、窒息死亡事故。 Risk existed: If crew members enter enclosed compartments without following the entry procedures, they are highly prone to accidents such as oxygen deficiency, poisoning, suffocation, and even death. 关闭要求: 拆卸并移除该空间的门。 Closing Requirements: Dismantle and remove the door for the space. 预防措施:保持空间处于开放状态，以便空气能够流通。 Preventive Measure: Keep space under door removed condition, so the air can circulate for the space. 2 描述：舵机舱的化学品柜中存放着两罐用于重型污水处理系统清洁剂的化学品（产品名称：GAMAZYME 700），但没有关于此类化学品处理的材料安全数据表（MSDS）。 Description: There were two cans of chemical for heavy duty sewage system cleaner (product name: GAMAZYME 700) stowed in chemical locker at the steering gear compartment, the MSDS for handling such chemical was not available . 根本原因：重型污水处理系统清洁剂的化学品已于近日收到。但材料安全数据表（MSDS）副本未能及 时提供。 Root Cause: The chemical for heavy duty sewage system cleaner was received recently. The MSDS copy was not be supply in time. 产生的风险：船员无法及时获取该化学品的安全注意事项与应急消除措施。 Risk existed: The crew could not promptly obtain the safety precautions and emergency elimination measures for this chemical. 关闭要求: 打印该化学品的材料安全数据表，并将其放在货架附近。 Closing Requirements: Print the MSDS of the chemical and keep it near the store shelf. 预防措施:船员应通过培训提高化学品安全意识。收到新化学品后，立即更新化学品安全技术说明书 （MSDS）。 Preventive Measure: The crew should enhance the safety awareness of chemical by training. After receiving new chemical, update the MSDS immediately. 3 描述： 右舷的舷梯没有搭到码头上，而是用钢索悬挂着，并且在舷梯的下部平台上安装了一个短跳板。 Description: Starboard side accommodation ladder was not landed on the wharf, it was rigging by wire falls, and a short brow was fitted to the lower platform of accommodation ladder. 根本原因：由于岸边起重机的导轨限制，码头上右舷侧舷梯的停靠空间有限。 Root Cause: There are limited space for landing starboard side accommodation ladder On the wharf due to the guide rail of the shore crane. 产生的风险：极易造成上下人员踏空、滑倒、坠落入海。 Risk existed: May cause personnel to slip, trip and fall overboard. 关闭要求: 我们对在舷梯下层平台安装跳板进行了风险评估。 Closing Requirements: We made the risk assessment for fitting the short brow on the lower plat form of the accommodation ladder. 预防措施:为了人员在攀爬舷梯时的安全，我们需要将舷梯架设到码头上。 Preventive Measure: We need land the accommodation ladder to the wharf for personnel’s safety when climbing on the accommodation ladder. 4 描述：自 2023 年 10 月 23 日船舶被接管以来，船舶在海上航行时无人机舱（UMS）模式的启动和停 止时间未记录在轮机日志中。机舱一直以无人机舱（UMS）模式运行。 Description: The start and stop times of UMS mode when ship was at sea passage were not recorded in the engine log book since the vessel was taken over on 23/Oct/2023. Engine room was being operated in UMS mode. 根本原因：船员不熟悉最新的要求。 Root Cause: Crew is not familiar with the newest request. 产生的风险：无法追溯机舱运行状态，不符合法规及体系记录要求。 Risk existed: It is impossible to trace the operating status of the engine room, which does not meet the regulatory and system record requirements. 关闭要求: 每天在轮机日志中记录 UMS 的启动和停止时间。 Closing Requirements: - Record the UMS start and stop time in the engine/official log book everyday . 预防措施:开展了关于记录 UMS 内容的培训流程 Preventive Measure: Training procedure about recording content of UMS carried out 5 描述：从机舱二层甲板通往舵机室的逃生门与周围白色的舱壁一样被漆成了白色，在机舱充满烟雾的情 况下，该逃生门无法清晰辨认。 Description: The escape door leading from engine room 2nd deck to steering gear compartment were painted with white colour against the surrounding white bulkhead, not clearly indicated in the event of the engine room being filled with smoke. 根本原因：船员的安全意识薄弱。 Root Cause: Crew ‘s safety awareness is weak. 产生的风险：烟雾环境下无法快速识别逃生门，延误逃生。 Risk existed: In a smoky environment, it is impossible to quickly identify the emergency exit, which delays escape. 关闭要求: 在安全出口门框周围粘贴清晰标识。 Closing Requirements: Paste clearly indicated mark surrounding the escape door’s door case. 预防措施:通过培训提高船员的安全意识，让船员了解紧急情况下逃生门标识的重要性。 Preventive Measure: Enhance the crew’s safety awareness by training, make crew to understand the importance of the escape door’s mark for emergency situationusing . 6 描述：2026 年 2 月 2 日签发了检查艏尖舱的进入封闭处所检查表和许可证和 2026 年 3 月 6 日签发了主 机扫气箱的进入封闭处所检查表和许可证。然而，无证据表明压载泵及其相关液压系统、主机相关管路 系统和电气系统已通过锁闭挂牌程序实现隔离。 Description: Enclosed space permits were issued on 2/Feb/2026 for FPT inspection and on 6/Mar/2026 for M/E scavenge air box inspection. However, there was no evidence that the ballast pumps and associated hydraulic systems, and M/E related pipeline and electrical systems had been isolated using Lock-out/Tag-out (LOTO) procedures. 根本原因： 1.船员在封闭空间作业时未严格遵守上锁挂牌（LOTO）程序。 2.作业许可证及上锁挂牌执行过程的监管不足。 3.船员缺乏针对关键系统的上锁挂牌应用培训。 Root Cause: 1. Crew failed to strictly follow LOTO procedures for enclosed space operations. 2. Insufficient supervision of work permit and LOTO execution. 3. Lack of LOTO application training for crew on critical systems. 产生的风险：人员在检查和保养过程中造成工伤事故。 Risk existed: Work-related injuries occurred to personnel during the inspection and maintenance process. 关闭要求: 1.遵循上锁挂牌（LOTO）检查清单。 2.加强监督管理。 3.在每日班前会上重点强调。 Closing Requirements: 1. Follow the LOTO (Lock-out/Tag-out)checklist. 2.Strengthen supervision. 3. Emphasized at toolbox meeting every day. 预防措施: 对全体船员加强上锁挂牌（LOTO）培训。 Preventive Measure: Strengthen training for all crew members about LOTO (Lock-out/Tag-out). 7 描述：无证据表明，船舶的《国际海运固体散货规则》/《固体散货安全操作规则》船岸安全检查表中， 包含涉及应急程序的装卸工人熟悉环节，也无证据表明每班次至少对货舱进入程序的合规性进行过一次 核实。 Description: There was no evidence that the ship's IMSBC/BLU code ship/shore safety checklist include a stevedore familiarisation section with emergency procedures and verify compliance with cargo hold entry procedures at least once every watch. 根本原因：船岸安全程序的相关要求落实不到位。 Root Cause: Insufficient implementation of the requirements for ship-shore safety procedures. 产生的风险：应急处置能力不足，易引发伤亡事故；流程失控，扩大事故影响范围。 Risk existed: Insufficient emergency response capabilities are likely to cause casualties; loss of process control will expand the scope of accident impacts. 关闭要求: 1.立即修订检查清单，增加码头工人熟悉应急程序的章节。 2.所有值班班次每小时核查货舱进入程序。 3.与码头工人开展联合安全简报会，并讲解应急程序。 Closing Requirements: 1. Revise the checklist immediately, add stevedore familiarization section with emergency procedures. 2. Verify cargo hold entry procedures hourly for all watch shifts. 3. Conduct joint safety briefing with stevedores and emergency procedures. 预防措施: 1.审查并更新所有与《国际海运固体散装货物规则》（IMSBC）/《散装液体货物手册》（BLU）相关的 检查清单。 2.召开装货前船岸联合安全会议，审查检查清单的合规情况及码头工人培训状况。 3.培训并监督值班船员，使其在港口货物作业期间按要求正确执行船岸安全程序。 Preventive Measure: 1. Review and update all IMSBC/BLU related checklists. 2.Hold a pre-loading joint ship-shore safety meeting to review checklist compliance and stevedore training status. 3.Train and supervise the duty crew to properly carry out ship-shore safety procedure as required during cargo operations in port. 8 描述：船舶中桅房内的电焊机的回路线被固定在船体结构上。 Description: The welding machines' return lines in the mid-ship store was observed to be secured to the ship's structure. 根本原因：船员不熟悉焊机回路线的正确要求与操作。 Root Cause: Crew are unfamiliar with the correct requirements and operation of welding machine return lines. 产生的风险：线路因船舶摇晃、振动而松动，易造成短路、漏电或线路磨损引发火灾等风险。 Risk existed: Loosening of wires caused by the ship's rolling and vibration is likely to lead to risks such as short circuits, electric leakage, or fires triggered by wire abrasion. 关闭要求: 1.对负责焊接作业的船员开展现场操作培训。 2.增设回路电缆，确保焊接作业时回路线靠近焊接现场，并缩短回路电流距离。 Closing Requirements: 1. Conduct on-site operational training for crew responsible for welding work. 2. Add loop cables to ensure the return line is near the welding site during welding operations and shorten the loop current distance. 预防措施: 1.加强监督管理。 2.组织相关船员开展焊接设备的使用与操作培训。 Preventive Measure: 1.Strengthen supervision. 2. Organize training for related crew on the use and operation of welding equipment. 9 描述：船舶配备了呼吸装置空气再充注系统。然而，船上可再充注的自给式正压呼吸器及紧急逃生呼吸 装置气瓶的工作压力分别为 300 巴和 200 巴，但呼吸装置压缩机上安装的安全泄压阀，其工作压力为 350 巴。 Description: The vessel equipped with a breathing apparatus air recharging system. Ship's rechargeable SCBA and EEBD bottles working pressure are 300 bar and 200 bar, however, the safety relief valve fitted on BA compressor working pressure is 350 bar. 根本原因： 1.呼吸器（BA）压缩机安全泄压阀在安装 / 维修期间设定压力校准错误。 2.未对所有呼吸器系统组件进行定期压力校验。 Root Cause: 1. Incorrect calibration of BA compressor safety relief valve set pressure during installation/maintenance. 2. No regular pressure verification of all BA system components. 产生的风险：压缩机泄压阀（350 巴）压力高于 SCBA（300 巴）、EEBD（200 巴）气瓶额定值，易 因操作失误致气瓶超压损坏或爆裂；误充 EEBD 会损其组件，还可能掩盖系统故障，影响应急使用。 Risk existed: The BA compressor's relief valve (350 bar) has higher pressure than SCBA (300 bar) and EEBD (200 bar) cylinders. It may cause cylinder overpressure damage/burst due to misoperation, damage EEBD components if misfilled, and hide system faults, affecting emergency use. 关闭要求: 申请紧急逃生呼吸装置（EEBD）气瓶充气时的安全泄压阀，订单清单附后。 Closing Requirements: safety relief valve application carried out for EEBD bottle recharging. Order list is attached hereunder. 预防措施: 1.对自给式呼吸器（SCBA）及应急逃生呼吸装置（EEBD）气瓶进行充气时，每次均确保使用合适的安 全泄压阀。 2.对呼吸器充气系统及其附件进行定期检查与维护。 Preventive Measure: 1.When recharge SCBA & EEBD bottles, ensure the appropriate safety relief valve is used each time. 2.Regular inspection and maintenance shall be conducted on breathing apparatus air recharging system and its accessories. 10 描述：正在使用的舷梯，其上部约 4 米长的区域未设置安全网防护。 Description: The upper section of the in using accommodation ladder approximately 4 meters was not covered by safety net. 根本原因： 1.船舶登船设备的安全使用存在违规情况，船员对登船安全要求的认知不足。 2.未及时检查舷梯安全网的覆盖状况。 Root Cause: 1. Non-compliance in the safe use of ship’s embarkation equipment. Insufficient crew awareness of ship boarding safety requirements. 2. No in timely inspection of accommodation ladder safety net coverage. 产生的风险：舷梯上部未设安全网，易导致人员在上下船时因船舶摇晃、脚步不稳而从高处坠落，尤其 在风浪天气下风险显著升高。 Risk existed: The absence of a safety net on the upper section of the accommodation ladder may easily lead to personnel falling from height when boarding or disembarking the ship due to the ship's rolling or unsteady footsteps, with the risk increasing significantly especially in rough weather. 关闭要求: 安装合适的舷梯安全网，从船舷延伸至码头 / 岸壁并牢固固定。确保船舷与舷梯之间的所有 间隙完全封闭。 Closing Requirements: Install a suitable gangway safety net extending from the ship’s side to the dock/quay wall and securely fastened. Ensure all gaps between the ship’s side and the gangway are fully enclosed. 预防措施: 1.对船员进行船舷通行设备使用前、使用中及使用后的相关知识与注意事项培训。 2.确保所有通行设备状态良好，并定期进行检查。 3.确保所有通行设备按照规定安全、正确地使用。 Preventive Measure: 1. Provide training to the crew on the knowledge and precautions before, during, and after the use of shipboard access equipment. 2. Ensure all access equipment is in good condition and inspected regularly. 3. Ensure all access equipment is used safely, correctly and in accordance with regulations. 11 描述：船舶在生活区前部设有高硫油与低硫油共用管路，但管路冲洗量及冲洗程序未纳入操作员综合安 全管理体系或船上文件中，且无相关风险评估；燃油取样程序及受保护储存（情况）尚未确认。 Description: Vessel was provided with common line for HSFO and LSFO forward of the accommodation, but line flushing volume and procedure were not included in operator's integrated SMS or onboard, no RA available for same; bunker sampling procedure and sheltered storage not confirmed (V). 根本原因： 1.安 全管理体系（SMS）/ 加油计划过时，未更新共用管路的相关细节。 2.燃油共用管路的冲洗与取样无标准程序。 3.缺少与加油作业相关的风险评估（RA）文件。 Root Cause: 1. Outdated SMS/bunkering plan, no updated details of common line. 2. No standard procedures for flushing and sampling of common fuel lines. 3. Missing RA documents related to bunkering operations. 1. 产生的风险：共用管路无冲洗要求，易残留重油杂质污染轻油，致设备故障；无风险评估，难预判管路 混用隐患，事故应对无据；取样与储存未确认，燃油质量难把控，且可能因储存不当引发泄漏、火灾。 1. Risk existed: Without pipeline flushing requirements for the common line, residual HFO impurities may contaminate LSFO and cause equipment failure; No RA means pipeline mixing hazards cannot be predicted, leaving no basis for accident response; Unconfirmed bunkering sampling and storage make fuel quality uncontrollable, and improper storage may cause leakage or fire. 关闭要求: 1.制定重油（HFO）加油管路冲洗程序。 2.开展重油加油管路冲洗程序的培训。 Closing Requirements: 1. Formulate HFO bunker line flushing procedure. 2. HFO bunker line flushing procedure training carried out. 预防措施: 加油作业前，对相关船员开展重油（HFO）加油管路冲洗程序培训。 Preventive Measure: HFO bunker line flushing procedure training carried out for related crews before bunkering. 12 描述：在操作测试过程中，燃油速闭阀未能有效关闭。触发（速闭阀）后，燃油供给压力维持在 0.55 兆 帕（MPa）；过滤器排出约 0.5 升燃油后，压力仍未变化。该问题已在检查期间整改完毕。 Description: During the operational test, the fuel-oil quick-closing valve failed to close effectively. Upon actuation, fuel supply pressure maintained 0.55 MPa; after ~0.5 litre oil drained from filter, pressure unchanged. Rectified during inspection. 根本原因：3 号发电机回油阀在测试过程中发生卡滞。 Root Cause: The return valve of NO.3 generator engine stuck during testing. 1. 产生的风险：紧急时无法切断燃油供给，若遇火灾，燃油持续输送会加剧火势；压力未降表明燃油仍泄 漏，可能引发管路喷油、环境污染，甚至爆炸风险。 1. Risk existed: Failure to cut off fuel supply in emergencies: if a fire occurs, continuous fuel delivery will intensify the fire; Unchanged pressure indicates ongoing fuel leakage, which may cause pipeline oil spray, environmental pollution, or even explosion risks. 关闭要求:

defects.inspected_item: 号发电机回油阀已完成解体检修并恢复正常使用。 1.3 号发电机回油阀已完成解体检修并恢复正常使用。 2.轮机部开展测试程序相关培训。 Closing Requirements: 1. The return valve of NO.3 generator engine overhauled and activated. 2. Test procedure training in engine department. 预防措施: 1.相关设备按要求正确、定期开展测试。 2. 活络调试相关阀件，恢复正常使用。 Preventive Measure: 1.The tested correctly and regularly. 2.The related valves activated. 描述：经检查发现，1、3、5、7 及 9 号货舱舱口围内侧围板上边缘（即舱口围顶部平台流水槽内侧板） 存在锈蚀现象。 Description: Cargo hold
defects.desc: .1, 3, 5, 7 & 9 hatches inboard coamings faces up edges (coaming top table water channel inner plates) were found rusted and corroded. 根本原因：主货舱舱口围板的检查与维护工作未按规定妥善开展。 Root Cause: Inspection and maintenance of main hold coamings not properly carried out. 产生的风险：货舱舱口围板及流水槽内侧板锈蚀，会降低结构强度，易导致漏水、渗水，使货物受潮损 坏；锈蚀扩展可能造成钢板穿孔，影响船舶水密性与结构安全，增加航行及装卸作业隐患。 Risk existed: Rusting and corrosion of cargo hold hatch coamings and water channel inner plates reduce structural strength, easily causing water leakage and cargo damage. Corrosion may lead to steel plate perforation, impairing watertight integrity and structural safety, increasing risks during navigation and cargo handling. 关闭要求: 1.立即对所有货舱舱口围板开展全面检查。 2.清洁所有泄水孔与止回阀，确保其畅通无堵塞。 Closing Requirements: 1. Conduct a thorough inspection of all hold coamings immediately. 2. Clean all drain hole and non-return valves to ensure they are clear and unobstructed. 预防措施: 1.制定货舱舱口围板的定期检查计划，检查范围涵盖舱口围顶板排水槽内板、泄水孔、止回阀及结构完 整性。 2.保持舱口围表面清洁，及时除锈并涂刷防腐涂层；将此项工作纳入即将开展的进坞修理清单，实施永 久性修复。 3.确保泄水孔畅通无堵塞，止回阀功能正常。 Preventive Measure: 1.Establish a regular inspection schedule for hold coamings, including top table water channel inner plates, drain holes, non-return valves, and structural integrity. 2. Keep coaming surfaces clean, remove rust and apply anti-corrosive coating in a timely manner. Add this item to incoming DRY DOCKING REPAIR LIST for permanent restoration. 3. Ensure drain holes are clear and non-return valves function properly. 14 描述：船上左舷前部内侧首缆系泊绞车，其刹车上的打滑点指针设置错误，导致指针无法随刹车杆转动 时正确指示打滑点。 Description: The rendering point was incorrectly set at the fixed point of the brake spindle on forward port side inward head line mooring winch onboard, the pointer cannot move against the signs along the brake spindles. 根本原因： 1.制动打滑点指示器指针被错误地直接固定于制动主轴上。 2.未对绞车制动打滑点的设定值进行定期校验。 Root Cause: 1. The rendering pointer was incorrectly wrongly fixed directly to the brake spindle. 2. No regular verification of winch brake rendering point settings. 产生的风险：无法准确判断刹车松紧程度，易导致系泊张力失控、缆绳受力不均，引发断缆或设备损坏 风险。 Risk existed: Making it impossible to judge brake tightness accurately. This may cause uncontrolled mooring tension, uneven rope stress, and risks of rope breakage, or equipment damage. 关闭要求: 已按要求完成制动力的重新校准，并根据测试结果对制动打滑点指示器指针进行了规范的重 新制作与安装。 Closing Requirements: A recalibration of the brake force was carried out as the requires, and the rendering pointer was properly re‑fabricated and fitted in accordance with the test results. 预防措施: 1.开展制动力测试及指针正确定位安装相关的现场培训。 2.按规定妥善开展系泊设备的定期检查与维护，确保所有设备状态良好、运行安全。 Preventive Measure: 1. On-site training was conducted regarding brake force testing and the correct positioning of the pointer. 2. Regularly inspection and maintenance of mooring equipment shall be properly carried out to ensure all equipment is maintained in good condition and safe for operation. 15. 描述：船尾系泊站的内侧与外侧系泊绞车制动滚筒工作表面，整个宽度均出现锈蚀。 Description: The brake drum running surfaces of the inboard and outboard mooring winches at the aft mooring stations were found to be corroded across their entire width. 根本原因：系泊绞车的检查与维护工作未按规定及时、全面、彻底地开展。 Root Cause: The inspection and maintenance of the mooring winch were not performed in a timely, comprehensive and thorough manner. 产生的风险：刹车滚筒工作面全面锈蚀，会降低刹车摩擦力，易导致制动失效、缆绳打滑、张力失控， 引发断缆、走船等安全事故。 Risk existed: Full-width corrosion on the running surfaces of brake drums reduces friction, which may lead to brake failure, rope slipping, uncontrolled tension, and cause accidents such as rope breakage and vessel drifting. 关闭要求: 1.对船尾系泊站锈蚀的制动鼓工作面开展除锈及表面处理。 2.检查刹车片、销轴与连杆机构，对磨损 / 损坏的部件及时予以更换。 3.维护作业完成后，对船尾系泊绞车的全功能运行状态进行校验。 Closing Requirements: 1. Conduct de-rusting and surface treatment for rusted brake drum running surfaces at aft mooring station. 2. Inspect brake linings, pins and linkages, replace worn/damaged ones in a timely manner. 3. Verify full functional operation of aft mooring winches after maintenance. 预防措施: 1.对系泊设备进行定期检查与维护。 2.采取有效措施，防范设备出现腐蚀、磨损及故障。 3.始终确保系泊系统的结构完整性与运行待用状态。 Preventive Measure: 1.The mooring equipment shall be inspected and maintained on a regular basis. 2. Effective measures shall be taken to prevent corrosion, wear, and malfunction. The integrity and operational readiness of mooring systems shall be ensured at all times. 16. 描述：机舱警报打印机工作正常，但仅能手动打印，无法自动打印；2026 年 1 月警报历史记录缺失。 警报监控系统内存最多可存储 34 页，最早警报记录仅追溯至 2026 年 2 月。 Description: Engine room alarm printer in working condition but it was printing manually rather than automatically, alarm history in January/2026 missing. The alarm monitoring system's memory could store up to 34 pages, with the earliest alarm record dating back to February/2026. 根本原因： 1.报警打印机自动打印功能故障未按规定上报。 2.报警记录与机舱关键记录未建立定期备份机制。 3.轮机部对轮机日志及相关记录的合规性监管不到位。 Root Cause: 1. Malfunction of alarm printer's automatic function not reported. 2. No regular backup system for alarm records and key engine room records. 3. Insufficient supervision of logbook and record compliance in the engine department. 产生的风险：无法自动打印警报，关键历史记录缺失，不利于事故追溯、故障分析及 PSC 检查，影响 机舱安全管理与应急处置。 Risk existed: No automatic alarm printing and missing key history records are not conducive to accident tracing, fault analysis and PSC inspection, affecting engine room safety management and emergency response. 关闭要求: 加强对报警打印机工作状态与模式设置的检查，确保报警触发时，报警打印机同步执行打印。 Closing Requirements: strength check alarm printer working condition and mode setting ,keep alarm printer print synchronously when an alarm activated. 预防措施: 1.确保报警打印机处于正常工作状态。 2.加强值班轮机员交接班环节的监督核查工作。 Preventive Measure: 1. Ensure alarm printer in normal condition. 2. Strengthen duty engineer’s supervision when taken over the watch. 17 描述：机舱围壁内 4 号机舱风机防火挡板在测试时无法完全关闭，与水平位置约有 5° 间隙。 经多次测试，系统气动执行机构的动作状况仍未改善。 该问题已在检查期间整改。 Description: The fire damper for Engine Room No.4 fan located in the engine room casing did not close completely when tested, around 5 degrees gap to the horizontal level. Repeated tests did not improve the performance of the pneumatic actuator used in the system. Rectified during inspection. 根本原因：内部防火网的固定铆钉脱落，导致防火网出现松脱。 Root Cause: due to the detachment of the internal fire proof net's fixed rivets, the fireproof net became loose. 产生的风险：防火挡板关闭不严，火灾时无法有效阻隔烟火蔓延，导致烟火窜入其他舱室，降低船舶防 火分隔效果，扩大事故风险。 Risk existed: Fire damper not fully closed fails to stop spread of fire and smoke effectively, reducing fire compartmentation effect and increasing accident risk. 关闭要求: 内部防火网已采用铆钉固定牢固。 Closing Requirements: Internal fire proof net's fixed with rivets. 预防措施: 加强监督、检查与测试工作。 Preventive Measure: Strengthen supervision, inspection and test. 18 描述：机舱前底舱压载水泵上方的热水管，有约 5 米长的保温层缺失 / 脱落。该问题已在检查期间整 改。 Description: A section of lagging approximately 5 meters on the hot water line located above ballast pumps in engine room bottom deck forward. Rectified during inspection. 根本原因：未按规定对机舱难触及区域的隔热层状态开展定期检查。 Root Cause: No regular inspection of lagging status in hard-to-reach areas of engine room. 产生的风险：热水管保温层缺失，易造成人员烫伤、热量损耗，同时可能产生冷凝水，影响机舱设备安 全与工作环境。 Risk existed: Missing lagging on hot water line may cause scalding, heat loss and condensed water, endangering equipment safety and working environment in engine room. 关闭要求: 确认隔热层的整改（更换）效果，检查热水管路，排查其泄漏 / 破损情况。 Closing Requirements: Confirm the rectification (replacement) effect of lagging, inspect hot water line to identify leakage/damage. 预防措施: 1.将机舱难触及区域隔热层的每周目视检查工作，纳入轮机部日常工作范畴。 2.每季度对机舱所有隔热层开展全面检查，排查是否存在油污浸渍、破损、泄漏情况。 3.船上应配备足量的隔热层备用材料，以便对出现油污浸渍、破损的部件进行即时更换。 Preventive Measure: 1. Incorporate weekly visual inspection of lagging in hard-to-reach areas of engine room into the engine department's daily work. 2.Conduct comprehensive inspection of all engine room lagging quarterly to identify oil impregnation/damage/leakage. 3.Keep sufficient spare lagging materials on board for immediate replacement of oil-impregnated/damaged parts. 19 描述：发现 5 号及 9 号货舱附近的两盏货灯灯罩损坏。 Description: Two cargo lights located near hold No.5 & 9 noted with cover damaged. 根本原因： 1.未按规定对货舱便携式及固定式货舱灯的工作状态开展定期检查。 2.货舱灯灯罩玻璃出现破损，未及时予以维修或更换。 3.甲板部的检查清单中，未针对货舱灯的维护工作设置专项检查项。 Root Cause: 1. No regular inspection of portable/fixed cargo hold light status. 2. Glass damage to cargo hold light covers not repaired/replaced in a timely manner. 3. No special inspection for cargo hold light maintenance in the deck department's inspection checklist. 产生的风险：灯罩破损易导致灯具进水、短路，引发触电或火灾风险，同时影响货舱作业照明，降低装 卸作业安全性。 Risk existed: Damaged lamp covers may cause water ingress and short circuits, leading to electric shock or fire risks. It also reduces cargo hold lighting and endangers handling safety. 关闭要求: 1.立即更换 5 号、9 号货舱的货舱灯。 2.对所有货舱灯开展全面检查，排查灯罩、灯泡及电缆存在的各类缺陷。 Closing Requirements: 1. No.5/9 cargo hold lights were renewed immediately. 2. Fully inspect all cargo hold lights to identify defects in covers, bulbs and cable. 预防措施: 1.制定专项检查清单，并定期开展检查与维护工作。 2.加强值班驾驶员的监督核查工作，对损坏的灯具立即予以更换。 Preventive Measure: 1. Make a checklist and inspection and maintenance regularly. 2. Strengthen duty officer’s supervision and renew the damaged light immediately. 20 描述：机舱车间内弧焊机的回路线用螺栓直接接在船体结构上，未配备工件连接夹的规范布设。 rising Description: Returning cable of ARC welding machine in the engine workshop was used to connected to the ship’s structure by the bolt. The arrangement of work piece connection clamp was not provided. 根本原因：不理解相关规定。 Root Cause: Don’t understand this rule. 产生的风险：线路因船舶摇晃、振动而松动，易造成短路、漏电或线路磨损引发火灾等风险。 Risk existed: Loosening of wires caused by the ship's rolling and vibration is likely to lead to risks such as short circuits, electric leakage, or fires triggered by wire abrasion. 关闭要求:修改回线连接以绕过船体，并安装一个直接连接到工件的夹具。 Closing Requirements: Modify the return wire connection to bypass the hull，and install a clamp that attaches directly to the work piece. 预防措施: 维护此回路连接并使用便携式电焊机。 Preventive Measure: Maintain this return wire connection and use portable welding machine. 21 描述：右舷舷梯锁紧螺母的安全销及锁紧螺栓末端螺纹存在锈蚀。 Description: Safe pin of lock nut and the end thread of locking bolt on the starboard side accommodation ladder found rusty. 根本原因：上个月 PMS 例行检查时，大副已发现问题并安排水手长处理。水手长仅完成了左舷舷梯的 除锈和加油工作，但忘记在右舷进行同样操作。大副在分配工作后未能进行后续复查和验证，导致工作 未能闭环管理。 Root Cause: During routine inspection as PMS last month, CO already found this issue and task to Bosun. Bosun only completed the de-rusting and greasing work on the port side accommodation ladder but forgot to perform the same work on S’Side accommodation ladder. CO failed to conduct a follow-up review and verification after assigning the work. leading to no closed-loop management of the task. 产生的风险：锈蚀会导致销栓失效，引发舷梯坍塌、人员受伤。 Risk existed: Rust may cause failure of lock pin/bolt, leading to accommodation ladder collapse, injury. 关闭要求:立即安排水手长完成除锈工作，并在右舷舷梯的锁紧螺栓螺纹末端涂抹足量润滑脂，同时更 换锁紧螺母的新安全销。 Closing Requirements: Immediately arrange the Bosun to complete de-rusting and apply sufficient grease the end thread of locking bolt and replace new safe pin of lock nut on the S’side accommodation ladder. 预防措施: 1. 建立明确的工作分配与确认制度。 2. 加强工作的闭环管理。 Preventive Measure: 1. Establish a clear work assignment and confirmation system. 2. Strengthen the closed-loop management of work. 22 描述：7 号货舱右舷前部用于调整承重的垫铁脱焊与基座结构分离。 Description: The metal shims which used for adjusting the height of bearing pad, located on the forward starboard side of Cargo Hold No.7, was detached from the base structure. 根本原因：金属垫片在初始安装时焊接强度不足，和/或由于长期振动及舱盖冲击导致的疲劳失效。 Root Cause: The metal shims insufficient welding strength during initial installation and/or fatigue failure caused by long-term vibration and hatch cover impact. 产生的风险：垫片脱落导致承座不稳、设备损坏，存在坍塌隐患。 Risk existed: Detached shims cause bearing pad instability, equipment damage, collapse hazard. 关闭要求: 1. 制作新的金属垫片，确保其尺寸与轴承座及底座结构表面完全吻合。 2. 清洁底座结构表面，将新金属垫片牢固焊接于底座结构。 3. 对焊缝进行无损检测和目视检查，确认垫片连接牢固且满足强度要求；进行水密性测试，确保焊接 不影响密封性能。 Closing Requirements: 1. Fabricate new metal shims and dimensions to ensure it fit the bearing pad and base structure surface thoroughly. 2. Clean the base structure surface, then weld the new metal shims firmly to the base structure. 3. Conduct a non-destructive test and visual inspection of the welded joint to confirm the shims are securely attached and meet strength requirements. Conduct a watertight test to confirm it no affect the sealing requirements. 预防措施: 更新货舱结构检查清单，将承重垫块垫片及其固定状态纳入定期检查项目，确保每个航次都 进行检查。 Preventive Measure: Update the cargo hold structural inspection checklist to include specific checks for the bearing pad shims and their fixation status, ensuring regular inspection during each voyage. 23 描述：在 5 号舱盖右舷前部发现约 10 厘米长的胶条变形。 Description: Deformation sealing rubber approximately 10cm in length was observed on the forward starboard side of hatch cover No.5. 根本原因：在更换 5 号舱盖密封橡胶时，该段约 10 厘米的密封橡胶未被完全压入安装槽，导致安装不 平整并随后变形。安装工作未严格按照标准程序执行，且对密封橡胶安装的最终检查不足，未能及时发 现未完全压入的问题。 Root Cause: During the replacement of the sealing rubber on hatch cover No.5, The approximately 10cm section of the sealing rubber was not fully pressed into the installation groove, resulting in an uneven installation and subsequent deformation of the sealing rubber. The installation work was not carried out in strict accordance with the standard procedure and the final inspection of the sealing rubber installation was insufficient, failing to identify the incomplete pressing issue in a timely manner. 产生的风险：胶条变形会导致货舱进水、造成货损、结构腐蚀等。 Risk existed: Deformation of the rubber seal will result in water ingress into the cargo hold, cargo damage, structural corrosion, etc. 关闭要求: 1. 移除已变形的密封橡胶段，彻底清洁安装槽道，确保无残留物或碎屑。 2. 重新安装密封橡胶，确保橡胶完全嵌入槽道内。 3. 对修复后的密封橡胶进行目视检查及水密性测试，确认其满足密封要求且无变形。 Closing Requirements: 1. Remove the deformed section of the sealing rubber, clean the installation groove thoroughly to ensure no residue or debris remains. 2. Re-install the sealing rubber, ensuring the all rubber fully in the groove. 3. Conduct a visual inspection and a watertight test on the repaired sealing rubber to confirm it meets the sealing requirements and is free of deformation. 预防措施: 1. 规范密封橡胶更换程序：明确密封橡胶需全长压入槽内的要求，并制定分步安装指南供甲板部船员 参考。 2. 加强安装后检查：要求在每次更换后进行 100%的目视检查，确认密封橡胶的平整度和安装完整性， 并将检查结果记录在舱盖维护保养日志中。 Preventive Measure: 1. Standardize the sealing rubber replacement procedure: Clarify the requirement that the entire length of the sealing rubber into the groove, and formulate a step-by-step installation guide for deck crew reference. 2. Strengthen post-installation inspection: require a 100% visual check of the sealing rubber flatness and installation completeness after each replacement. and record the inspection results in the hatch cover maintenance log. 24 描述：艏部右舷系泊站 M1 系泊绞车的刹车片顶紧螺栓，其螺纹与锁紧螺母均已锈蚀。 Description: The jack bolt of breaking brand installed for M1 mooring winch, located at the starboard side of forward mooring station, was corroded on the bolt thread and lock nut. 根本原因： 1. 缺乏对顶推螺栓的定期防腐蚀维护和检查。 2. 顶推螺栓和锁紧螺母材料为碳钢而非不锈钢，在海洋环境中抗腐蚀性能较差。 Root Cause: 1. Lack of regular anti-corrosion maintenance and inspection for the jack bolt. 2. The jack bolt and lock nuts are made of carbon steel not stainless steel, which has poor corrosion resistance in the marine environment. 产生的风险：顶紧螺栓螺纹与锁紧螺母锈蚀可能导致系泊绞车制动失效，引发船舶失控、系泊事故及人 员伤亡，严重危及船舶靠泊安全。 Risk existed: Corrosion of the jack bolt threads and lock nut may result in mooring winch brake malfunction, triggering vessel runaway, mooring incidents, personnel casualties, thereby severely jeopardizing berthing safety. 关闭要求: 1.立即申领 18 套不锈钢螺栓与螺母。 2.拆除已锈蚀的碳钢顶紧螺栓及锁紧螺母，更换为新的不锈钢顶紧螺栓与锁紧螺母，并涂抹润滑脂。 3.依据设备手册要求，调节顶紧螺栓，设定 2 毫米的工作间隙。 Closing Requirements: 1. Immediately raised requisition for 18sets stainless steel bolts & nuts . 2. Removed the corroded carbon steel jack bolt, lock nut. Replaced with new stainless steel jack bolts and lock nuts. Applied grease. 3. Adjusted the jack bolt to set a 2mm working clearance as required by the equipment manual. 预防措施: 1. 为所有系泊绞车刹车装置建立月度检查和维护计划，重点关注顶推螺栓、螺纹和锁紧螺母的锈蚀状 况，并验证 2 毫米的工作间隙，详细记录检查结果。 2. 为刹车装置备足不锈钢材质的顶推螺栓和锁紧螺母备件，以确保在发生锈蚀或损坏时能及时更换。 Preventive Measure: 1. Establish monthly inspection and maintenance schedule for all mooring winch breaking devices, focusing on checking the corrosion condition of jack bolts, threads and lock nuts, as well as verifying the 2mm working clearance, and recording the inspection results in detail. 2. Prepare sufficient spare parts of stainless steel jack bolts and lock nuts for the breaking devices to ensure timely replacement in case of corrosion or damage. 25 描述：应急消防泵未配备防护装置。 Description: The protection guard was not provided on the emergency fire pump. 根本原因：防护罩在上次检查时被拆下，忘记重新安装，被遗落在角落并已生锈。 Root Cause: The protective cover was removed during last inspection and forget to reinstall，it was left in a corner and has rusted. 产生的风险：未设防护装置易引发意外触碰、设备损坏，不符合安全规范，危及消防作业安全。 Risk existed: Lack of protection guard may cause accidental contact, equipment damage, or failure to meet safety regulations, and endangering fire-fighting safety. 关闭要求:用镀锌板制作新的保护罩并安装。 Closing Requirements: Make a new protect cover using galvanized sheet metal and install it. 预防措施: 张贴通知，提醒所有人每次检查和测试后需重新安装防护罩。 Preventive Measure: Put up a notice to remind everyone to refit the guard after every inspection and testing. 26 描述：舵机室内的钢板垂直存放且未有效固定。 Description: Steel plate in the steering gear room stored in vertical position without properly secured. 根本原因：忽视了链条和花篮螺丝的松动，未能及时将其紧固。 Root Cause: Overlook the loosening of the chains and turnbuckles，and failed to tighten them in time. 产生的风险：钢板未有效固定易倾倒，造成人员受伤、设备损坏。 Risk existed: Without properly secured the steel plates may topple over, causing personnel injuries, equipment damage. 关闭要求: 使用角钢，并用大型螺栓固定。 Closing Requirements: Using angle steel secured with large bolt. 预防措施: 加强例行检查，并确保物品使用后螺栓立即被紧固。 Preventive Measure: Strengthen routine inspection and ensure bolts are tightened immediately after use. 27 描述：电瓶间水密胶条槽的右上角外缘发现锈蚀，且缺失约 3 厘米。 Description: Outer edge of Battery room Door sealing rubber channel found corroded on the top right corner with approximately 3cm missing. 根本原因：对蓄电池室风雨密门密封橡胶槽的例行检查不够仔细，导致未能及时发现右上角早期的腐蚀 状况。 Root Cause: During routine inspection of the battery room weather door sealing rubber channel was not conducted carefully, resulting in the failure to detect early corrosion at the top right corner in a timely manner. 产生的风险：胶条槽锈蚀缺失导致水密失效，引发进水、有害气体积聚、火灾爆炸风险。 Risk existed: Corrosion and loss of the rubber channel cause loss of watertight integrity, leading to water ingress, gas accumulation, fire explosion risks. 关闭要求: 1. 将右上角锈蚀缺损的密封橡胶槽道切除，制作新分段并焊接就位。 2. 更换密封橡胶，并进行光照检漏测试，确保其水密性。 Closing Requirements: 1. Cut out the corroded and missing section of the sealing rubber channel at the top right corner, Fabricated a new section and welding. 2. Renew the sealing rubber, and preformed a light leakage test to ensure water tightness. 预防措施: 1.对所有风雨密门进行更加仔细和详细的例行检查，以及时发现腐蚀或损坏的早期迹象。 2.加强船员培训，强调细致检查和及时整改缺陷的重要性，以保持蓄电池室等关键处所的安全和完整性。 Preventive Measure: 1. Conduct more careful and detailed routine inspections all weather doors, to detect early signs of corrosion or damage in a timely manner. 2. Strengthen crew training to emphasize the importance of meticulous inspection and prompt defect rectification, to maintain the safety and integrity of critical spaces such as the battery room. 28 描述：船舶于 2026 年 1 月 25 日驶离博凯港，核查机舱警报管理系统时，无舵机警报测试的证据及记录。 Description: Vessel departed Port De Boke on 25/Jan/2026, there was no evidence / record of steering gear alarms had been tested when reviewing the Engine Room Alarm Management system. 根本原因：离港前 12 小时以上未按公司系统进行舵机报警试验。 Root Cause: The steering gear alarm test is not performed according to the company system more than 12 hours before Departure. 产生的风险：未进行舵机警报测试可能导致故障无法及时发现，引发操舵失控、航行事故。 Risk existed: Failure to test steering gear alarms may result in undetected malfunctions, loss of steering control, navigational accidents. 关闭要求: 根据公司体系要求，已于 2026 年 3 月 22 日烟台港离港前完成舵机警报测试。 Closing Requirements: Steering gear alarm tested before departure YANTAI PORT 22/MAR/2026 according to the company system. 预防措施: 对办公室与工程师加强关于船舶开航前 12 小时内 SHIP-05-04-07 检查表与舵机操作测试的培 训。 Preventive Measure: Strengthen the offices and engineers training about SHIP-05-04-07 Checklist & Test for Steering Gear Operation Within 12 Hours Before Departure. 29 描述：无证据表明气体检测仪在每次使用前进行功能测试。 Description: There was no evidence/ record of bump test had been carried out prior each usage. 根本原因：安全意识不够。 Root Cause: Safe awareness was not enough. 产生的风险：未对气体检测仪执行每次使用前功能测试，无法确认仪器传感器及报警功能有效，易导致 有毒、可燃气体泄漏无法及时预警，引发中毒、爆炸及人员伤亡等安全事故。 Risk existed: No functional test conducted on gas detectors before each use fails to verify the effectiveness of sensors and alarms, which may result in failure to detect toxic or flammable gas leaks timely, causing poisoning, explosion and casualties. 关闭要求: 全体船员进行撞击测试相关要求与程序的培训。 Closing Requirements: All crew training the requirement and procedure of bump test. 预防措施: 1. 加强关于碰撞试验相关要求和操作的安全意识培训。 2. 建立碰撞试验记录。 Preventive Measure: 1.Strength Safe awareness training about relevant requirement and operation of bump test. 2.Establish the record of bump test. 30 描述：船舶中桅房内的电焊机的回路线被固定在船体结构上。 Description: The return line of the welding machine located in the midship store was observed permanently connected to the ship structure 根本原因：缺乏焊机的安全使用意识。 Root Cause: Lack of awareness of the safe use of welding machine. 产生的风险：线路因船舶摇晃、振动而松动，易造成短路、漏电或线路磨损引发火灾等风险。 Risk existed: Loosening of wires caused by the ship's rolling and vibration is likely to lead to risks such as short circuits, electric leakage, or fires triggered by wire abrasion. 关闭要求: 已更换焊机回路线，并在船中部物料间安装接地夹具。 Closing Requirements: Renewed the return line & installed earth clamp of the welding machine at the midship store. 预防措施: 1. 加强机舱船员关于安全使用焊机的培训。 2. 向船队发送提醒，并要求符合< COSWP >。 Preventive Measure: 1.Strengthen ER crews training about the safe use of welding machine. 2.Forward reminder to fleet ship, and require compliance with the < COSWP > 31 描述：已认可的安全设备记录未及时更新，未能体现引航员软梯的材质、制造商以及其制造与测试所依 据的标准。 Description: The Record of Approved Safety Equipment was not updated to reflect the material, manufacturer, and the standard to which the pilot ladder was made and tested. 根本原因：更换新的引水梯后，船级社没有及时收到这一信息。 Root Cause: The information was not promptly notified to the classification society after the new pilot ladder was replaced. 产生的风险：记录未更新无法核实引航梯符合安全标准，易造成结构失效、人员坠落受伤，严重危及引 航员及船员安全。 Risk existed: Outdated records fail to verify pilot ladder compliance with safety standards, leading to potential structural failure, fall accidents, injuries , seriously endangering pilot and crew safety. 关闭要求: 我们已和验船师沟通确认，在下次年检时进行更新。 Closing Requirements: We have already communicated with the surveyor and will make the update during the next annual survey. 预防措施: 今后如遇安全设备更新方面的类似情况，我们将及时通知船级社更新并记录安全证书。 Preventive Measure: In the future, if there are any similar situations regarding the update of safety equipment, we will promptly notify the classification society to update and record the safety certificate. 32 描述： 1.船长及大副未接受过与本船实际型号相符的舱盖检查与维护专项培训，仅由公司管理人员开展过通用 培训。 2.公司安全管理体系（SMS）中未制定程序，以确保舱盖部件间隙测量每六个月定期进行。 Description: 1. The Master and Chief Officer had not undergone a hatch cover inspection and maintenance training course pertinent to the type installed on the vessel being inspected, the generic training were conducted by the Manager. 2. There was no procedure to ensure that the clearance measurements of hatch cover components are carried out regularly every six months in Managers SMS. 根本原因： 1. 由于原始制造商已破产且不再生产舱盖设备，仅开展了舱盖通用性培训。 2. 舱盖测量项目已纳入维护计划，但缺少制造商要求的间隙测试程序。 Root Cause: 1.Only general training on the hatch cover was conducted because the original manufacturer has gone bankrupt and no longer produces hatch cover equipment. 2.The hatch cover measurement has already been included in the maintenance plan, but clearance test required by the manufacturer is lack. 产生的风险：缺乏针对性舱盖培训易导致检查维护不当，引发进水货损；未规定半年间隙测量程序，易 产生结构隐患，违反体系要求。 Risk existed: Lack of targeted hatch cover training may lead to improper inspection and maintenance, causing water ingress and cargo damage. Absence of regular clearance measurement procedures results in potential structural issues, non-compliance with SMS requirements. 关闭要求: 1. 结合舱盖说明书，观看视频与 PPT 学习公司专项培训内容。 2. 依据舱盖说明书技术要求，对舱盖间隙等技术参数进行测试，结果正常，并更新了舱盖年度维护计 划。 Closing Requirements: 1. Watch the video and PPT to learn the special training content company with the hatch cover manual. 2. According to the technical requirements of the hatch cover manual, the technical parameters such as the hatch cover clearance were tested and found to be normal, and the annual maintenance plan for the hatch cover was updated. 预防措施: 1. 根据第 9A.2 章要求，针对舱盖开展专项培训，并为船长和大副更新安全管理体系培训。 2. 安全管理体系已完成修订，现要求所有船舶依据制造商提供的技术规格进行维护保养，包括接触面 间隙等项目。 Preventive Measure: 1.Conduct specialized training on hatch cover and updated SMS training for the master and chief mate in accordance with the requirements of chapter 9A.2 2. The SMS has been updated, and it requires all ships to undergo maintenance in accordance with the technical specifications provided by the manufacturers, including the clearance of contact surfaces, etc. 33 描述：2 号、3 号货舱共计 5 个快速锁紧楔子，分别加装了 3 个和 4 个金属垫片。 Description: Five quick-acting cleats on cargo hatch No.2 and No.3 were fitted with 3 metal washers and 4 metal washers respectively. 根本原因：对快速压紧器的相关规范要求缺乏认知和理解。 Root Cause: Lack of the awareness and knowledge of the requirements of quick-acting cleats. 产生的风险：锁紧楔子加装过多金属垫片易导致受力不均、舱盖锁闭不牢，引发进水货损，不符合安全 要求。 Risk existed: Excessive metal washers fitted on quick-acting cleats may cause uneven stress, insecure hatch cover locking, water ingress, cargo damage and non-compliance with safety requirements. 关闭要求: 拆除快速压紧器上多余的金属垫片。 Closing Requirements: Dismantle the more metal washers of the quick-acting cleats. 预防措施: 1. 依据《舱盖维护手册》要求，加强对快速压紧器规范的培训。 2. 完成全船快速压紧器检查，确保其安装与维护符合标准。 Preventive Measure: 1.Enhanced training on the requirements of quick-acting cleats according to the《Hatch Cover Maintenance》. 2.Inspected all quick-acting cleats onboard to ensure proper install and maintenance. 34 描述：船上安装的是不可分隔式绞车，但在进行绞车打滑点测试计算时，仅按第一层系缆绳进行核算， 未考虑系泊作业中实际常用的缆绳层数。 Description: The undivided winches were fitted on board, however, the first layer of mooring lines was used for the winch rendering test according to the formula adopted for the calculation, and the normal layer in use for most mooring operations was not considered for the calculation. 根本原因：对系泊绞车制动力测试理解不足。 Root Cause: Inadequate understanding of Mooring Winch Brake Rendering Power Test. 产生的风险： 绞车试验仅按第一层缆绳计算，未考虑实际作业层数，易导致超载、绞车故障、缆绳断裂、船舶靠泊失 控，严重危及系泊安全。 Risk existed: Using only the first layer of mooring lines for winch rendering test calculation without considering actual working layers may lead to overloading, winch failure, broken mooring lines, uncontrolled berthing, seriously threatening mooring safety. 关闭要求: 修改绞车松缆测试参数，并重新测试系泊绞车刹车松出性能。 Closing Requirements: Modify the parameters of winch rendering test and retest Mooring Winch Brake Rendering. 预防措施: 1. 加强甲板部与轮机部关于系泊绞车刹车释放测试的培训。 2. 安全管理体系（SMS）中的绞车刹车释放测试记录表已更新，测试将基于绞缆筒上的实际工作缆层 进行。 Preventive Measure: 1.Strengthen the offices and engineers training about the Mooring Winch Brake Rendering test. 2.The Winch Brake Rendering test form have been updated in SMS，the test want to base on the layers on mooring drum. 35 描述：机舱车间内的立式钻床未安装急停装置，车床也未配备防护挡板。 Description: The standing drill was not fitted with an emergency stop installation, also lathe machine was not provided with protective guards in the engine room workshop. 根本原因：对车床和立式钻床的安全使用缺乏认知。 Root Cause: Lack of awareness of the safe use of lathes and standing drill. 产生的风险：钻床无急停装置、车床无防护挡板，易引发机械缠绕、挤压伤害，造成严重人身伤亡，不 符合船舶安全规范。 Risk existed: Lack of emergency stop device on the standing drill and protective guards on the lathe may lead to mechanical entanglement, crushing injuries, serious personnel casualties and non-compliance with marine safety regulations. 关闭要求: 已安装机舱车间立式钻床的急停装置及车床防护罩。 Closing Requirements: Installed the emergency stop for standing drill and protective cover for lathe machine of ER workshop. 预防措施: 1. 加强机舱船员关于机床和立钻的安全使用培训。 2. 全船队需检查紧急停止装置，缺失或不符合要求的必须加装。 Preventive Measure: 1.Strengthen ER crews training about the safe use of lathes and standing drill. 2.All the fleet ship want to checked the emergency stop and install if unfit. 36 描述：机舱二层平台的热水井（级联柜）蒸汽回管路上发现存在临时修理。 Description: Temporary repair was observed on the Cascade Tank steam return line on the 2nd platform of the Engine Room. 根本原因：对机舱蒸汽管线的维护缺乏认知。 Root Cause: Lack of awareness of ER steam line maintenance. 产生的风险：蒸汽回管路采用临时修理易造成蒸汽泄漏、烫伤风险，加剧管路腐蚀及系统故障，危及人 员安全，不符合安全标准。 Risk existed: Temporary repair on the steam return line may result in steam leakage, scalding hazards, pipe corrosion, system failure, and non-compliance with safety standards, posing risks to personnel safety. 关闭要求:已更换热水井上方的蒸汽回水管路。 Closing Requirements: Renewed the steam return line above the Cascade tank. 预防措施: 1. 加强机舱蒸汽管路的检查，确保所有蒸汽管路状况良好。 2. 加强轮机部船员关于《机舱管理规则》与《锅炉安全操作规程》的培训。 Preventive Measure: 1.Enhanced inspection of the steam line of ER to ensure all steam line in good condition. 2. Strengthen ER crews training about Engine Room Rules and Boiler Safety Operation Instruction. 第二部分：数据分析 Part II – Data analysis 2026年第一季度有4艘船舶经历了RIGHTSHIP检查，共开具了36条缺陷。所涉及的方面如下： Four vessels underwent RIGHTSHIP inspections in the first quarter of 2026 and a total of 36 deficiencies were issued. The areas covered are as follows: 项目 item 缺陷 占比 体系相关 SMS 14 39% 燃油管理 fuel management 2 6% 舱盖和起重设备 hatch cover & lifting equipment 5 14% 系泊设备相关的 mooring equipment 4 11% 机舱相关 engineer room 10 28% 船壳和上层建筑 hull & superstructure 1 3% 第三部分：改进措施 Part III – Improvement Measures 根据上述分析，下述改进措施供大家参考 Based on the above analysis, the following improvement measures are provided for your reference:： 1. 强化体系文件专项培训，重点落实 SHIP-02-05 封闭处所进入安全规定、SHIP-02-21 锁闭挂牌 （LOTO）规定、SHIP-02-08 货舱作业安全规定，确保船员熟练掌握并严格执行。 Strengthen special training on SMS documents, focusing on SHIP-02-05 Safety Rules for Enclosed Space Entry, SHIP-02-21 Regulations on Lock-out and Tag-out (LOTO), and SHIP-02-08 Regulations on Operation in Cargo Holds, to ensure crew members master and strictly implement the requirements. 2. 依据 PRO-19 船舶预防性维护保养程序，完善全船设备维保方案并严格落地执行。 Formulate and rigorously implement the vessel’s equipment maintenance plan in accordance with PRO-19 Ship Preventive Maintenance Procedures. 3. 按照 PRO-10 船舶检查与监督程序常态化开展自查，重点核查封闭空间、应急设备、系泊系统、舱 盖结构及机舱关键部件；坚持举一反三，全船队同步排查同类缺陷，一次性闭环整改。 Conduct regular self-inspections in line with PRO-10 Ship Inspection & Supervision Procedure, with priority checks on enclosed spaces, emergency equipment, mooring systems, hatch cover structures, and key engine room components. 3.气瓶碰撞可能造成气瓶损坏报废，同时可能损坏周边其它设备。 Risk existed: 1.If the gas cylinder falls over or collides, the cylinder valve may break, causing impact injured and frostbite to personnel. 2.Oxygen cylinders located adjacent to the engine room or living quarters pose a serious threat to the structural safety of the ship and the lives of the crew in case of a fire. 3.Collison of gas cylinder may cause the cylinders to be damaged and scrapped, and may also damage other surrounding equipment. 关闭要求: 1.现制作了新的夹具，并对气瓶重新进行固定，以确保符合安全规范要求。 2.加强全体船员对安全管理体系的培训与学习。 Closing Requirements: 1.A new clamp was fabricated on-site and the gas cylinder has been re-secured to ensure safety compliance. 2.Strengthen the training and learning of the Safety Management System for all crew members. 预防措施： 1.将气瓶固定装置检查增加至月度检查清单中。 2.组织船员进行气瓶安全及安全管理体系中的要求的培训。 3.由机务主管在登船检查时进行验证。 Preventive Action: 1.Added gas cylinder securing check to monthly inspection checklist. 2.Conducted crew training on gas cylinder safety and SMS requirements. 3.Superintendent to verify during visit. 2 描述： 用于船岸通行的舷梯未能延伸至岸上地面。为填补舷梯和码头之间的空隙，在舷梯的下 平台加装一个短跳板，但是该跳板梯在岸端的滚轮缺失。跳板梯整体已按放安全网，并 完成相关的风险评估。 Description: The accommodation ladder used for access between vessel and shore did not reach a soild surface ashore. To close the gap between the vessel accommodation ladder and the wharf, a short gangway was attached to the lower platform of ladder, whereas the rollers at the landing end at the short ladder were missing. A safety net was rigged for the entire setup, and a relevant risk assessment for the vessel-side arrangement was in place. 根本原因分析： 1.港口规定禁止舷梯直接放放置在码头上。 2.使用临时跳板梯时，使用之前没有进行检查，未能发现梯子下平台滚轮缺失。 3.当舷梯无法放至码头时，缺乏验证临时登船设施安全性的程序。 Root Cause Analysis: 1.Port regulations prohibited the accommodation ladder from resting directly on the dock. 2.A temporary gangway was used to bridge the gap, but a pre-use inspection failed to identify missing rollers on the temporary platform. 3.Noformal procedure existed for verifying the safety of temporary boarding arrangements when the ladder cannot reach the dock. 产生的风险： 1.易造成人员坠落、伤亡的风险；存在导致船舶滞留或者罚款，影响装卸货的风险。 Risk existed: 1.Risk of personnel falls, injuries or fatalities; risk of ship detention or fines, which may affect cargo loading and unloading operation. 关闭要求: 1.已为临时跳板配齐并正确安装了滚轮，整套登船设施现已安全并符合规定。 Closing Requirements: 1.Rollers have been supplied and correctly installed on the temporary gangway. The entire boarding arrangement is now safe and compliant. 预防措施: 1. 已制定舷梯无法放置岸上时，采用替代登船设施的程序。 2. 使用临时跳板梯时，必须强制完成使用前检查和风险评估。 3. 已启用专用的登船设施检查清单，使用前核查跳板梯的滚轮，结构及安全状况。 Preventive Action: 1. A formal procedure has been established for alternative boarding arrangements when the ladder cannot reach the dock. 2. A mandatory pre-use inspection and risk assessment must be completed before using any temporary gangway. 3. A dedicated checklist for boarding arrangements has been implemented to verify rollers, structure, and safety condition before use. 3 描述： 船上垃圾存储容量不足（《垃圾管理计划》要求配备 14 个 0.2 立方米的垃圾桶，而船尾 甲板仅配备 12 个 0.2 立方米垃圾桶），船尾 3 个垃圾桶已装满并溢出，且桶盖未完全关 闭。另外，大约 1.0 立方米的各类垃圾被装在 2 两个聚丙烯袋中，露天存放于尾甲板。同 时发现垃圾桶固定不充分，绑扎松弛。该船最后一次向岸上设施处理垃圾时间为 2026 年 2 月 14 日。 Description: The vessel had insufficient garbage storage capacity (required as per garbage management plan 14 nos drums of 0.2 m3 each, whereas actually provided 12 nos drums of 0.2 m3 each on the poop deck).Three storage drums (capacity about 0.2 m3 each) were found overfilled and their lids left partially open at storage location on the poop deck. In addition, approximately 1.0 m3 of assorted garbage was stored in two polypropylene bags on the open poop deck (S). The garbage storage drums were also noted to be inadequately secured with loose lashings. The vessel had last disposed the garbage to the shore facility on 14 Feb 2026. 根本原因分析： 1.垃圾桶数量没有按照垃圾管理计划进行配备。 2.日常垃圾收集，压缩及监控工作执行不到位。 3.垃圾桶的存放与固定方式不符合要求。 Root Cause Analysis: 1. Garbage drums quantity not maintained as per Garbage Management Plan. 2. Ineffective daily garbage collection, compacting and monitoring. 3. Improper storage and securing of garbage drums. 产生的风险： 1.影响船舶安全与卫生，易造成海洋污染。 Risk existed: 1.It affects the safety and sanitation of the ship, and may easily cause marine pollution. 关闭要求: 1. 已将垃圾同数量补充至规定数量。 2. 对所有垃圾进行分类，压缩并妥善存放。 3. 已用适合的绑扎件固定所有垃圾桶，并盖好桶盖。 Closing Requirements: 1. Replenished garbage drums to required quantity. 2. Sorted, compacted and properly stowed all garbage. 3. Secured all drums with proper lashing and closed covers. 预防措施: 1.日常巡检检查表新增垃圾站检查项目。 2.针对 MARPOL 附则 V 及《垃圾管理计划》组织船员培训。 3.机务主管登轮时核查垃圾数量与状况。 Preventive Action: 1. Added garbage station check to daily patrol checklist. 2. Conducted crew training on MARPOL Annex V and Garbage Management Plan. 3. Superintendent to verify quantity and condition during visit. 4 描述： 各货舱舱口围顶部的内侧舱口边缘（1-5 舱受影响）被发现存在腐蚀和减薄情况，而 8,9 舱被观察到有部分换新。 Description: The inboard hatch rims at the various cargo holds coaming top were found to be corroded and thinned (cargo holds 1 to 5 were affected), whereas cargo holds 8 and 9 were observed partially renewed. 根本原因分析： 1. 未按照维护计划要求对舱口围板进行结构检查。 2. 防腐保护和油漆维护保养工作不到位。 3. 日常巡视检查未能及时发现结构减薄。 Root Cause Analysis: 1. Routine structural inspection of hatch coaming not performed as per PMS. 2. Insufficient corrosion protection and coating maintenance. 3. Structural thinning not detected during routine rounds. 产生的风险： 1.降低货舱舱口围结构强度，导致舱盖水密性失效。 Risk existed: 1.Reduce the structural strength of the cargo hold coaming ,resulting in the failure of the hatch cover’s watertight integrity. 关闭要求: 1.对腐蚀区域进行清洁，除锈及修复处理。 2.更换腐蚀的舱口围板边缘，恢复结构设计的厚度。 3.涂刷防腐油漆，完成修复工作。 4.制定专项维护保养计划，完成对1-5号货舱舱口板边缘的修复及换新，防腐保护工作。 Closing Requirements: 1. Cleaned, de-rusted and repaired corroded areas. 2. Renewed corroded coaming rims and restored structural thickness. 3. Applied anti-corrosive coating and completed repair. 4. Formulated a special maintenance plan and schedule to carry out repair, renewal and corrosion protection work for No.1, 2, 3, 4, 5 cargo hold coaming rims in the near term. 预防措施: 1. 严格执行维护保养计划中的防腐相关要求. 2. 将其纳入老龄船强化检查项目。 Preventive Action: 1. Strictly implemented PMS for corrosion protection. 2. Included in enhanced inspection program for aging vessels. 5 描述： 各货舱舱口围处多个止回排水阀防火冒（约 17 个）被发现与各自的拉锁脱离。 Description: Several fire caps (about 17 in number) for the non-return drain valves at various cargo hold coamings were observed detached from their respective valve lanyards. 根本原因分析： 1.备件管控和库存检查不足。 2.对止回阀和防火帽缺乏系统性检查。 Root Cause Analysis: 1.Insufficient spare parts control and inventory check. 2.Lack of systematic inspection for drain valves and fire caps. 产生的风险： 影响货舱消防安全，易造成止回阀作用失效造成还说倒灌货舱，造成货损或破坏船舶稳 性。 Risk existed: It impairs the fire safety of the cargo holds, and may cause failure of the non-return valves ,resulting in seawater backflow in to the holds, cargo may damage, or compromise of the ship’s stability. 关闭要求: 1. 紧急为所有的排水阀配齐并安装了 24 个防火帽。 2. 确认所有的防火帽安装到位，并通过拉锁固定。 3. 更新备件库存与相关的记录。 Closing Requirements: 1. Urgently supplied and fitted 24 fire caps on all drain valves. 2. Verified all caps in place and secured with lanyards. 3. Updated spare parts inventory and records. 预防措施: 1. 将防火帽检查纳入日常安全检查项目。 2. 优化提高备件预测与订购程序。 Preventive Action: 1. Added fire caps check to timely safety inspection. 2. Improved spare parts forecasting and ordering procedure. 6 描述： 发现尾甲板中间两台缆车的刹车带的可见区域已减薄磨损少于原始厚度的一半。 Description: The visible areas of the brake lining of two mooring winches located at the mid-ship on the poop deck were found thinned down to less than half of the original thickness. 根本原因分析： 1. 未按照维护保养计划的要求测量刹车带的厚度。 2. 未对磨损厚度进行定期记录。 3. 日常检查中未发现该缺陷。 Root Cause Analysis: 1. Brake lining thickness not measured as per PMS requirements. 2. No periodic recording of wear thickness. 3. Defect not detected during routine inspection. 产生的风险： 刹车带磨损减薄会导致系泊缆车制动力不足，甚至失效，引发断缆，船舶漂移，碰撞吗 偶等事故，严重威胁系泊作业安全和人员生命安全。 Risk existed: Thinned brake lining will cause insufficient or even lost braking torque of the mooring winches, leading to broken mooring lines , ship drifting, and collision with the berth, seriously endangering mooring operation safety and crew safety. 关闭要求: 1. 使用经认可 的新备件更换磨损的刹车带。 2. 测量并记录新的刹车带的厚度，结果符合要求。 3. 完成刹车力测试，结果满意合格。 Closing Requirements: 1. Replaced worn brake linings with new approved parts. 2. Measured and recorded new thickness; meets standard. 3. Completed functional brake test; satisfactory. 预防措施: 1. 执行落实刹车带厚度测量和记录工作。 2. 针对甲板部人员开展了刹车带磨损判断标准的培训。 3. 加强对系泊缆车刹车带的定期检查和测量工作。 Preventive Action: 1. Implemented brake lining thickness measurement and recording. 2. Conducted training for deck crew on brake wear criteria. 3. Strengthen the regular inspection and measurement of the mooring winch brake linings. 7 描述： 经检查发现，尾甲板右侧舷梯附近的一台便携式起重机系固不充分，绑扎松弛。在检查 期间已报告完成了绑扎整改。 Description: A portable mobile crane located near the accommodation ladder on the poop deck (S) was found inadequately secured with loose lashing. It was reported that the lashings were rectified during the inspection. 根本原因分析： 1. 设备使用后未严格按规定执行固定程序。 2. 开航前检查未覆盖包括可移动设备。 3. 临时设备绑扎的监督管理不到位。 Root Cause Analysis 1. Securing procedure not properly followed after use. 2. Pre-departure inspection did not cover movable equipment. 3. Insufficient supervision of ad-hoc equipment lashing. 产生的风险： 绑扎松弛的便携式起重机会以造成位移，倾倒，易造成设备损坏，人员受伤。 Risk existed: The loosely secured portable crane may shift, topple and resulting equipment damage or causing the injuries to personnel. 关闭要求: 1. 已立即按照公司安全管理体系及绑扎规定，对便携式移动起重机进行重新绑扎，并妥 善，牢固固定。 2. 已针对全体船员开展可移动设备固定于绑扎的安全管理体系要求专项培训，内容包括 操作流程，风险意识及开航前检查标准。 Closing Requirements: 1. The portable mobile crane was immediately re-lashed and secured properly and firmly in compliance with company’s SMS and lashing regulations. 2. A comprehensive safety training was conducted for all crew on SMS requirements for securing and lashing of movable equipment, covering procedures, risk awareness, and pre-departure inspection criteria. 预防措施: 1. 将可移动设备固定检查项目增加至开航前检查表。 2. 针对船员开展设备绑扎及安全管理体系要求的专项培训。 3. 加强开航前的主管现场抽查工作。 Preventive Action: 1. Added movable equipment securing to pre-departure checklist. 2. Conducted crew training on equipment lashing and SMS requirements. 3. Enhanced supervisor spot-check before departure. 8nature 描述： 在审核船岸安全检查表时发现，检查表中未包含装卸工人熟悉应急程序的相关内容，无 证据证明每班完成了针对货舱进入程序的船岸检查表验证工作。 Description: Upon reviewing the ship/ shore safety check list, it was noted that the stevedore familiarization section with emergency procedure was not included in the check list, and there were no evidence showed that the verification of ship-shore checklist against cargo hold entry procedure was carried out every watch. 根本原因分析： 未能有效执行船岸安全程序的要求。 Root Cause Analysis: Insufficient implementation of the requirements for ship-shore safety procedures. 产生的风险： 1.存在装卸工人不熟悉船舶应急设备程序，一旦发生意外，无法正确响应，导致人员伤亡 的风险。 2.每班未能验证货舱进入程序，可能导致气体检测，通风等安全措施失效，引发人员伤亡。 Risk existed: 1.Stevedores unfamiliar with the ship’s emergency procedures may fail to respond correctly during cargo holds operation, leading to casualties. 2.Failure to verify the cargo hold entry procedure every watch may result invalid gas detection and ventilation measures , causing casualties. 关闭要求: 1.立即修订检查表，新增加装卸工人应急程序熟悉情况的检查项目。 2.对所有值班班次，每小时检查一次货舱进入程序的执行情况。 3.与装卸工人开展联合安全简会，明确应急程序的要求。 Closing Requirements: 1.Revise the checklist immediately, add stevedore familiarization section with emergency procedures. 2.Verify cargo hold entry procedures hourly for all watch shifts. 3.Conduct joint safety briefing with stevedores and emergency procedures. 预防措施: 1.在装货前召开船岸联合安全会议，核查检查表执行情况及装卸工人的培训情况。 2.培训并监督值班人员，在港口货物操作作业期间按要求正确执行船岸安全程序。 3.加强船舶安全管理体系的学习与落实。 Preventive Action: 1.Hold a pre-loading joint ship-shore safety meeting to review checklist compliance and stevedore training status. 2.Train and supervise the duty crew to properly carry out ship-shore safety procedure as required during cargo operations in port. 3.Strengthen learning ship management system. 9 描述： 检查时发现，船上配备 1 台 PS245 型和 1 台 GX-8000 型气体检测仪，两款仪器均具备检 测 氧气（O2）,甲烷（CH4）,一氧化碳（CO）和硫化氢（HS）的功能，仅只有 GX-8000 型气体检测仪内置采样泵，而且船上未配备其它额外的手动采样管。 Description: At the time of the inspection, it was noted that 1set PS245 and 1 set GX-8000 gas detector with function to detect O2 , CH4 , CO and H2S were onboard , only the GX-8000 gas detector was fitted with build in pump and no any other extra manual pipe were provided for the ship also. 根本原因分析： 缺少一台气体检测仪，而且未及时补充备用气体检测仪。 Root Cause Analysis: Lost one gas detector and No supplementary gas detector in time. 产生的风险： 无内置采样泵的气体检测仪无法对货舱及封闭空间进行深层气体采样，若设备故障，将 失去主动检测能力，易引发缺氧，中毒或爆炸等事故，威胁作业人员安全。 Risk existed: The gas detector without build-in pump cannot perform deep gas sampling in cargo holds or enclosed space, if pumped detector fails, will lose the active sampling capability , which may lead to hypoxia, poisoning or explosion accident, endangering the lives of personnel. 关闭要求: 1.加装一台带内置采样泵的气体检测仪。 2.按照制造厂商说明完成年度校准，并将校准证书留存在船上。 Closing Requirements: 1.Install one additional gas detector with built-in sampling pump. 2.Complete annual calibration in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions and retain calibration certificates on board. 预防措施: 1.根据记录清单加强监督与检查。 2.加强对 SOLAS 相关规定的学习。 Preventive Action: 1.Strengthen supervise and inspection according to record list. 2.Strengthen study the SOLAS regulation requirements. 10 描述： 检查时，船级社出具的直升机平台强度确认函未在船备查。 Description: The strength confirmation letter of helipad from class not available at the time of the inspection. 根本原因分析： 1. 对法规要求的理解不充分。 2. 遗漏相关证书。 Root Cause Analysis: 1. Lack sufficient understanding the regulation requirements. 2. left out the certificate. 产生的风险： 无船级社出具的直升机平台强度确认函，无法确认平台结构强度符合安全要求，直升机 起降坑发生平台坍塌，变形，引发坠毁，人员伤亡事故。 Risk existed: Without the strength confirmation letter of the helipad issued by the classification society, the structural strength of platform cannot be confirmed to meet safety requirements. The platform may collapse or deform during helicopter takeoff and landing ,causing crashes and casualties. 关闭要求: 按照法规要求，向 NK 船级社申请 SOF 证书。 Closing Requirements: Request SOF certificate from NK according to the regulation requirements. 预防措施: 1.加强监督与检查。 2.加强对法规要求的学习。 Preventive Action: 1. Strengthen supervision and inspection. 2. Strengthen study the regulation requirements. 11 描述： 船尾甲板右侧一救生圈，其连接救生圈和自亮灯的救生绳破损，长度约 20cm。 Description: One lifebuoy fitted on the starboard side of the aft poop deck has a deterioration painter line connecting the lifebuoy to the self-igniting light, approx. 20cm in length. 根本原因分析： 1.日常检查不到位。 2.维护保养缺失。 3.船员安全意识不足，能力欠缺。 Root Cause Analysis: 1. Inadequate routine inspection. 2. Lack of preventive maintenance. 3. Insufficient crew awareness and competent. 产生的风险： 救生绳破损可能导致自亮灯脱落或救生圈抛投失效，落水人员在夜间无法被定位，直接 降低生还概率，引发伤亡事故。 Risk existed: The damaged painter line may cause the self-igniting light to fall off or the lifebuoy to fail during deployment, making it impossible to locate personnel overboard at night and directly reducing the chance of survival, leading to casualties. 关闭要求: 1.立即更换链接救生圈与自亮灯的浮索。 2.确保浮索配置到位并符合规则要求。 Closing Requirements: 1.Immediate replacement of the painter line connecting the lifebuoy to the self-igniting light. 2.Ensure the painter line on site and compliance restoration. 预防措施: 1.严格按照公司安全管理体系执行检查。 2.加强对救生设备和消防设备检查的监督和管理。 Preventive Action: 1.Carry out inspection in strict accordance with the company’s SMS. 2.Strength supervision and management for LSA & FFE inspection. 12 描述： 在检查中发现，右锚止链器与锚链轮之间锚链有扭转。 Description: At the time of the inspection , it was noted that the starboard anchor chain to be twisted between stopper and wildcat. 根本原因分析： 1.起锚时锚链偏角过大。 2.锚链轮严重腐蚀，导致锚链方向翻转。 Root Cause Analysis: 1.The anchor chain deviated at an excessive angle when the anchor was being heaved. 2.The chain wheel was severely corroded, causing the chain to reverse its direction. 产生的风险： 1.锚链扭转会产生剪切应力，加速锚链链环磨损断裂，导致锚设备失效。 2.扭转的锚链易卡阻在锚链轮或止链器内，影响应急抛锚操作，延误处置时机。 Risk existed: 1.Twisted anchor chain will generate additional shear stress, accelerating wear and fracture of chain links, leading to anchor equipment failure. 2.The twisted chain is prone to jamming in the wildcat or stopper, affecting emergency anchoring operation, delaying response time and amplifying accident consequences. 关闭要求: 使用锚机放出锚链，并用撬杠和钢板将锚链方向复位。 Closing Requirements: Use the windlass to release the anchor chain and use a crowbar and steel plate to reverse the direction of the anchor chain. 预防措施: 1.起锚时使用车舵配合调整锚链角度。 2.下次坞修时对锚链轮进行维护保养。 Preventive Action: 1.Use the engine and rudder adjust the chain angle when heaving anchor. 2.Maintenance and servicing of the chain wheel during dock downtime. 13 描述： C 层甲板两个机舱通风机备拆解送岸修理，未关闭会议前未能复位安装。 Description: Two engine room blowers on C deck were disassembled for shore repairing , prior to close meeting was not installed back. 根本原因分析： 因船舶震动，防火风闸轴与铜套发生磨损，间隙增大，导致风闸轴下沉。 Root Cause Analysis: Because of ship vibration, fire fan damper shaft ground the copper bushing clearance grew and fire damper shaft sank. 产生的风险： 1.机舱通风机缺失导致机舱通风不足，油气浓度升高，热量积聚，极易引发火灾或爆炸事 故。 2.高温无法散发会造成机舱设备过热失效，影响船舶动力系统，导致船舶失去操纵能力， 威胁航行安全。 Risk existed: 1.The lack of engine room blowers leads to insufficient ventilation, increase oil-gas concentration and heat accumulation, which may easily cause fire or explosion accidents. 2.Failure to dissipate high temperature will cause overheating failure of engine room equipment, affecting the ship’s power system, leading to loss of maneuverability and threatening navigation safety. 关闭要求: 拆解风闸并送车间修理，更换防火风闸轴及铜套，修理后复装。 Closing Requirements: Dismantled damper and sent to workshop, renewed fire damper shaft & copper bushing ,Fitted it back once recondition was completed. 预防措施: 加强日常检查，加注润滑油，降低轴系震动。 Preventive Action: Strengthen routine checked, and fill grease for bushing, reduce shaft vibration. 14 描述： 机舱底层平台上，连接主海水泵与主柴油机空气冷却器及滑油冷却器的两端海水管路已 被拆除，由岸上服务队进行修理，计划在船离港前完成复位安装。 Description: 2 sections of sea water line from main sea water pump to main engine air cooler and lub oil cooler in engine room bottom platform were dismantled for repair by shore service team, plan to installed back before vessel departure. 根本原因分析： 海水管路因腐蚀造成泄漏。 Root Cause Analysis: Sea water pipe leaking due to corrosion. 产生的风险： 1.海水管路拆除导致主机冷却系统终端，主机过热会引发拉缸，烧瓦灯故障，造成主机停 机，船舶失去动力。 2.滑油冷却失效会导致油温过高，润滑失效，加剧设备磨损，同时可能引发滑油自然，导 致机舱火灾。 3.若维修安装延误，船舶无法按时离港，造成船期延误，影响正常营运。 Risk existed: 1.The removal of sea water lines interrupts the main engine cooling system, overheating of the engine may cause serious failures such as cylinder scoring and bearing seizure ,leading to main engine shutdown ,the ship will lose power. 2.Failure of lubricating oil cooling will result in height oil temperature and insufficient lubrication ,accelerating equipment wear and potentially causing spontaneous combustion of lubricating oil, leading to engine room fire accident. 3.If the repair and installation are delayed , the ship will not be able to depart on schedule, facing risks of schedule delay, charter party breach, disrupting normal operation. 关闭要求: 由岸基维修队更换新的海水管路。 Closing Requirements: Renewed new sea pipe by shore team. 预防措施: 1.降低 MGPS 的运行电流。 2.加强日常保养。 Preventive Action: 1.Decreased the MGPS running current. 2.Strengthen routine inspection. 15 描述： 检查时发现，位于空调间内的澄清热水循环泵，其压盖密封处存在漏水现象，漏水速率 约为每秒 3 滴。 Description: The hot water circulating pump for the clarifier located in the AHU room was observed leaking water from gland seal at a rate of approximately 3 drops per second. 根本原因分析： 对热水循环泵的检查存在疏忽。 Root Cause Analysis: Negligence for inspection for hot water circle pump. 产生的风险： 压盖密封漏水可能导致热水滴入空调间内的电器设备，引发短路，漏电，进而造成电器 设备烧毁或火灾，威胁船舶安全。 Risk existed: The water leakage from the gland seal may cause hot water to drip into electrical equipment in the AHU room, leading to short circuit and electric leakage, which in turn may cause electrical equipment burn out or fire, endangering the safety of the ship. 关闭要求: 立即压紧轴封，以较少泄漏。 Closing Requirements: Fasten the gland packing immediately for reduction leakage. 预防措施: 加强对所有设备的检查工作。 Preventive Action: Strengthen inspection for all equipment。 16 描述： 在 3 舱和 4 舱之间的甲板右侧桅房内发现 1 台电动抛光机，1 台电动角磨机和 1 台电动切 割机均未安装安全防护罩。 Description: In the deck store on the starboard side of the main deck between No.3 and No.4 cargo holds, one electric buffing machine, one electric grinder and one electric cutter were found without safety guards fitted. 根本原因分析： 1.船员没有严格遵守船舶安全操纵程序 2.船员缺乏船舶安全操作程序的培训。 Root Cause Analysis: 1.Crew failed to strictly follow ship Safe Operations procedures. 2.Lack of Safe Operations procedures training for crew. 产生的风险： 1.无防护罩的电动工具在使用时，砂轮，切割片等部件高速旋转，一旦破裂，碎片飞溅， 易造成人员严重割伤。 2.抛光，打磨作业会产生大量金属火花，无防护张时，火花不受控制飞溅，若附近有易燃 物，极易引发火灾。 Risk existed: 1.When using power tools without safety guards, the high-speed rotating parts may break or fragment may fly out, easily causing cuts burns, leading serious mechanical injury accidents. 2.Sparks generated by polishing and grinding will splash uncontrollably, easily igniting flammable materials in the store room, causing fire accidents. 关闭要求: 1.加强监督管理。 2.每日工前会上强调相关要求。 Closing Requirements: 1.Strengthen supervision. 2.Emphasized at toolbox meeting every day. 预防措施: 1.加强对全体船员的船舶安全操作程序培训。 2.加强船舶管理体系的学习。 Preventive Action: 1.Strengthen training for all crew members about ship Safe Operations. 2.Strengthen learning ship management system. 17 JOY 描述： 船上未明确规定电子海图显示与信息系统（ECDIS）航线的命名与标识规则。该系统内保 存的航线名称高度相似（如 “V07B1”“V007B3”“V07B3”），且无清晰标识可显示检查时 正在使用的具体航线。纸质航行计划中提及的 “V007”，与检查时电子海图显示与信息系 统内的航线命名不相符。 Description: ECDIS route naming and identification were not clearly defined on board. Routeson the ECDIS were saved with similar titles (e.g. “V07B1”, “V007B3”, “V07B3”),and no clear identification was available to show which route was in use at thetime of inspection. The paper passage plan referenced “V007”, which was not aligned with the route naming on the ECDIS at the time of inspection. 根本原因： 船员对安全管理体系（SMS）中有关电子海图显示与信息系统（ECDIS）航线的标准化命 名、核查及使用要求缺乏足够熟悉，导致出现不合规操作，且未在电子海图航线与纸质 航行计划之间开展定期核查。 Root Cause: The crew lacked adequate familiarity with the requirements of the SMS concerning the standardised naming, verification, and use of ECDIS routes, leading to non-compliant practices, with no regular verification between the ECDIS route and paper passage plan. 产生的风险： 存在航行安全隐患，ECDIS 中航线命名不规范，标识不清，易导致值班驾驶员无用航线， 造成偏航，误入危险水域，引发搁浅，碰撞等事故；同时纸质航次计划于电子航线命名 不匹配，无法形成有效交叉验证，航行过程中失去安全校核保障。 Risk existed: There are navigation safety risks, the non-standard route naming and unclear identification in ECDIS may lead to the watch officer misusing routes, resulting in deviation from the planned track, entering dangerous waters, and causing accidents such as grounding and collision. Meanwhile, the mismatch between the paper passage plan and ECDIS route naming fails to form effective cross-verification, losing the safety check guarantee during navigation. 关闭要求: 已根据安全管理体系（SMS）要求进行修正，并针对船上所有甲板部高级船员开展专项 培训，内容涉及与电子海图显示与信息系统（ECDIS）航线管理相关的船舶安全管理体系 程序，包括命名规范、航线核查以及交接要求。 Closing Requirements: Corrected according to the SMS requirement and Conduct a targeted training session for all deck officers on the vessel’s SMS procedures related to ECDIS route management, including naming standards, route verification and handover requirements. 预防措施: 严格执行统一的航线命名标准，杜绝随意命名现象。定期核对纸质与电子航线信息，确 保二者保持一致。定期清理冗余的电子海图显示与信息系统航线，规范在用航线标注工 作。定期开展船员培训，强化日常作业管控。主管部门实施日常监督，并将其纳入安全 检查管理范畴。 Preventive Measure: Strictly implement unified route naming standards to avoid random naming. Regularly check paper and electronic route information to ensure consistency. Regular clean up redundant ECDIS routes and standardize in-use route marking. Conduct regular crew training and strengthen daily operation control. Master implements daily supervision and includes it is safely inspection management. 18 描述： 氧气/乙炔气体系统已于 2026 年 4 月 20 日完成年度第三检验；但是船上无法提供氧气乙 炔减压阀的制造日期，也无相关记录证明已按照制造商要求进行更新/更换，且船上未存 放制造商的操作/维护指南。 Description: The OX/AC gas system had received annual third-party inspection 20 Apr 2026; however, the manufacturing dates of the AC and OX regulators were not known, no records were available to verify renewal in accordance with manufacturer requirements, and no manufacturer’s guidance was available on board. 根本原因： 工作人员不熟悉调节器背面数字钢印所代表的生产厂家含义，因此不清楚调节器的生产 日期。 Root Cause: The crew not familiar with the manufacture’s meaning represented by the digital steel printing on the back of the regulators, so the production date of the regulators is not familiar. 产生的风险： 存在严重的安全隐患，氧气、乙炔减压阀无制造日期，无更换记录，无法确认是否超期 服役，易出现泄漏，压力失控，引发火灾或爆炸事故， 同时船上无制造厂商的操作维护 指南，船员造作无标准依据，进一步放大安全的风险。 Risk existed: There are serious safety risk, the manufacturing dates of the oxygen/acetylene regulators are unknown and no renewal records are available, making it impossible to confirm whether they have exceeded their service life, which may lead to leakage, pressure loss, fire or explosion accidents. Meanwhile, the lack of manufacture’s operation and maintenance guidance on board leaves crew without standard operating references, further amplifying safety risks. 关闭要求: 通过查询相关信息，了解调节器背后数字所代表的含义，并对机舱部全体船员开展相关 知识培训。 Closing Requirements: Through the query information to know the meaning of the digital representative behind the regulators, and train all the crew of engine department related knowledge. 预防措施: 为监管机构做好记录，其中应包含制造商的生产日期和有效期，以便在监管设备到期前 提前进行更换。 Preventive Measure: Make a record for the regulators, including the manufacture’s production date and expiry date, so that the regulators can be replaced in advanced before the expiration of the regulators. 19 描述： 船上无相关记录能够证明，已对舱盖的垫铁，定位块和止动块进行了间隙测量，在检查 期间发现仅对锁紧器和舱盖围板的间隙进行了检查。 Description: There were no records available to verify that clearance measurements for bearing pads, locators and stoppers had been carried out, with inspections observed limited to cleats and hatch cover skirt clearance. 根本原因： 船员对舱口盖检查的安全管理体系（SMS）要求缺乏充分理解，导致检查范围不完整， 遗漏了对承压垫板、定位器及止动器的间隙测量工作。该船现有的舱口盖检查记录不完 整，未能全面反映所需维保项目的检查范围。 Root Cause: The crew lacked full understanding of the SMS requirements for hatch cover inspection, resulting in incomplete inspection scope that omitted clearance measurements for bearing pads, locators and stoppers. The vessel’s existing hatch cover inspection records were incomplete and did not fully reflect the scope of required maintenance items. 产生的风险： 维护保养缺失，PSC、船级社检验会直接开缺陷。 Risk existed: Lack of maintenance will directly result in deficiencies being issued during PSC and classification society inspections. 关闭要求: 立即完成船上所有舱盖支承垫板、定位器及止动器的间隙测量工作，并核实所有间隙均 符合制造商技术规范。补充并归档完整的舱盖检验记录，其中应包含所有测量数值与检 验日期，以备后续核查。针对甲板部船员开展专题培训，内容涵盖舱盖维护与检验要求 的全部范畴。 Closing Requirements: Immediately complete the clearance measurements for all hatch cover bearing pads, locators and stoppers on board, and verify that all clearances comply with the manufacturer’s specifications. Supplement and archive the complete hatch cover inspection records, including all measured values and inspection dates, for future verification. Conduct a targeted training session for deck crew on the full scope of hatch cover maintenance and inspection requirements. 预防措施: 制定一份符合安全管理体系（SMS）要求的标准化舱口盖检查清单，清单需涵盖所有必 检项目（承压垫板、定位器、止动器、系缆扣、舱口围板间隙），并定期更新；同时按 照制造商推荐的周期，对承压垫板、定位器及止动器进行定期间隙测量。为甲板船员制 定年度安全管理体系培训计划并开展考核，确保其全面熟悉舱口盖检查流程及记录保存 要求。 Preventive Measure: Implement a standardized, SMS-compliant hatch cover inspection checklist, which includes all required items (bearing pads, locators, stoppers, cleats, hatch skirt clearances) and is updated regularly, with periodic clearance measurements for bearing pads, locators and stoppers scheduled in accordance with the manufacturer’s recommended intervals. Conduct annual SMS training plan and assessment for deck crew to ensure full familiarity with hatch cover inspection procedures and record-keeping requirements. 20 描述： 1.第 8,9 货舱的尾倒缆绞缆机齿轮油观察窗因表面被油漆或环氧树脂覆盖，已无法观察油 位。 2.船首楼右舷外侧的一台绞缆机，齿轮箱观察窗处存在漏油现象，油液已扩散并污染了下 方机壳。 Description: 1-Mooring winches for aft spring lines at Cargo Holds No.8 and No.9 were observed with the gear oil sight glasses not visible, with the surfaces coated/covered with paint or epoxy. 2-One mooring winch at the forecastle, starboard side outer position, was observed with oil leakage from the gearbox sight glass, with oil spreading and contaminating the casing below. 根本原因： 船员对液压甲板机械操作及管理规定中的安全管理体系（SMS）要求缺乏充分理解，未 开展检查工作，且船员未能及时发现问题。 Root Cause: The crew lacked full understanding of the SMS requirements for Hydraulic deck machinery operation and management regulations. Lack inspection and crew don’t find timely. 产生的风险： 应急操作时绞缆机失效风险。 Risk existed: Risk of mooring winch failure during emergency operation. 关闭要求: 1. 清理 8 号与 9 号货舱之间系泊绞车齿轮箱油位观察窗上的油漆。 2. 检查并维护右舷艏楼系泊绞车齿轮箱观察窗，清理系泊绞车表面的油污。 Closing Requirements: 1.To clean the paint on the oil level sight glass of the mooring winch gear box between cargo hold NO.8 and NO.9. 2.Inspect and maintain the forecastle mooring winch gear box sight glass of the starboard side, clean the oil stains on the mooring winch surface. 预防措施: 1.开展相关培训：学习公司船舶安全管理体系文件 SHIP-06-15：液压甲板机械操作与管 理规定。学习公司船舶安全管理体系文件 SHIP-08-12：锚机及系泊设备检验、试验与维 护。 2.今后定期检查，发现问题及时处理。 Preventive Measure: 1.Do relevant training: Study the company SMS SHIP-06-15: Hydraulic deck machinery operation and management regulations. Study the company SMS SHIP-08-12: Windlass and Mooring Equipment Inspection, Test & Maintenance. 2.Check regularly in the future, find problems to deal with in time. 21 描述： 检查发现，应急发电机房内 220V 配电板的绝缘低，报警值设置为 0.5Mohm，水手长仓库 内 220V 照明配电板的绝缘低，报警值设置为 0.4Mohm。检查时测得，该 220V 照明配电 板的绝缘电阻约为 1Mohm。 Description: Insulation low alarm settings were observed set at 0.5 MOhm for the 220 V panel in the emergency generator room and 0.4 MOhm for the 220 V lighting distribution board in the bosun store. The insulation resistance on the 220 V lighting distribution board was observed at approximately 1 MOhm at the time of inspection. 根本原因： Root Cause: The crew lacked full understanding of the SMS requirements for Ship Electrical Equipment Management Precautions and lack of inspection. 产生的风险： 易引发电气短路、打火，诱发火灾。 Risk existed: It is prone to causing electrical short circuits and sparks, which may trigger fires. 关闭要求: 将 220V 电源绝缘报警值设定为规定的 0.2 兆欧。 并检查了船舶桅灯的绝缘状况，重新进行了水密处理，目前状态良好。 Closing Requirements: Set the insulation alarm value of 220V power supply to the specified 0.2 MΩ And checked the insulation condition of the mast light of the ship, and made watertight treatment again, now in good condition. 预防措施: 学习公司 SMS SHIP-08-05：船舶电气设备管理注意事项。了解绝缘过低故障的成因、解 决措施，以及电气设备管理中后续维护的要点。 Preventive Measure: Study the company SMS SHIP-08-05: Ship Electrical Equipment Management Precautions. Learn the cause of low insulation failure and the solution and the main points of future maintenance in electrical equipment management. 22 描述： SKY 核查发现，该轮烟台港靠泊富余水深（UKC）测算情况：船舶吃水 18.2 米，依据船舶安 全管理体系（SMS）规定，港内航行最低富余水深为吃水的 10%（1.82 米），船舶进港 时实际富余水深满足该项要求。但引水登船点错误套用了开敞海域富余水深计算公式： 开敞海域富余水深标准为吃水的 20%（3.64 米），而该处实际富余水深仅 1.88 米，未 达标，测算记录却仍勾选 “合格（YES）”。 Description: Inspection verified the UKC calculation for berthing at Yantai. With a draft of 18.2 m, the SMSrequires a minimum navigating in port UKC of 10% of draft (1.82 m), and the vessel’s actual UKC whileentering port satisfied this requirement. However, the open sea UKC calculation form was used for the pilotboarding point. The required open sea UKC is 20% of draft (3.64 m), whereas the actual UKC was 1.88 m,falling short of the standard. The calculation was still recorded as "YES ". 根本原因： 1.负责人对安全管理体系（SMS）SHIP-05-01 规定的富裕水深计算要求不熟悉。 2.旧版龙骨下富余水深计算表格未单独标注港内、开阔海域对应的计算系数，无区分提示， 存在固有设计缺陷，易造成人为误用。 Root Cause: 1.PIC lacked proficiency with company SMS procedure SHIP-05-01 governing graded under keel clearance calculation requirements. 2.Legacy UKC calculation form fails to separately mark calculation coefficients for in-port / open sea, lacking distinguishing prompts, with inherent design defects prone to human misuse. 产生的风险： 记录虚假勾选合格，存在搁浅、船体受损。 Risk existed: Falsely recorded as compliant, bringing risks of grounding, hull damage. 关闭要求: 1.船长组织一个专项甲板部门培训关于“安全管理体系（SMS）SHIP-05-01 规定的富裕 水深”在 2026 年 5 月 28 日（培训记录签字），说明 UKC 计算依据在港内是船舶静态最 大吃水 10%，在深水区域是船舶静态最大吃水 20%。 2.富余水深计算表格已升级至 V03 版本，内嵌自动计算公式，可按水域类型自动区分参 数，消除人工计算误差。已回收所有作废的 V02 版本表格并统一销毁，相关处置记录留 存船上。 3.后续从烟台港开航的航次，均使用新版龙骨下富余水深计算表格，核算结果经核查符合 规范要求。 Closing Requirements: 1.Master organized a dedicated full deck department training on SMS SHIP-05-01 dated 28 May 2026 (supported by signed training record), clarifying 10% in-port and 20% open-water UKC calculation criteria. 2.UKC calculation form upgraded to Revision V03 with embedded automatic formulas enabling auto parameter differentiation per water zone to eliminate manual calculation errors. All obsolete V02 forms collected for scrapping with disposal record kept onboard. 3.Subsequent departure voyages from Yantai adopt updated forms for under keel clearance calculation with verified compliant computation results. 预防措施: 1.所有 UKC 数据执行双重录入操作，并在最终确认前对所有参数进行交叉核对。 2.船长每周随机抽查至少三份 UKC 计算文件，由独立审核人签名后归档。 3.修订后的计算表格纳入 SMS 文件；岸基海务主管每月对表格执行情况进行随机抽查。 Preventive Measure: 1.Dual-entry practice enforced for all UKC data with cross-check of all parameters before finalization. 2.Master randomly audits minimum three UKC calculation documents weekly with independent review signature for filing. 3.Revised calculation form incorporated into controlled SMS documents; shore-based marine superintendent conducts monthly random inspection on form implementation. 23 描述： 检查期间对 ECDIS 中的航行计划进行了审核。根据船舶航行程序，ECDIS 的安全设置 ——浅水等深线、安全等深线、安全水深和深水——分三个阶段进行调整。然而，在 ECDIS 的计划航线/航路上，以及航行计划中，并未显示任何专用标记或符号来标明这些设置应 进行更改的位置或转向点。同样，根据船舶航行程序，“前视和环视”设置也分为三个 阶段，但在 ECDIS 的计划航线/航路上，以及航行计划中，也未显示任何专用标记或符 号来标明这些设置应进行更改的位置或转向点。 Description: The passage plan in the ECDIS was reviewed during the inspection, the ECDIS safety settings —shallow contour, safety contour, safety depth, and deep water—are adjusted in three distinct stages A/P vessel’s navigation procedure. However, no dedicated marks or symbols are displayed on the planned route/passage in ECDIS and the passage plan to indicate the positions or waypoints where these setting changes should be made. A/P Vessel’s Navigation procedure, there were three stages of Look ahead and lookaround settings, However, no dedicated marks or symbols are displayed on the planned route/ passage in ECDIS and the passage plan to indicate the positions or waypoints where these setting changes should be made. 根本原因： 1.负责人不熟悉安全管理体系文件 SHIP-05-18 关于电子海图系统操作程序。 2.标准的航次计划模板未设置必填栏用以标注电子海图系统参数修改位置，且安全管理体 系中未明确相关执行要求。 Root Cause: 1.PIC non-familiar with SMS SHIP-05-18 governing ECDIS operational procedures. 2.Standard voyage plan template has no mandatory field to indicate ECDIS parameter modification positions, lacking specified implementation requirement in SMS. 产生的风险： 关键点位无标注，航行参数切换遗漏，易导致船舶搁浅和碰撞。 Risk existed: Missing marks may result in missed parameter adjustment and subsequent vessel grounding and collision. 关闭要求: 1.船长于 2026 年 5 月 28 日为全体驾驶员开展了 ECDIS 专项培训，明确了三个阶段报警 标准及强制标注要求。 2.烟台至舟山航行计划中补充了参数变更所需的坐标；针对港口、近岸及开阔海域分别配 置了分段安全水深、前视及扇形区报警参数并在 ECDIS 航线上添加了相应标记。 Closing Requirements: 1.Master delivered full deck officer ECDIS specialized training on 28 May 2026 specifying three-zone alarm standards and mandatory marking requirements. 2.Coordinates for parameter changes supplemented to Yantai-Zhoushan voyage plan;
