corresponding markers added on ECDIS route with segmented safety depth, look-ahead and sector alarm configuration for port, coastal and open sea sectors. 预防措施: 1.航行计划模板已修订，新增了[ECDIS 参数修改位置]的必填栏，要求填写相应的坐标标 注。 2.离港前会议包含 ECDIS 参数配置的交叉核对项目；二副编制计划，由大副负责验证。 3.船上每月进行航行审核；岸基部门对 ECDIS 配置执行不定期的远程抽查。 Preventive Measure: 1.Voyage plan template revised to add mandatory field titled [ECDIS Parameter Modification Positions] with required coordinate notation during voyage planning. 2.Pre-departure meeting includes cross-verification item for ECDIS configuration; Second Officer compiles plan verified by Chief Officer. 3.Monthly onboard navigation audit conducted; shore side performs unscheduled remote ECDIS configuration spot-checks. 24 描述： 检查期间已核查动火作业许可证、封闭空间进入许可证，但船上上锁挂牌（LOTO）未并 入作业许可（PTW）管理体系。 Description: The Hot work permit, enclosed space entry permit was reviewed during the inspection, however, The Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) was not integrated with the Permit to Work (PTW) system on board. 根本原因： 1.现有 SHIP-02-05-01 项下的作业许可（PTW）检查表不完整，安全管理体系（SMS）文 件中未规定强制性的上锁/挂牌（LOTO）验证条款。 2.船员在能源隔离方面规定的上锁/挂牌要求培训不足。 Root Cause: 1.Existing PTW checklist under SHIP-02-05-01 is incomplete with no stipulated LOTO mandatory verification clauses within SMS documentation. 2.Crew receives insufficient training on regulatory lockout/tagout requirements for energy isolation. 产生的风险： 易因设备意外启动引发机械伤害、火灾爆炸等人身伤亡事故。 Risk existed: It may lead to accidental startup of equipment, resulting in mechanical injury, fire and explosion casualties. 关闭要求: 1.热工作业及进入封闭空间作业许可文件已更新至 3.0 版/8.0 版，新增挂牌上锁隔离、 电气挂牌锁定相关勾选项；已回收所有空白旧版许可，统一启用新版表格。

defects.inspected_item: 年 6 月 2 日，依照修订后的许可制度开展实际封闭空间作业，作业许可签署完整、 2.2026 年 6 月 2 日，依照修订后的许可制度开展实际封闭空间作业，作业许可签署完整、 归档留存，符合挂牌上锁相关标准。 Closing Requirements: 1.Hot work and enclosed space entry permit documents updated to Rev3.0/Rev8.0 with additional checkboxes for LOTO isolation and electrical lockout tagging; all blank obsolete permits retrieved and superseded by updated forms. 2.Actual enclosed space entry operation approved under revised permit system executed on 02 June 2026 with fully signed filed permits complying with lockout/tagout standards. 预防措施: 1.船长组织甲板部与轮机部开展作业许可及挂牌上锁综合培训。 2.轮机长每月随机抽查至少两份在用作业许可，核查挂牌上锁执行情况是否合规。 3.船长已将作业许可文件完整性纳入月度安全管理体系核查清单，用于船岸自查。 Preventive Measure: 1.Master arranges combined deck & engine department PTW and LOTO comprehensive training. 2.Chief Engineer randomly inspects minimum two active work permits monthly to confirm LOTO compliance. 3.PTW documentation completeness included in monthly SMS review checklist by Master for ship-shore self-inspection. 描述： 1.检查查阅了最近两份船岸安全检查表，但缺少装卸工人应急程序熟悉培训相关项目。 .无相关记录和证据证明每值班次至少对货舱进入作业程序开展一次核查。 Description: .Last two ship-shore safety checklists were reviewed during the inspection, however the stevedore familiarization section with emergency procedures was not included. .There was no records or evidence to indicate that the cargo hold entry procedures had been verified at least once every watch. 根本原因： . 原始检查表编制不完整，遗漏了岸上人员应急简要确认条目。 . 船上未针对货舱进入建立正式的每班次例行核查制度。 Root Cause: .Original checklist compiled incompletely omitting shore personnel emergency briefing confirmation clause. .
defects.desc: formal routine per-shift verification system established onboard for cargo hold entry activities. 产生的风险： 1.码头装卸人员不熟悉船上应急处置，发生泄漏、火灾、人员被困时处置失误，扩大险情、 造成人员伤亡。 2.管控缺位易出现违规盲目入舱，引发缺氧、有毒气体中毒窒息事故。 Risk existed: 1.Stevedores lack emergency knowledge, improper response may aggravate accidents and casualties. 2. Absence of per-watch verification leads to irregular hold entry and risks of poisoning or suffocation. 关闭要求: 1.修订后的 SHIP-07-01-02 岸船检查表新增以下内容：确认装卸工已接受应急指导及货舱 进入程序简报的确认项；补充表格关于每班次货舱进入核查；旧版表格即行废止。 2.自 2026 年 5 月 27 日起，货物作业中使用修订版检查表，每班次均进行完整的货舱气体 监测，并由船岸双方签署验证记录。 Closing Requirements: 1.Revised SHIP-07-01-02 shore-ship checklist adding: confirmation item for stevedore emergency induction and hold entry procedure briefing; supplementary form for per-shift hold entry verification; obsolete forms withdrawn from use. 2.Revised checklist implemented during cargo operation commencing 27 May 2026 with complete per-shift hold gas monitoring and signed verification records by both ship and shore parties. 预防措施: 1.靠泊开始装货作业前，大副确认新版检查清单全部填写完毕；未按要求签字，禁止开始 装货作业。 2.货舱进入检查记录和船岸检查清单一并归档，靠泊后由船长复核。 3.岸基管理公司每季度对船舶船岸安全文件开展随机抽查。 Preventive Measure: 1. Prior to loading commencement alongside berth, Chief Officer confirms full completion of revised checklist; loading prohibited without required signatures. 2. Hold entry check records filed together with shore-ship checklists and reviewed by Master post-berthing. 3. Shore management company implements quarterly random document audits for vessel shore-ship safety files. 26 描述： 机舱车间装设的电焊机回路线永久搭接在船体结构上。 Description: The welding machine fitted in engine room work shop was found the return line permanent connected to the ship’s structure. 根本原因： 1.船舶新建建造期间，工厂安装不当。 2.在后续的船舶交接验收以及日常机舱巡回检查中，忽略了隐藏的接地隐患。 Root Cause: 1.Improper factory installation during vessel new building construction. 2.Hidden earthing hazard overlooked during successive vessel take-over acceptance and regular engine room rounds. 产生的风险： 结构腐蚀，设备损坏，火灾爆炸 Risk existed: Structural corrosion, equipment damage, fire and explosion. 关闭要求: 1.拆除固定式接地装置，按照安全规范改装为可拆卸式接地电缆。 2.轮机长使用专用检查清单，对全船便携式电焊机接地装置开展全面检查，并整改所有同 类不合格项。 Closing Requirements: 1.Remove permanent fixed earthing connection and refit detachable movable earthing cables per safety specifications. 2.Chief Engineer completes full vessel inspection of all portable welding machine earthing circuits with dedicated inspection checklist and rectifies all identical non-conformities. 预防措施: 1.机舱值班人员将电气设备接地装置纳入日常巡查范围。 2.已在新船交接及试航验收清单中新增电焊机接地专项核查项，后续新造船均遵照执行。 Preventive Measure: 1.Engine room watchkeepers include electrical equipment earthing integrity within daily routine inspection scope. 2.New ship take-over and sea trial acceptance checklist supplemented with dedicated welding machine earthing verification item for future new buildings. 27 描述： 除6货舱舱舱盖装有 46 只自动围紧器外，其余各舱舱盖均配置 16 只，但部分围紧器卡 滞卡死，无法灵活活动。 Description: There were 16 pcs of auto cleats fitted on each hatch cover except No.6( 46 pcs),however Some of them were found seized in position not free to move. 根本原因： 船舶保养计划（PMS）存在缺陷，日常维护缺少定期活络作业。 Root Cause: Deficient planned maintenance system (PMS) routine servicing lacking periodic freeing and lubrication work. 产生的风险： 舱盖启闭困难，风浪天气舱盖密闭不良，海水渗入致货舱进水、货物受损。 Risk existed: Difficult hatch operation leads to poor watertightness, causing seawater ingress and cargo damage in heavy seas. 关闭要求: 船舶停靠舟山太平洋船厂期间，厂方人员采用可控加热 + 机械敲击方式拆解所有卡死围 紧器，完成彻底活络，现已操作灵活。 Closing Requirements: All seized cleats disassembled via controlled heating and mechanical tapping, fully freed and lubricated for smooth operational movement by yard staffs during ship at Zhou shan Paxocean shipyard. 预防措施: 1.自动舱盖围紧保养已纳入月度维护保养计划中，包含拆解、除锈及润滑活络作业。 2.水手长每周检查舱盖，发现缺陷立即上报部门长，并录入维护保养计划中。 Preventive Measure: 1.Automatic hatch cleat maintenance incorporated into monthly PMS schedule including disassembly, descaling and grease replenishment. 2.Bosun performs weekly hatch cover inspection; emerging defects reported promptly to department head and logged into PMS maintenance system. 28 描述： 4号舱盖右前密封条受压凹陷，实测凹陷深度16毫米、长度约2米；舱盖说明书规定凹陷 超 5毫米即需更换。 Description: Hatch cover no.4 starboard forward rubber packing was found over pressed measured with16mm deep and in a length of approximately 2mtrs, Hatch cover instruction manual the recommended to change if more than 5mm. 根本原因： 舱盖日常保养不到位，加之紧固螺栓紧力异常，致使橡胶条因受压过度而出现永久性变 形。 Root Cause: Poor routine hatch maintenance and abnormal preload of tightening bolts leading to permanent rubber deformation under excessive compression. 产生的风险： 密封失效，航行中海水渗入舱内，造成货物受潮受损。 Risk existed: Failed sealing causes seawater leakage and cargo wet damage at sea. 关闭要求: 1.船舶在舟山太平洋船厂期间，厂方人员拆除 4 货舱舱盖右前侧受压变形的旧橡胶条，对 橡胶槽进行除锈清洁，并安装全新橡胶条。 2.对受影响的舱盖螺栓进行调整；全船检查所有舱盖胶条压缩余量，对不合格部位现场调 整。 Closing Requirements: 1.The No.4 H/C starboard forward over pressed rubber packing removed, channel descaled &cleaned , the brans-new rubber packing installed by yard staffs during ship at Zhou shan Paxocean shipyard. 2.Calibrate bolt preload torque for affected hatch; full vessel survey of all hatch packing compression margin with on-site fine-tuning for out-of-spec units. 预防措施: 1.将橡胶条的压缩量测量纳入季度 PMS（计划保养系统）维护项目中。 2.水手长在开航前进行舱盖开关操作时，目视检查橡胶条状况，发现异常立即报告缺陷。 Preventive Measure: 1.Rubber packing compression measurement added into quarterly PMS maintenance items. 2.Bosun visually inspect packing condition during hatch opening/closing before departure with immediate defect reporting upon abnormality. 29 描述： 锅炉安全阀附近两处蒸汽管线隔热层缺失，缺失长度约 20 厘米。 Description: Two steam line near the boiler safety valve was found the lagging missing in a length of approximately 20cm. 根本原因： 机舱日常巡查存在疏漏，高温管路隔热层预防性保养工作不到位。 Root Cause: Oversight during engine room routine patrols and insufficient preventive maintenance for high-temperature pipeline insulation. 产生的风险： 高温管线裸露易烫伤人员，热量损耗加剧。 Risk existed: Exposed hot piping may cause personnel scald and excessive heat loss. 关闭要求: 破损处已重新完整包妥隔热层并固定牢靠；轮机长对机舱所有高温蒸汽管路开展全面检 查，集中修复隔热层。 Closing Requirements: Damaged piping fully re-insulated and secured in place; Chief Engineer conducts full engine room high-temperature steam pipe survey for centralized insulation repair. 预防措施: 1.机舱月度保养中增设蒸汽管路隔热层专项全面检查项目。 2.值班轮机员在日常巡查中，重点检查锅炉及主蒸汽管路隔热层完好状态。 Preventive Measure: 1.Monthly engine room maintenance includes dedicated full steam piping insulation inspection item. 2.Watch engineers prioritize integrity check of boiler and main steam line insulation during regular rounds. 30 描述： 已核查 2026年2月1日、2026年5月28日的引航卡和船长引水信息交换表资料，拖轮总缆 桩拉力、缆桩安全负荷、拖缆缆绳设计破断力数据未更新。 Description: Pilot card and MPX dated on 01/Feb/2026 & 28/May/2026reviewed, the tug total bollard pull, SWL of the bollard & LDBF of tug line were not updated. 根本原因： 值班驾驶员（OOW）未完整填写船长和引水交换信息，且未按要求执行交叉核对。 Root Cause: OOW were not properly filled in details of M&P exchange information, cross check was not followed. 产生的风险： 数据不准易靠离泊发生断缆、船舶碰撞。 Risk existed: Outdated data may lead to line broken, collision. 关闭要求: 此后须仔细核对并完整填写引航卡交接信息。 Closing Requirements: Hereafter, carefully check and complete the pilot card exchange information. 预防措施: 加强相关培训，严格落实交叉核查工作。 Preventive Measure: Strengthen training and carefully cross checking. 31 描述： 电子海图（ECDIS）上中止线标注错误，不可折返界线与应急抛锚区未标注。 Description: The Abort line was incorrectly marked on the ECDIS, the Line of non-return & contingency anchorage were not marked on the ECDIS. 根本原因： 1.开航前检查不到位。 2.航行安全规范意识不足。 Root Cause: 1.Inadequate Pre-departure Check. 2.Insufficient Awareness of Navigation Safety Specifications. 产生的风险： 关键航线缺失标注，危急时无法精准决策避险，易造成船舶搁浅、触礁。 Risk existed: Missing markings hinder emergency decision-making, risking grounding and stranding. 关闭要求: 1.依据最新海图、港口规章及航线计划导则，重新校准并修正电子海图（ECDIS）中止线 位置。 2.及时在电子海图标注不可折返线与应急锚地，保证全部安全界限线、应急锚地标绘准确、 完整，满足航行规范要求。 Closing Requirements: 1.Re-calibrate and correct the position of the abort line on ECDIS in strict accordance with the latest nautical charts, port regulations and passage planning guidelines. 2.Complete the marking of line of non-return and contingency anchorage on ECDIS timely, ensure all safety limit lines and emergency anchorage marks are accurate, complete and compliant with navigation requirements. 预防措施: 1.规范航次计划与电子海图作业。 2.强化船员相关培训与评估工作。 Preventive Measure: 1.Standardize Passage Planning & ECDIS Operation. 2.Strengthen Crew Training & Assessment. 32 描述： 公司演练计划表（附录二）未列入电子海图故障应急演练项目。 Description: ECDIS failure drills did not included in the company drill matrix (Appendix II). 根本原因： 船员不熟悉 RISQ 3.2 最新条款要求。 Root Cause: Not familiar with the new requirement of RISQ 3.2 by ship staff. 产生的风险： 船员缺乏实操训练，ECDIS 突发故障时处置不当，易引发搁浅。 Risk existed： Without relevant drills, improper response to ECDIS failure may result in grounding. 关闭要求: 将电子海图故障应急演练列入演练计划表，自即日起每三个月开展一次该项演练。 Closing Requirements: Add the ECDIS failure drill into the drill matrix, start to have such drill every 3 month from now on. 预防措施: 依照更新后的演习计划表执行该演习。 Preventive Measure: Follow the updated drill matrix to carry out panned drills. 33 描述： 经核准的安全设备记录未更新，缺少引水梯的材质、生产厂家及制造检验标准信息。 Description: The Record of Approved Safety Equipment was not updated to reflect the material, manufacturer, and the standard to which the pilot ladder was made and tested. 根本原因： 1.船员未对新更换引水梯的全部技术资料严格核验和完善建档。 2.船员日常安全检查与文件检查未包含引水梯技术资料的完整性。 Root Cause: 1.The ship staff fail to strictly verify and complete the full technical information of the newly replaced pilot ladder. 2.The ship’s staff safety inspection and document checking did not cover the completeness of pilot ladder technical records. 产生的风险： 资料缺失无法核查引水梯合规性，使用不合格引水梯易造成登离船人员坠落伤亡。 Risk existed： Incomplete records may lead to usage of non-compliant pilot ladder and cause pilot fall injury. 关闭要求: 立即收集引水梯全套技术文件，包含厂家资质证书、产品材质说明书、出厂试验报告， 待下次船级社检验时提交验船师审核确认。 Closing Requirements: Immediately collect the complete technical documents of the pilot ladder, including manufacturer qualification certificate, product material specification sheet, factory test report and submit to class surveyor to check and approve during next class survey. 预防措施: 1.优化文件管理制度：修订完善船上安全设备文件管理规程。 2.强化日常检查与审核：将安全设备技术资料完整性纳入船舶日常安全检查及月度内部审 项目中。 Preventive Measure: 1.Optimize Document Management System: Revise and improve the ship’s safety equipment file management procedures. 2.Strengthen Daily Inspection & Audit: Incorporate the completeness of safety equipment technical records into the ship’s daily safety inspection and monthly internal audit items. 34 描述： 1.压载控制室首尾吃水计显示数值错误：实测首吃水 13.9m，仪表显示 16.2m；实测首吃 水 12.4m，仪表显示 18.2m。 2.压载水阀维护与测试项目未纳入PMS中。 Description: 1.The fwd and aft draft gauge in the ballast control room were indicating wrong valve, at the time of inspection fwd draft was13.9M and draft gauge indicating 16.2 meters, fwd draft was12.4M and draft gauge indicating 18.2 meters. 2.The maintenance and testing of the ballast valves was not incorporated in the PMS. 根本原因： 1.日常未仔细检查吃水计。 2.不熟悉船舶维护系统（PMS）程序操作，检查工作不到位。 Root Cause: 1.Not carefully inspection the draft gauge in daily time. 2.The operation of PMS program is not familiar and the inspection is not in place. 产生的风险： 吃水读数失真、阀门缺少定期维保，易致压载调载失误，船舶出现横倾、超载、搁浅。 Risk existed： Incorrect draft reading and lack of valve maintenance may cause improper ballasting, resulting in vessel list, overloading or grounding. 关闭要求: 1.检修吃水标尺，使其恢复正常使用。 2.将回转台及其销轴纳入计划维护系统（PMS）。 Closing Requirements: 1.Repair the draft gauge and recover to normal working condition. 2.Add turn table and its pin into PMS. 预防措施: 学习和加强培训。 Preventive Measure: Learning and strengthen training. 35 描述： 船上配备非分离式绞缆机，但绞缆机刹车力测试仅按照计算公式采用第一层缆绳进行， 大多数的系泊作业实际使用缆绳层数未进行刹车力测试。 Description: The undivided winches were fitted on board, however, the first layer mooring line was used for the winch break rendering test according to the formula adopted for the calculation, and the normal layer in used for most mooring operations was not considered for the mooring winch break rendering test. 根本原因： 未正确理解刹车力测试的计算原理，本船正常层数不是第一层。 Root Cause: Not correctly understanding the principle of calculation break render capacity, the normal layer was not the first layer on our vessel. 产生的风险： 刹车测试与实际工况不符，系泊时刹车承载力不足，易出现断缆、船舶漂移碰撞。 Risk existed： Test condition inconsistent with actual operation may cause brake failure, rope breakage and vessel collision. 关闭要求: 结合系泊作业常规使用约 4 层缆绳的实际情况，重新计算所有系泊绞车的刹车力。 Closing Requirements: Considering the normal layer in use for most mooring operation about 4 layers and recalculate the rendering capacity for all mooring winch. 预防措施: 强化船上培训与检查，将本船系泊作业常规使用层数相关内容纳入船舶缆绳管理计划并 完成更新。 Preventive Measure: Strengthen training and inspection on board, add the normal layer used on board of most mooring operation and updated in ship’s mooring system management plan. 36 描述：

defects.inspected_item: 号辅机 1～6 号燃油泵周边发现约 2 升渗油。 1.1 号辅机 1～6 号燃油泵周边发现约 2 升渗油。
号辅机 1～6 号燃油泵周边发现约 2 升渗油。 2.3 号辅机 1～6 号燃油泵周边发现约 2 升渗油。 Description: .Approximately 2 ltrs of oil were observed around
defects.desc: .1 AE fuel oil pump No.1～No.6. 2.Approximately 2 ltrs of oil were observed around No.3 AE fuel oil pump No.1～No.6. 根本原因： 日常检查不够全面，未能及时发现并清理轻微渗油，造成泵体周边积油。 Root Cause: The routine daily inspection was not thorough enough, resulting in minor oil leakage not being detected and cleaned in a timely manner, causing accumulated oil around the pump casing. 产生的风险： 积聚燃油易遇高温起火，人员滑到。 Risk existed： Accumulated oil risks fire hazard and personnel slipping. 关闭要求: 1.立即彻底清理 1 号、3 号辅机燃油泵周边积油，保持该处整洁干燥。 2.对所有辅机燃油系统进行全面检查，确认无同类渗漏、积油情况。 Closing Requirements: 1.Immediately clean up all accumulated oil around No.1 and No.3 AE fuel oil pumps thoroughly and keep the surrounding area clean and dry. 2. Carry out a full inspection of all auxiliary engine fuel oil systems to confirm no similar leakage or oil accumulation exists. 预防措施: 1.加强机舱日常巡检，提升船员渗漏排查意识，做到轻微渗油、积油早发现、早处置。 2.始终保持机舱整洁达标，杜绝同类检查缺陷再次发生。 Preventive Measure: 1.Strengthen daily machinery space inspection and enhance crew’s awareness of leakage monitoring. Ensure minor oil seepage and oil accumulation are detected and disposed of at the early stage. 2.Maintain a clean machinery house standard at all times to avoid similar inspection defects. 37 描述： 船上已安装主机功率限制（EPL）；但驾驶台操纵手册未提现出功率限制情况下的船舶操 纵性能特性。 Description: The engine power limiter (EPL) was installed onboard the vessel; The maneuvering booklet on bridge has not been updated to reflect the vessel's performance characteristics under 'EPL-limited power' conditions. 根本原因： 干坞修理完工后未及时更新主机功率限制相关信息 Root Cause: Failure to update EPL-related information in a timely manner after dry docking-repair。 产生的风险： 驾驶员对船舶制动、旋回、加速能力等操纵边界预判偏差，极易在狭水道航行、靠离泊 作业、避碰处置及应急操作过程中引发碰撞、搁浅、浪损等水上交通安全事故。 Risk existed： Cause to misjudge the vessel's stopping, turning and acceleration capabilities, which highly risks collision, grounding, swash damage and other maritime safety accidents during narrow channel navigation, berthing/unberthing, collision avoidance and emergency operations. 关闭要求: 将更新后的主机功率限制相关信息加入到驾驶台操纵手册内 Closing Requirements: Update the EPL related information into the maneuvering booklet on bridge. 预防措施: 1. 针对船员高级船员开展 IMO 第 A.601 (15) 决议相关培训 2. 核查引航卡、驾驶台挂图及操纵小册子同步更新情况 3. 依据船舶安全管理体系建立闭环安全管理流程 Preventive Measure: 1. Training for officers regarding IMO Res.A601(15) 2. Check Pilot card、Wheelhouse Poster and Maneuvering Booklet synchronous update. 3. Form a closed-loop SMS management in accordance with SMS 38 描述： 尾甲板气瓶间内 5 只气瓶（3 只氧气瓶、2 只乙炔瓶），其下部固定卡箍未固定到位。 Description: At the cylinder locker on the poop deck, five cylinders (three oxygen, two acetylene) were observed the lower securing clamps not fixed in position at time of inspection. 根本原因： 缺乏检查与安全意识 Root Cause: Lack of inspection and safety awareness 产生的风险： 尾楼甲板气瓶间未固定的氧气瓶与乙炔瓶在船舶摇晃时易倾倒泄漏，引发燃爆、人员伤 亡事故。 Risk existed： Unsecured oxygen and acetylene cylinders in the poop deck cylinder locker are prone to toppling and gas leakage under vessel rolling, which may cause fire、 explosion、 marine casualties. 关闭要求: 立即紧固下方固定卡箍。 Closing Requirements: Fixed the lower securing clamps at once 预防措施: 1.全面检查船上所有气瓶的固定夹具完好状况。 2.对相关船员开展安全管理体系专项培训（比如：SHIP-02-02 工作场所的安全规定和 SHIP-02-06 热工作业的安全规定） Preventive Measure: 1. Inspect the condition of securing clamps for all gas cylinders on board. 2. Conduct SMS section training for relevant crew members(such as ：SHIP-02-02 Safety of Workplaces and SHIP-02-06 Safety of Hot Work.) 39 描述： 存放于首楼储物间的 2 个停用引水软梯，既没做清晰标识也没悬挂标签注明停用状态。 Description: Two out of service pilot ladders stowed in the forecastle store were neither clearly marked nor tagged to indicate their unserviceable status. 根本原因： 疏忽 Root Cause: Negligence in work. 产生的风险： 未标注或者悬挂停用状态的报废引航员软梯易被误用于登离船作业，引发人员高空坠落 伤亡。 Risk existed： Unmarked and untagged out of service pilot ladders are prone to misuse during embarkation and disembarkation operations, resulting in fatal fall casualties. 关闭要求: 在废弃引航梯张贴 “停用” 标识。 Closing Requirements: Do the “OUT OF USE” sign on abandoned pilot ladders. 预防措施: 1.船员加强在用与停用的区分及管理 2.核查其他设备是否张贴 “停用” 标识。 Preventive Measure: 1.Strengthen the identification and management of in use and not in use by crew members. 2.Check other equipment “OUT OF USE” mark. 40 描述： 检查发现主甲板上所有燃油柜、柴油柜和润滑油柜透气管口周围安装的集油槽，其透气 管头最低延伸管的出口低于集油槽（大约低 200 毫米），因此在恶劣天气条件下可能会 阻碍柜内真空压力的释放。 Description: The save-alls fitted around all fuel, diesel, and lubricating oil tank vents on main deck was noted that the lowest extension pieces outlet of the vent head was lower than the save-all (approx. 200mm deficiency), therefore this could obstruct the release of vacuum pressure within the tank during adverse weather conditions. 根本原因： 缺乏检查 Root Cause: Lack of inspection. 产生的风险： 恶劣工况下会堵塞透气通道、阻碍舱室压力平衡。 Risk existed： blocks tank vents, obstructs tank pressure balance under adverse weather conditions. 关闭要求: 对透气管头最低延伸管进行局部切断，使排出口高出对应的集油槽。 Closing Requirements: Partially cut down the lowest extension pipes of vent heads to raise their outlets above the corresponding save-alls. 预防措施: 对甲板所有油舱透气帽开展全面检查，确保透气管头最低延伸管的出气口高度高于集油 槽，保证透气通畅。 Preventive Measure: Carry out complete inspection for all oil tank vents on deck to ensure the outlets of the vent head’s lowest extension pipes are kept higher than the save-alls（easy to air flow in and out）. 41 描述： 约三分之一（54 个中的 6 个）舱盖滚轮限制器的橡胶缓冲垫表面被刷油漆（安装于 1-9 货舱舱口围轨道端部、以及舱口围平台中部位置）。 Description: Approximately one-third (6 out of 54) of the rubber buffer pads on the wheel stoppers (fitted at the coaming track ends and center of the coaming table for Hatches 1–9) were found painted. 根本原因： 甲板保养工作疏忽，相关检查不够细致。 Root Cause: Deck maintenance work is negligent and the inspection is not carefully. 产生的风险： 易引发舱盖结构损坏、货舱水密失效进水。 Risk existed： Lead to hatch cover structural damage, cargo hold watertight failure and water ingress. 关闭要求: 清除油漆，换新橡胶缓冲垫。 Closing Requirements: Remove the paint, Renew the rubber buffer pads. 预防措施: 加强甲板日常检查和甲板维护保养工作。 Preventive Measure: Enhance deck daily inspection and maintenance of deck work 42 描述： 检查发现：应急发电机是依靠单台启动马达；船上虽备有备用启动马达且上次测试时间 为 2025 年 12 月 6 日，但未按规范要求保持季度测试频率，无法确保其应急就绪状态。 Description: The emergency generator is reliant on a single starter motor. A spare starter motor is available onboard and was last tested on 06 Dec 2025; however, the quarterly testing frequency? has not been maintained to ensure operational readiness. 根本原因： 缺少检查与保养记录。 Root Cause: Lack of inspection and maintenance record. 产生的风险： 应急时易启动失效导致全船失电，引发航行失控、碰撞搁浅等重大安全事故。 Risk existed： It is prone to start-up failure under emergency conditions, resulting in the vessel blackout and leading to major maritime safety accidents such as not under command、collision 、 grounding. 关闭要求: 测试备用启动马达，并及时做好记录。 Closing Requirements: Test the spare starter motor and record it in time. 预防措施: 依据安全管理体系要求每季度对备用启动马达进行功能测试并留存完整记录，确保该设 备随时可用。 Preventive Measure: Test and record the spare starter motor quarterly as per SMS, make sure the starter motor can be used at any time. 43 描述： 船员洗衣房烘干机的绒毛过滤网缺失。 Description: The lint filter was found missing from the clothes dryer located in the crew laundry. 根本原因： 服务生清洁过滤网后，未及时装回。 Root Cause: Steward removed the filter cover and not put it back in time after cleaning. 产生的风险： 干衣机绒毛滤网缺失易导致易燃绒毛堆积在高温腔体，引发干衣机自燃、生活区火灾。 Risk existed： Missing lint filter of the clothes dryer will cause accumulation of flammable lint in the high-temperature chamber, leading to dryer spontaneous combustion, accommodation area fire. 关闭要求: 立即安装过滤网。 Closing Requirements: Back install dryer filter cover immediately. 预防措施: 指定专人负责管理与日常检查。并强化监督核查工作。 Preventive Measure: Assign specific person to manage & do a routine check. Strengthen supervision and inspection. 44 描述： INTEGRITY 本船装有传输式磁罗经，无任何记录证明该设备按周期开展测试。现场检测读数：陀螺 罗经 269.6 度，标准磁罗经 282.5 度，传输磁罗经 282.5 度。 Description: The vessel fitted with Transmitting Magnetic Compass, there was no evidence that the TMC was tested at regular interval. At the time of inspection, gyro reading: 269.6 degrees, magnetic compass reading:282.5, TMC: 282.5. 根本原因： 1.船员未充分认识定期 TMC 测试的重要性，未开展自查。 2.驾驶员航海设备维护与测试职责不清晰。 Root Cause: 1.The crew lacks awareness of the importance of regular TMC testing and failed to conduct self-inspections. 2.The responsibility for the maintenance and testing of navigational equipment is unclear among the officers. 产生的风险： 无法核实传输磁罗经精度，航行易出现航向偏差，威胁航行安全。 Risk existed： The accuracy of TMC cannot be verified, which may cause heading deviation and endanger navigation safety. 关闭要求: 立即对 TMC 开展功能测试，设备运行正常。 Closing Requirements: Conducted an immediate functional test of the TMC; results confirmed the equipment is operating normally. 预防措施: 1. 在安全管理体系内制定清晰的 TMC 测试计划表，确保各项记录可追溯。 2. 船长加强日常监督检查，重点核查 TMC 等关键航海设备测试记录。 3. 加强新任驾驶员航海设备交接熟悉培训，使其掌握相关维护要求。 Preventive Measure: 1.Establish a clear testing schedule for the TMC within the SMS to ensure traceability. 2.Master shall strengthen routine oversight and inspection, specifically verify the testing records of key navigation equipment like the TMC. 3.Strengthen the handover and familiarization training for navigation equipment for newly joined officers to ensure they understand the maintenance requirements. 45 描述： 临告和预告的修正内容未被手动录入航次计划，也未在英版海军部信息叠加层（AIO）与 T&P 通告之间，对照周版《航海通告》进行交叉核对。。 Description: The T&P corrections had not been manually entered into the passage plan and cross checked between the Admiralty Information Overlay (AIO) and T&P notice against the Weekly Notice to Mariners. 根本原因： 1.船员未遵守航次计划操作规程，规程要求手动录入临告和预告海图改正资料，并对照英 版海图信息叠加系统（AIO）与《每周航海通告》交叉核对。 2.驾驶员不熟悉英版海图信息叠加系统更新内容与每周航海通告的比对流程，仅依赖电子 系统，未开展人工复核。 Root Cause: 1.The crew did not follow the voyage planning procedure requiring manual entry of T&P corrections and cross-checking against AIO and Weekly Notices to Mariners. 2.Lack of familiarity with the process of comparing Admiralty Information Overlay (AIO) updates with weekly notices, leading to reliance solely on electronic systems without manual verification. 产生的风险： 增加搁浅、碰撞等航行风险。 Risk existed： Increase navigational risks such as grounding and collision. 关闭要求: 1.立即将全部未录入的临告和预告改正录入航次计划，并对英版海图信息叠加层、临告和 预告通告及最新每周航海通告完成全面交叉核对。 2.核实修正后的航次计划由船长批准，并向值班驾驶员完整讲解。 Closing Requirements: 1.Immediately entered all outstanding T&P corrections into the passage plan and performed a full cross-check between the AIO, T&P notices, and the latest Weekly Notices to Mariners. 2.Verified that the corrected passage plan was approved by the master and properly briefed to the watch keeping officers. 预防措施: 1.明确规定必须手工录入临告和预告改正，开航前留存交叉核对书面记录。 2.针对全体驾驶员开展专项培训，讲解英版海图信息叠加层、临告和预告通告、每周航海 通告的正确使用方法，并配套交叉核对实操练习。 Preventive Measure: 1.Explicitly mandate the manual entry of T&P corrections and require documented evidence of cross-checking prior to departure. 2.Provide targeted training for all navigating officers on the correct use of AIO, T&P notices, and Weekly Notices to Mariners, including practical exercises on cross-referencing. 46 描述： 船舶于2026年6月16日在烟台西港靠泊前，于4号锚地抛锚，但无论是在电子海图（ECDIS） 还是航次计划表格中，均未对航次计划进行修正。 Description: Vessel anchored at No.4 anchorage prior berthing Yantai west port on 16/Jun/2026, there was no passage plan amendment was prepared in both ECDIS and passage plan form. 根本原因： 船员未能意识到，靠泊前在指定锚地抛锚属于航次阶段变更，需要修正航次计划。 Root Cause: The crew did not recognize that anchoring at a designated anchorage prior to berthing constitutes a change in the voyage phase requiring an amended passage plan. 产生的风险： 导致航次计划不完整，增加船舶靠泊操作中的搁浅、碰撞等航行风险。 Risk existed： Result in an incomplete passage plan and increase the risk of grounding, collision, and other navigational hazards during berthing operations. 关闭要求: 1.立即编辑航次计划，覆盖 4 号锚地至烟台西港泊位全程航线，并同步录入 ECDIS 及纸 质航次计划表 2.核实该修正的航次计划并由船长批准，并在船舶驶往泊位前向所有值班驾驶员做了简要 通报。 Closing Requirements: 1.Immediately prepared a revised passage plan covering the route from the No.4 anchorage to the berth at Yantai West Port, and entered it into both ECDIS and the paper passage plan form. 2.Verified that the revised plan was approved by the master and briefed to all watch keeping officers before proceeding to berth. 预防措施: 1.在抵港前、抛锚前程序中增设强制检查项，确认航次发生变更时已完成航次计划修正。 2.以本次缺陷作为案例，针对全体驾驶员重新培训，讲解《国际海上人命安全公约》第五 章及公司安全管理体系中关于航次计划修正的相关要求。 Preventive Measure: 1.Include a mandatory checklist item in the pre-arrival and pre-anchoring procedures to confirm that the passage plan has been amended if the intended operation changes. 2.Provide refresher training to all navigating officers on the requirements for passage plan amendments as per SOLAS Chapter V and company SMS, using this deficiency as a case study. 47 描述： 电机员于 2026 年 6 月对各类机械和设备的马达和配电板进行了绝缘测试（涉及超过 100 件设备/机械），但上述作业均未签发上锁挂牌（LOTO）许可证或风险评估报告。 Description: The Electrical Engineer carried out meger test for motors and switchboard on various machinery and equipment in Jun 2026 ( over 100 equipment/machinery), however there was no LOTO permits/ Risk assessment issued for these jobs. 根本原因： 船员在执行上锁挂牌（LOTO）作业时安全意识不足，需进一步加强。 Root Cause: There is insufficient awareness of safety in the implementation scope of Lock out and Tag out operations, which needs to be enhanced. 产生的风险： 未签发上锁挂牌（LOTO）许可证和风险评估即进行大批量电气测试，导致安全隔离措施 缺失，显著增加人员触电、电弧灼伤及设备意外启动引发重伤事故的风险。 Risk existed： Without issuing LOTO permits or risk assessments leads to a lack of electrical isolation and safety controls, significantly increasing the risk of electric shock, arc flash, and unexpected equipment start-up, which could result in serious personnel injuries. 关闭要求: 组织全员学习船舶 SHIP-02-21 锁闭挂牌规定，要求电气作业期间严格遵守该程序，提升 相关安全意识。 Closing Requirements: Trained SHIP-02-21 Regulations on Lock out and Tag out& compliance with this procedure when election operation. Enhance awareness in this area. 预防措施: 1.设立监督，每日监督船员落实上锁挂牌作业流程，及时纠正违规行为。 2.通过真实案例剖析讲解，加深船员对上锁挂牌作业重要性的认知。 3.鼓励船员交流执行上锁挂牌作业中的经验与问题，定期对流程执行情况汇总分析。 Preventive Measure: 1.Set up supervision posts to supervise the crew's implementation of Lock out/Tag out procedures on a daily basis and correct violations in time. 2.Analyze and explain actual cases to strengthen crew members' understanding of the importance of Lock out/Tag out. 3.Encourage crew members to share their experiences and problems in the execution of Lock out/Tag out, summarize and analyze the execution of procedures regularly. 48 描述： 压载水阀保养和测试没有纳入计划维护保养系统。 Description: The maintenance and testing of the ballast valves was not incorporated in the PMS. 根本原因： 检查工作不够细致到位。 Root Cause: Inspection work are not careful and meticulous. 产生的风险： 缺少计划性维护易造成压载阀故障失灵，影响压载水操作，存在船舶稳性风险。 Risk existed： Lack of maintenance may cause ballast valve malfunction, impair ballasting and endanger vessel stability. 关闭要求: 1.将压载水阀门测试项目录入 PMS。 2.压载水遥控阀门须按照 PMS 要求定期测试。 Closing Requirements: 1.Insert the valve tested items in PMS system. 2.Ballast remote valve tested at regular interval based PMS. 预防措施: 1.组织船员培训压载水遥控阀测试操作方法。 2.安排轮机人员依据PMS定期检查压载水遥控阀。 Preventive Measure: 1.Training crew how to test ballast remote valve at local. 2.Arrange engineer to regularly check the ballast remote valve according the PMS 49 描述： 1.在 6 号货舱后部左侧的舱盖上，观察到一段长约 30 厘米的插入式橡胶条。 2.5号货舱后部左侧的橡胶密封条，发现存在10~12毫米的凹槽/压痕（约为实际尺寸50±1 毫米的25%）。 Description: 1.An insert rubber packing piece with length approximately 30 cm was observed on hatch coverNo.6 Aft Port side. 2.Rubber packing of the cargo hold No. 5 on aft port side was noted with grooving 10~12mm (approximately 25% of actual size 50-+1 mm). 根本原因： 1.该缺陷大概率是舱盖启闭时舱盖与密封胶条发生摩擦、装卸货作业造成磨损、胶条长期 露天风吹雨淋，以及长时间受压出现压缩永久变形所导致。 2.甲板船员未按照船舶计划维护保养系统（PMS）和安全管理体系（SMS）开展定期检查 并进行规范保养。 Root Cause: 1.It is likely caused by friction between the hatch cover and the packing rubber during opening and closing operation or wear from cargo handling activities, or pronged exposure to the weather and compression set over time. 2.Officer crew are not carried out interval inspection and make a proper maintenance according the PMS and SMS. 产生的风险： 在恶劣海况下易发生货舱进水，造成货物湿损、船舶稳性恶化，并可能因积水影响船舶 航行安全。 Risk existed： Increasing the risk of cargo hold flooding in heavy weather, which may cause cargo damage, stability degradation, and potential navigational hazards due to accumulated water. 关闭要求: 1.拆除凹槽/压痕密封胶条，并且更换新密封胶条。 2.更换部分橡胶条并且长度超过一米。 Closing Requirements: 1.Remove the grooving rubber packing and install the new rubber packing. 2.Replace the part of that section of the rubber packing more than 1meters in length. 预防措施: 1.对舱盖所有密封胶条制定月度检查计划，定期检查胶条磨损、沟槽及破损情况。 2.检查胶条压缩变形程度、磨损程度以及固定状况，提前更换出现老化或严重磨损的密封 胶条。 3.组织船员开展舱盖规范操作与货物装卸流程培训，减少胶条受到不必要的摩擦。 Preventive Measure: 1.Implement a monthly routine inspection schedule for all hatch cover rubber packing and carry out checking for wear &grooving &damage in regular. 2.Checking compression set ,wear levels, and fastening condition, replacing any packing rubbers that show signs of aging or excessive wear proactively. 3.Provide training to crew members on proper hatch cover operation and cargo handling procedure to minimize unnecessary friction and impact on rubber packing. 50 描述： 机舱车间台钻与砂轮机未安装急停装置，且台钻未配备安全防护挡板。 Description: The Standing drill and grinding machine were not fitted with an emergency stop installation, also Standing drill was not provided with protective guards in the engine room workshop. 根本原因： 安全意识不足。 Root Cause: There is insufficient awareness of safety . 产生的风险： 缺少防护及急停装置，操作时易发生机械卷入、割伤事故，存在人身伤害隐患。 Risk existed： Absence of guards and emergency stops may lead to mechanical entanglement and operator injuries. 关闭要求: 1.为车床制作并加装紧急停止装置与安全防护罩。 2.相关人员学习车床相关操作知识，加深对规范操作方式的掌握。 Closing Requirements: 1.Making & fitting fitted with an emergency stop installation and protective guard for the lathe. 2.Relevant personnel shall review and study the lathe knowledge to enhance their understanding of the correct operation method. 预防措施: 1.加强船员培训，使其充分了解安全防护罩的作用。 2.定期测试紧急停止装置并检查防护罩，若出现损坏及时更换。 Preventive Measure: 1.Strengthen crews training about the protective function that the protective guard can play. 2.Regularly test the emergency stop installation and check protective guard, if it is damaged, replace it in a timely manner. 51 描述： 肉库、鱼库制冷蒸发器出口管路结霜结冰。 Description: Ice accumulation was observed on the Evaporator outlet line in the meat room and fish room. 根本原因： 船员未执行定期检查，也未按要求做好规范保养。 Root Cause: Crew are not carried out interval inspection and make a proper maintenance. 产生的风险： 管路结冰阻碍制冷循环，库温失控易导致生鲜货物变质。 Risk existed： Ice blocks refrigeration circulation, out of control temperature spoils frozen provisions. 关闭要求: 及时清除积冰，并开展定期检查。 Closing Requirements: Defrost ice and checked regularly. 预防措施: 1.培训船员掌握除冰操作方法。 2.由值班轮机员检查肉库温度与结冰状况。 Preventive Measure: 1.Trained on the way to defrost ice. 2.Inspect the meat room temperature and ice condition by duty engineer. 52 描述： 没有客观证据表明，除船长和大副外，所有负责货物操作的驾驶员和普通船员均已接受 过关于载运固体散装危险及有害物质的正式操作培训。 Description: There was no objective evidence indicated that all officers and ratings except master and chief officer responsible for cargo handling on ships carrying dangerous and hazardous substances in solid form in bulk had undergone formal training. 根本原因： 该公司已对所有负责在载运散装固体危险有害物质船舶上从事货物装卸作业的高级船员 和普通船员开展了培训，但船上未留存其正式培训证书。 Root Cause: The company have conducted training for all officers and ratings responsible for cargo handling on ships carrying dangerous and hazardous substances in solid form in bulk. While their formal training certificate were not retained on board. 产生的风险： 船员缺乏危险货物作业正规培训，易引发散装固体危险货物装卸安全事故。 Risk existed： Insufficient formal training for seafarers may lead to safety accidents during cargo handling on ships carrying dangerous and hazardous substances in solid form in bulk. 关闭要求: 立即联系公司，要求其将正式培训证书发送至船上 Closing Requirements: Contact company immediately, require their formal training certificate to be send on board. 预防措施: 加强培训，认真研读 RISQ.2.7 条款，防止类似事件再次发生。 Preventive Measure: Strengthen training and carefully study the RISQ.2.7 clause to prevent similar case from happening again. 53 描述： 经批准的货船安全设备记录未予更新，未能反映船上现有引水员梯的相关信息。此外， 无证据表明负责释放和检查引水员梯的人员，已就引水员梯及其使用所涉及的检查要求、 法规和标准接受过定期培训。 Description: Record of Approved Cargo Ship Safety Equipment had not been updated to reflect the information of present pilot ladders on board the ship. - No evidence indicated that personnel responsible for rigging and inspecting pilot ladders had received periodic training in the inspection requirements, regulations and standards associated with pilot ladders and their use. 根本原因：船员缺乏对引航员软梯相关检查要求、法规及标准中，关于引航员软梯装配 与检查职责的认知。 Root Cause: The crew lack of acknowledge of responsible for rigging and inspecting pilot ladders in the inspection requirements, regulations and Standards associated with pilot ladders and their use. 产生的风险： 引水梯信息未更新、相关人员缺少定期专项培训，易造成引水梯配备不合规、引航作业 安全隐患。 Risk existed： Outdated safety equipment records and lack of periodic training for personnel handling pilot ladders will bring hidden safety risks to pilotage operation. 关闭要求: 1. 美国船级社验船师已立即更新《认可货船安全设备记录》，以反映船上现有引航员软 梯的相关信息。 2. 公司已将针对船员的登船前引航员软梯培训内容更新并补充至新的安全管理体系文 件中。 3. 按照安全管理体系年度培训计划的要求，已于 3 月 21 日完成了涵盖引航员软梯操 作、检查与维护的船上常规培训。 Closing Requirements: 1.Record of Approved Cargo Ship Safety Equipment had been updated immediately by ABS surveyor to reflect the information of present pilot ladders on board the Ship. 2.The company has updated and supplemented the pre-boarding pilot ladder training for seafarers into new SMS forms. 3.The regular onboard training on pilot ladders covering operation, inspection and maintenance was completed on 21-March as required by the annual training matrix of the SMS. 预防措施: 1. 及时更新已核准的货船安全设备记录； 2. 按照公司培训计划，加强对负责引水梯装配与检查人员的培训。 3. 登船前引航员软梯培训将按照新表格开展。此类每季度一次的船上培训今后将持续进 行。 Preventive Measure: 1. Update Record of Approved Cargo Ship Safety Equipment Timely; 2. In accordance with the company's training plan, strengthen the training for personnel responsible for the rigging and inspection of pilot ladders. 3. The pre-boarding pilot ladder training will be implemented in accordance with the new forms. Such quarterly onboard training will be carried out continuously in the future. 54 描述： 货舱污水井止回阀检修工作未纳入船舶计划维护保养系统中。 Description: Overhaul of cargo hold bilge non-return valves was not included in the planned maintenance system. 根本原因：轮机员在编制维护保养系统时，未能全面核查所有船舶重要管路设备，且货 舱舱底水止回阀的维护项目被遗漏，未在船上进行记录。 Root Cause: The engineer failed to fully verify all marine essential piping equipment when compiling the planned maintenance system, and maintenance items for cargo hold bilge non-return valves were omitted without being recorded onboard. 产生的风险： 货舱污水井止回阀未列入维保计划，存在污水倒灌风险。 Risk existed： Failure to include overhaul of cargo hold bilge non-return valves in PMS risks bilge water backflow. 关闭要求: 立即联系岸基管理部门，增设所有货舱舱底水止回阀的检修项目，并将止回阀 上次检修日期更新至船舶预防性维修系统（PMS）。（货舱舱底水止回阀上次检修日期： 2026 年 1 月 20 日） Closing Requirements: Immediately contact shore management department, add overhaul items of all cargo hold bilge non-return valves and update last non-return overhaul date into PMS.( cargo hold bilge non-return valve last overhaul date:20-JAN-2026) 预防措施: 对船员开展培训，强化计划保养体系的执行流程，认真学习安全管理体系的相 关条款，安排轮机管理人员定期对所有船舶设备维保项目进行全面盘点，杜绝同类疏漏 问题再次发生。 Preventive Measure: Training the crew Strengthen the procedure of planned maintenance system, carefully study relevant clauses of SMS, arrange engineering officers to conduct comprehensive inventory of all ship equipment maintenance items regularly to prevent similar omissions from recurring. 55 描述： 在 2026 年 1 月 31 日船厂安装一台开式脱硫塔。然而，没有证据表明该脱硫塔的维护保 养已在 PMS 中定期记录。 Description: An open loop type Exhaust Gas Cleaning System (scrubber system) was installed at shipyard on 31 Jan 2026. However no evidence indicated that maintenance of exhaust gas cleaning system was recorded periodically in the PMS. 根本原因： 脱硫塔安装完成后，船员未及时更新船舶维修保养体系（PMS），即便船舶废气清洗系 统（EGCS）的常规保养项目已录入船舶维修保养体系数据库，监管人员也未能监控并跟 踪新安装设备的维护保养工作是否在该体系中正常开展。 Root Cause: After scrubber installation finished, crew did not update PMS in time, even regular maintenance items for EGCS were added into PMS system database, but the Supervisory personnel failed to monitor and track whether the maintenance and upkeep of newly installed equipment were functioning in PMS properly. 产生的风险： 设备故障无法提前管控，存在废气排放超标风险。 Risk existed： May lead to equipment breakdown and excessive exhaust emission. 关闭要求: 立即联系岸上技术部门，确保废气清洗系统（EGCS）所有计划保养项目均在 计划保养系统（PMS）中正常执行，并补全船上此前已完成的所有保养记录。 Closing Requirements: Contact shore technical department at once, make sure all scheduled maintenance items of EGCS correct running in PMS, and filled back all previous maintenance records done onboard 预防措施: 开展船舶维修保养体系专项培训，全面核查并校验计算机化船舶维修保养体系 中的所有设备，认真研读《国际防止船舶造成污染公约》相关规定及公司维护保养规程， 杜绝同类缺陷重复出现。 Preventive Measure: Conduct specialized training on PMS, Fully check and verify all equipment in in the computerized PMS, carefully study MARPOL regulations and company maintenance procedures to avoid similar deficiencies repeating. 56 描述： 船上未配备厂家规定的、适用于该类型舱盖安全运行及计划性、故障维修所需的最新最 低推荐备件清单。 Description: An up-to-date list of the minimum recommended spare parts for the safe operation and to support both planned and corrective maintenance of type of hatch cover, as specified by the manufacturer was not available on board. 根本原因：工作中存在疏忽，对舱盖备件的重要性认识不足，未能及时检查各类备件的 数量并更新库存清单。 Root Cause: Negligence at work, insufficient understanding of the importance of hatch cover spare parts, failure to promptly inspect the quantity of each spare part and update the inventory list in a timely manner. 产生的风险： 缺少舱盖原厂最新必备备件清单，维保抢修无参考依据，影响舱盖安全使用。 Risk existed： Absence of manufacturer’s latest recommended spare parts list for hatch covers hinders maintenance and endangers hatch cover safety. 关闭要求: 依据舱口图纸及说明书要求，编制舱口备件清单，按照清单所列项目及时向厂 家申领所需备件，并妥善管理，确保备件随时可用。 Closing Requirements: on the hatch drawings and instruction manual requirements, prepare a list of hatch spare parts, promptly request the required spares from the manufacturer according to the list items, and properly manage them to ensure they are always readily available. 预防措施: 对船员开展培训以提升其安全意识，使其认识到舱口盖备件对开启与关闭作业的重要性。 制定定期检查管理表，确保舱口盖备件的数量充足、质量合格，并保证其在需要时随时 可用。按流程申领备件并妥善管理，确保备件始终处于待命可用状态。 Preventive Measure: Training the crew to enhance their awareness, making them realize the significance of the hatch cover spare parts for the opening and closing operations. Prepare a regular inspection management table to ensure the quantity and quality of the hatch cover spare parts, and make sure they are always available when needed. Apply for spare parts and manage them properly to ensure they are always ready for use. 57 描述： 船上所有在用系泊缆绳均未加装防磨护具。 Description: All mooring ropes in use onboard were not covered with chafe protections. 根本原因：船员对系缆防护的认知不足，在系缆管理方面的学习也不到位。他们未能认 识到系缆防护对系泊安全的重要性，对检查表问卷未做好充分准备，并且未按照检查要 求开展作业。 Root Cause: The crew had insufficient awareness of mooring line protection and inadequate learning in mooring line management. They failed to recognize the importance of mooring line protection for mooring safety and did not prepare adequately for the checklist questionnaire. They also did not operate in accordance with the inspection requirements. 产生的风险： 系泊缆无防磨保护，易磨损断裂引发系泊安全事故。 Risk existed： All mooring ropes in use onboard were not covered with chafe protections. 关闭要求: Closing Requirements: Install protective covers on all 16 in-use mooring lines on the ship. 预防措施: 增强系缆防护意识，定期开展培训，学习船舶系缆管理方案，并根据船上系缆 防护套的状况及时申领新的系缆防护套。 Preventive Measure: Enhance the awareness of mooring line protection, conduct regular training, study the ship mooring line management plan and promptly apply for new mooring line protection covers based on the condition of the mooring line protection covers on board. 58 描述： 机舱工作间固定式钻机未按船上安全作业守则第 20.3 条要求设置紧急停止装置。 Description: The fixed drill machine in the engine room workshop was not provided with a means of emergency stop as required by COSWP Regulation 20.3. 根本原因：工作人员对《商船良好工作做法》中规定的车间设备相关安全规章缺乏足够 了解，未对安全防护装置开展定期检查，且忽视了紧急停止功能的重要性。 Root Cause: Crew members lack sufficient understanding safety regulations regarding the workshop equipment specified in the COSWP, fail to conduct regular inspections on safety protection devices, and disregard the importance of emergency stop functions. 产生的风险： 机舱钻机缺少急停装置，误操作时无法快速停机，易引发机械伤人事故。 Risk existed： Lack of emergency stop device for engine room drill may cause mechanical injury accidents. 关闭要求: 立即联系船舶管理公司采购部门，为船舶提供合格的应急停止装置。安装完成 后，已进行全面功能测试并确认该装置运行正常。 Closing Requirements: Immediately contact ship management office procurement department to supply qualified emergency stop device to vessel. Upon completion of installation, full function test was carried out and confirmed the device operates properly. 预防措施: 对相关工作人员开展培训，强化所有车间机械设备的每周巡检计划，深入学习 《商船良好工作做法》第 20.3 条，消除安全隐患。 Preventive Measure: Trained related crew and strengthen weekly inspection schedule for all workshop machinery, thoroughly study COSWP Regulation 20.3, and eliminate potential safety hazards. 59 描述： 焚烧炉废油泵电机损坏且已被拆解。 Description: Incinerator was found with waste oil pump motor defective and dismantled. 根本原因：废油泵电机内部绕组因绝缘老化发生意外烧毁，导致电机在运行过程中突然 故障。 Root Cause: The internal winding of waste oil pump motor suffered unexpected burnout caused by aging insulation, resulting in sudden motor breakdown during operation. 产生的风险： 焚烧炉废油泵电机故障拆解，无法正常处理污油，存在油污处置违规风险。 Risk existed： Defective and dismantled waste oil pump motor renders incinerator unusable and causes illegal oily waste disposal risks. 关闭要求: 立即联系公司，更换本港船上供应的合格废油泵电机，替换故障电机，并开展 焚烧炉运行测试，使其恢复正常运行。 Closing Requirements: Contact company immediately, the qualified waste oil pump electric motor supplied on board at current port, replaced defective electric motor, and carried out incinerator running test to restore normal operation. 预防措施: 这台旧电机已送至岸上服务商处进行线圈重绕，现已修复完毕并作为备用机组 留存。 Preventive Measure: The old motor has been sent to the shore service provider for coil rewinding. It has been repaired and kept as a spare unit. 60 描述：主配电板上的 220V 馈电板绝缘电阻读数偏低，测得值为 0.7 兆欧。 Description: Main switchboard was found with 220V feeder panel low insulation resistance with reading of 0.7MOhm. 根本原因：责任人员未按要求对 220 伏馈电线的绝缘状况开展定期检查，而此类检查本 应能发现灯具底座密封不严的问题。该缺陷是在右舷外侧的一盏室外照明灯具上被发现 的。 Root Cause: Responsible officer failed to conduct regular inspections of the insulation condition of the 220V feeder as required, which would have revealed inadequate sealing at the base of a light fitting. The defect was found on an exterior lighting fixture outside the starboard. 产生的风险：可能导致漏电短路，引发触电及电气火灾。 Risk existed： May cause electric leakage, short circuit, electric shock and electrical fire. 关闭要求: 查明故障原因，清除灯具内部潮气，加强灯座密封，并反复测量绝缘电阻，直 至其恢复至正常水平。 Closing Requirements: Identify the fault cause, removed moisture inside the lamp, reinforced the seal of the lamp base, and measured the insulation resistance repeatedly until it returns to normal level. 预防措施: 对船员进行专项培训，仔细审查安全管理体系（SMS）规定，加强电气设备的 维护，并定期检查和加强室外电缆的密封性能，以避免再次发生类似的违规情况。 Preventive Measure: Carry out special training for crew, carefully review SMS regulations, Strengthen the maintenance of electrical equipment, and regularly inspect and reinforce the sealing performance of outdoor electric cables to avoid similar non-compliance again. 61 描述： 船舶最近一次船对船作业于 2026 年 5 月 7 日在几内亚卡姆萨港完成，无证据表明本 次作业组织者或现场主管填写完成船对船作业检查表。 Description: Last STS operation was completed on 07 May 2026 at Kamsar, Guinea, however no evidence indicated that STS Questionnaire had been completed by either the STS Organiser or the STS Unit Manager 根本原因：该船船员对 RISQ.17.11 的了解不足，未能按照 RISQ 中规定的要求进行 STS 作业。 Root Cause: The crew members of the ship lacked sufficient knowledge of RISQ.17.11 and failed to conduct the STS operations in accordance with the requirements specified in RISQ. 产生的风险： 未填船对船作业专项检查表，存在货物撒漏、缆绳断裂、船体碰撞与港口检查缺陷风险 Risk existed： Incomplete STS questionnaire for transfer operation, resulting in cargo spillage、mooring line breakage、vessel collision and detention during port inspection. 关闭要求: 加强培训，并仔细研读 RISQ.17.11 条款，以防止类似情况再次发生。 Closing Requirements: Strengthen training and carefully study the RISQ.17.11 clause to prevent similar case from happening again. 预防措施: 定期对船员进行培训，在每次 STS 作业前开展培训，以确保船舶为 STS 作业 做好充分准备；由 STS 组织者或 STS 单位经理填写 STS 问卷。 Preventive Measure: Carry out regular training for the crew, conduct training before each STS operation to ensure that the ship is well-prepared for STS operation, Complete STS Questionnaire by either the STS Organizer or the STS Unit Manager. 第二部分：数据分析 Part II – Data analysis 2026 年第二季度有 8 艘船舶经历了 RIGHTSHIP 检查，共开具了 61 条缺陷。所涉及的方面如下： Four vessels underwent RIGHTSHIP inspections in the second quarter of 2026 and a total of 61 deficiencies were issued. If electrical maintenance or power outage operations are carried out simultaneously with hot work or enclosed space operations, corresponding work permits shall be issued at the same time, energy isolation (LOTO) measures shall be strictly implemented, and complete records of the entire approval and operation process shall be retained. 3. 规范航海及 ECDIS 标准化管控 Standardize navigation and ECDIS management 遵照《SHIP-05-01 船舶航行制度与航次计划程序》统一船队 ECDIS 航线命名、标识规范；明确 UKC 富余水深分段计算标准，航次变更、锚泊调整需同步更新纸质航次计划与电子航线，完整标注安全等深 线、中止线、应急锚地等关键界线。 Follow SHIP-05-01 Navigation Regulation and Voyage Plan Procedure to unify vessel-wide standards for ECDIS route naming and marking; clarify graded UKC calculation criteria. Any voyage alteration or anchorage adjustment requires simultaneous update of paper passage plan and ECDIS tracks, with full marking of safety contour, abort line, contingency anchorage and other critical boundaries. 4. 分层开展专项船员实操培训 Carry out tiered practical training for seafarers 依据《PRO-14 船员培训控制程序》，针对 RightShip 高频缺陷分甲板、机舱、驾驶岗位开展专项实操 培训：舱盖维保、LOTO 能源隔离、ECDIS 规范操作、MARPOL 防污染、引航梯检验管理；同步补齐 固体散装危险货物、设备备件台账管理相关培训并留存考核记录。 In line with PRO-14 Crew Training Control Procedure, deliver targeted practical training for deck, engine and navigation officers based on recurrent RightShip deficiencies, covering hatch cover maintenance, LOTO energy isolation, standardized ECDIS operation, MARPOL pollution prevention and pilot ladder inspection. Complete supplementary training on solid bulk dangerous goods and spare parts ledger management with assessment records filed. 5. 搭建岸船一体化闭环监督体系 Establish closed-loop shore-vessel supervision system 依托《PRO-10 船舶检查、监督程序》建立长效管控：海务 / 机务定期登轮检查；固化“缺陷整改→体 系文件修订→全员培训宣贯→登轮复核验证”全流程闭环管理机制。 Rely on the PRO-10 Ship Inspection and Supervision Procedures to establish a long-term control mechanism: regular on-board inspections by marine and technical superintendents; consolidate the whole-process closed-loop management mechanism of " rectification of defects → revision of system documents → training and publicity for all personnel → on-board review and verification".

defect.desc: 2026 年第一季度 Rightship 检查数据统计分析报告 Statistical analysis report of Rightship inspection defect data in the firstquarter-2026 第一部分: 第一季度 Rightship 检查缺陷数据统计 Part I：Statistics of Rightship inspection defect data in the first quarter. 1 描述：压载水处理系统（BWTS）单元安装在机舱 3 甲板右舷侧，该位置所在的空间是一个独立的封 闭舱室，四周有边界并设有两扇门。但这个舱室并未在封闭空间登记表中被认定为封闭空间。 Description: The ballast water treatment system (BWTS)unit was installed at engine room 3rd deck starboard side, in which space was an independent enclosed compartment surrounding with boundaries and two doors. This compartment was not identified as an enclosed space in the enclosed space register. 根本原因：压载水处理系统（BWTS）的安装空间以前是机舱备件室，但在该空间安装压载水处理系统 （BWTS）后，门仍然留在那里，这会导致有毒气体积聚的风险。 Root Cause: The ballast water treatment system(BWTS) installing space is E/R spare parts room before, but after installing ballast water treatment system(BWTS) in the space ，the door is still remained there, which cause toxic gas accumulation risk. 产生的风险：船员未采取密闭舱室的进入程序进入，极易发生缺氧、中毒、窒息死亡事故。 Risk existed: If crew members enter enclosed compartments without following the entry procedures, they are highly prone to accidents such as oxygen deficiency, poisoning, suffocation, and even death. 关闭要求: 拆卸并移除该空间的门。 Closing Requirements: Dismantle and remove the door for the space. 预防措施:保持空间处于开放状态，以便空气能够流通。 Preventive Measure: Keep space under door removed condition, so the air can circulate for the space. 2 描述：舵机舱的化学品柜中存放着两罐用于重型污水处理系统清洁剂的化学品（产品名称：GAMAZYME 700），但没有关于此类化学品处理的材料安全数据表（MSDS）。 Description: There were two cans of chemical for heavy duty sewage system cleaner (product name: GAMAZYME 700) stowed in chemical locker at the steering gear compartment, the MSDS for handling such chemical was not available . 根本原因：重型污水处理系统清洁剂的化学品已于近日收到。但材料安全数据表（MSDS）副本未能及 时提供。 Root Cause: The chemical for heavy duty sewage system cleaner was received recently. The MSDS copy was not be supply in time. 产生的风险：船员无法及时获取该化学品的安全注意事项与应急消除措施。 Risk existed: The crew could not promptly obtain the safety precautions and emergency elimination measures for this chemical. 关闭要求: 打印该化学品的材料安全数据表，并将其放在货架附近。 Closing Requirements: Print the MSDS of the chemical and keep it near the store shelf. 预防措施:船员应通过培训提高化学品安全意识。收到新化学品后，立即更新化学品安全技术说明书 （MSDS）。 Preventive Measure: The crew should enhance the safety awareness of chemical by training. After receiving new chemical, update the MSDS immediately. 3 描述： 右舷的舷梯没有搭到码头上，而是用钢索悬挂着，并且在舷梯的下部平台上安装了一个短跳板。 Description: Starboard side accommodation ladder was not landed on the wharf, it was rigging by wire falls, and a short brow was fitted to the lower platform of accommodation ladder. 根本原因：由于岸边起重机的导轨限制，码头上右舷侧舷梯的停靠空间有限。 Root Cause: There are limited space for landing starboard side accommodation ladder On the wharf due to the guide rail of the shore crane. 产生的风险：极易造成上下人员踏空、滑倒、坠落入海。 Risk existed: May cause personnel to slip, trip and fall overboard. 关闭要求: 我们对在舷梯下层平台安装跳板进行了风险评估。 Closing Requirements: We made the risk assessment for fitting the short brow on the lower plat form of the accommodation ladder. 预防措施:为了人员在攀爬舷梯时的安全，我们需要将舷梯架设到码头上。 Preventive Measure: We need land the accommodation ladder to the wharf for personnel’s safety when climbing on the accommodation ladder. 4 描述：自 2023 年 10 月 23 日船舶被接管以来，船舶在海上航行时无人机舱（UMS）模式的启动和停 止时间未记录在轮机日志中。机舱一直以无人机舱（UMS）模式运行。 Description: The start and stop times of UMS mode when ship was at sea passage were not recorded in the engine log book since the vessel was taken over on 23/Oct/2023. Engine room was being operated in UMS mode. 根本原因：船员不熟悉最新的要求。 Root Cause: Crew is not familiar with the newest request. 产生的风险：无法追溯机舱运行状态，不符合法规及体系记录要求。 Risk existed: It is impossible to trace the operating status of the engine room, which does not meet the regulatory and system record requirements. 关闭要求: 每天在轮机日志中记录 UMS 的启动和停止时间。 Closing Requirements: - Record the UMS start and stop time in the engine/official log book everyday . 预防措施:开展了关于记录 UMS 内容的培训流程 Preventive Measure: Training procedure about recording content of UMS carried out 5 描述：从机舱二层甲板通往舵机室的逃生门与周围白色的舱壁一样被漆成了白色，在机舱充满烟雾的情 况下，该逃生门无法清晰辨认。 Description: The escape door leading from engine room 2nd deck to steering gear compartment were painted with white colour against the surrounding white bulkhead, not clearly indicated in the event of the engine room being filled with smoke. 根本原因：船员的安全意识薄弱。 Root Cause: Crew ‘s safety awareness is weak. 产生的风险：烟雾环境下无法快速识别逃生门，延误逃生。 Risk existed: In a smoky environment, it is impossible to quickly identify the emergency exit, which delays escape. 关闭要求: 在安全出口门框周围粘贴清晰标识。 Closing Requirements: Paste clearly indicated mark surrounding the escape door’s door case. 预防措施:通过培训提高船员的安全意识，让船员了解紧急情况下逃生门标识的重要性。 Preventive Measure: Enhance the crew’s safety awareness by training, make crew to understand the importance of the escape door’s mark for emergency situationusing . 6 描述：2026 年 2 月 2 日签发了检查艏尖舱的进入封闭处所检查表和许可证和 2026 年 3 月 6 日签发了主 机扫气箱的进入封闭处所检查表和许可证。然而，无证据表明压载泵及其相关液压系统、主机相关管路 系统和电气系统已通过锁闭挂牌程序实现隔离。 Description: Enclosed space permits were issued on 2/Feb/2026 for FPT inspection and on 6/Mar/2026 for M/E scavenge air box inspection. However, there was no evidence that the ballast pumps and associated hydraulic systems, and M/E related pipeline and electrical systems had been isolated using Lock-out/Tag-out (LOTO) procedures. 根本原因： 1.船员在封闭空间作业时未严格遵守上锁挂牌（LOTO）程序。 2.作业许可证及上锁挂牌执行过程的监管不足。 3.船员缺乏针对关键系统的上锁挂牌应用培训。 Root Cause: 1. Crew failed to strictly follow LOTO procedures for enclosed space operations. 2. Insufficient supervision of work permit and LOTO execution. 3. Lack of LOTO application training for crew on critical systems. 产生的风险：人员在检查和保养过程中造成工伤事故。 Risk existed: Work-related injuries occurred to personnel during the inspection and maintenance process. 关闭要求: 1.遵循上锁挂牌（LOTO）检查清单。 2.加强监督管理。 3.在每日班前会上重点强调。 Closing Requirements: 1. Follow the LOTO (Lock-out/Tag-out)checklist. 2.Strengthen supervision. 3. Emphasized at toolbox meeting every day. 预防措施: 对全体船员加强上锁挂牌（LOTO）培训。 Preventive Measure: Strengthen training for all crew members about LOTO (Lock-out/Tag-out). 7 描述：无证据表明，船舶的《国际海运固体散货规则》/《固体散货安全操作规则》船岸安全检查表中， 包含涉及应急程序的装卸工人熟悉环节，也无证据表明每班次至少对货舱进入程序的合规性进行过一次 核实。 Description: There was no evidence that the ship's IMSBC/BLU code ship/shore safety checklist include a stevedore familiarisation section with emergency procedures and verify compliance with cargo hold entry procedures at least once every watch. 根本原因：船岸安全程序的相关要求落实不到位。 Root Cause: Insufficient implementation of the requirements for ship-shore safety procedures. 产生的风险：应急处置能力不足，易引发伤亡事故；流程失控，扩大事故影响范围。 Risk existed: Insufficient emergency response capabilities are likely to cause casualties; loss of process control will expand the scope of accident impacts. 关闭要求: 1.立即修订检查清单，增加码头工人熟悉应急程序的章节。 2.所有值班班次每小时核查货舱进入程序。 3.与码头工人开展联合安全简报会，并讲解应急程序。 Closing Requirements: 1. Revise the checklist immediately, add stevedore familiarization section with emergency procedures. 2. Verify cargo hold entry procedures hourly for all watch shifts. 3. Conduct joint safety briefing with stevedores and emergency procedures. 预防措施: 1.审查并更新所有与《国际海运固体散装货物规则》（IMSBC）/《散装液体货物手册》（BLU）相关的 检查清单。 2.召开装货前船岸联合安全会议，审查检查清单的合规情况及码头工人培训状况。 3.培训并监督值班船员，使其在港口货物作业期间按要求正确执行船岸安全程序。 Preventive Measure: 1. Review and update all IMSBC/BLU related checklists. 2.Hold a pre-loading joint ship-shore safety meeting to review checklist compliance and stevedore training status. 3.Train and supervise the duty crew to properly carry out ship-shore safety procedure as required during cargo operations in port. 8 描述：船舶中桅房内的电焊机的回路线被固定在船体结构上。 Description: The welding machines' return lines in the mid-ship store was observed to be secured to the ship's structure. 根本原因：船员不熟悉焊机回路线的正确要求与操作。 Root Cause: Crew are unfamiliar with the correct requirements and operation of welding machine return lines. 产生的风险：线路因船舶摇晃、振动而松动，易造成短路、漏电或线路磨损引发火灾等风险。 Risk existed: Loosening of wires caused by the ship's rolling and vibration is likely to lead to risks such as short circuits, electric leakage, or fires triggered by wire abrasion. 关闭要求: 1.对负责焊接作业的船员开展现场操作培训。 2.增设回路电缆，确保焊接作业时回路线靠近焊接现场，并缩短回路电流距离。 Closing Requirements: 1. Conduct on-site operational training for crew responsible for welding work. 2. Add loop cables to ensure the return line is near the welding site during welding operations and shorten the loop current distance. 预防措施: 1.加强监督管理。 2.组织相关船员开展焊接设备的使用与操作培训。 Preventive Measure: 1.Strengthen supervision. 2. Organize training for related crew on the use and operation of welding equipment. 9 描述：船舶配备了呼吸装置空气再充注系统。然而，船上可再充注的自给式正压呼吸器及紧急逃生呼吸 装置气瓶的工作压力分别为 300 巴和 200 巴，但呼吸装置压缩机上安装的安全泄压阀，其工作压力为 350 巴。 Description: The vessel equipped with a breathing apparatus air recharging system. Ship's rechargeable SCBA and EEBD bottles working pressure are 300 bar and 200 bar, however, the safety relief valve fitted on BA compressor working pressure is 350 bar. 根本原因： 1.呼吸器（BA）压缩机安全泄压阀在安装 / 维修期间设定压力校准错误。 2.未对所有呼吸器系统组件进行定期压力校验。 Root Cause: 1. Incorrect calibration of BA compressor safety relief valve set pressure during installation/maintenance. 2. No regular pressure verification of all BA system components. 产生的风险：压缩机泄压阀（350 巴）压力高于 SCBA（300 巴）、EEBD（200 巴）气瓶额定值，易 因操作失误致气瓶超压损坏或爆裂；误充 EEBD 会损其组件，还可能掩盖系统故障，影响应急使用。 Risk existed: The BA compressor's relief valve (350 bar) has higher pressure than SCBA (300 bar) and EEBD (200 bar) cylinders. It may cause cylinder overpressure damage/burst due to misoperation, damage EEBD components if misfilled, and hide system faults, affecting emergency use. 关闭要求: 申请紧急逃生呼吸装置（EEBD）气瓶充气时的安全泄压阀，订单清单附后。 Closing Requirements: safety relief valve application carried out for EEBD bottle recharging. Order list is attached hereunder. 预防措施: 1.对自给式呼吸器（SCBA）及应急逃生呼吸装置（EEBD）气瓶进行充气时，每次均确保使用合适的安 全泄压阀。 2.对呼吸器充气系统及其附件进行定期检查与维护。 Preventive Measure: 1.When recharge SCBA & EEBD bottles, ensure the appropriate safety relief valve is used each time. 2.Regular inspection and maintenance shall be conducted on breathing apparatus air recharging system and its accessories. 10 描述：正在使用的舷梯，其上部约 4 米长的区域未设置安全网防护。 Description: The upper section of the in using accommodation ladder approximately 4 meters was not covered by safety net. 根本原因： 1.船舶登船设备的安全使用存在违规情况，船员对登船安全要求的认知不足。 2.未及时检查舷梯安全网的覆盖状况。 Root Cause: 1. Non-compliance in the safe use of ship’s embarkation equipment. Insufficient crew awareness of ship boarding safety requirements. 2. No in timely inspection of accommodation ladder safety net coverage. 产生的风险：舷梯上部未设安全网，易导致人员在上下船时因船舶摇晃、脚步不稳而从高处坠落，尤其 在风浪天气下风险显著升高。 Risk existed: The absence of a safety net on the upper section of the accommodation ladder may easily lead to personnel falling from height when boarding or disembarking the ship due to the ship's rolling or unsteady footsteps, with the risk increasing significantly especially in rough weather. 关闭要求: 安装合适的舷梯安全网，从船舷延伸至码头 / 岸壁并牢固固定。确保船舷与舷梯之间的所有 间隙完全封闭。 Closing Requirements: Install a suitable gangway safety net extending from the ship’s side to the dock/quay wall and securely fastened. Ensure all gaps between the ship’s side and the gangway are fully enclosed. 预防措施: 1.对船员进行船舷通行设备使用前、使用中及使用后的相关知识与注意事项培训。 2.确保所有通行设备状态良好，并定期进行检查。 3.确保所有通行设备按照规定安全、正确地使用。 Preventive Measure: 1. Provide training to the crew on the knowledge and precautions before, during, and after the use of shipboard access equipment. 2. Ensure all access equipment is in good condition and inspected regularly. 3. Ensure all access equipment is used safely, correctly and in accordance with regulations. 11 描述：船舶在生活区前部设有高硫油与低硫油共用管路，但管路冲洗量及冲洗程序未纳入操作员综合安 全管理体系或船上文件中，且无相关风险评估；燃油取样程序及受保护储存（情况）尚未确认。 Description: Vessel was provided with common line for HSFO and LSFO forward of the accommodation, but line flushing volume and procedure were not included in operator's integrated SMS or onboard, no RA available for same; bunker sampling procedure and sheltered storage not confirmed (V). 根本原因： 1.安 全管理体系（SMS）/ 加油计划过时，未更新共用管路的相关细节。 2.燃油共用管路的冲洗与取样无标准程序。 3.缺少与加油作业相关的风险评估（RA）文件。 Root Cause: 1. Outdated SMS/bunkering plan, no updated details of common line. 2. No standard procedures for flushing and sampling of common fuel lines. 3. Missing RA documents related to bunkering operations. 1. 产生的风险：共用管路无冲洗要求，易残留重油杂质污染轻油，致设备故障；无风险评估，难预判管路 混用隐患，事故应对无据；取样与储存未确认，燃油质量难把控，且可能因储存不当引发泄漏、火灾。 1. Risk existed: Without pipeline flushing requirements for the common line, residual HFO impurities may contaminate LSFO and cause equipment failure; No RA means pipeline mixing hazards cannot be predicted, leaving no basis for accident response; Unconfirmed bunkering sampling and storage make fuel quality uncontrollable, and improper storage may cause leakage or fire. 关闭要求: 1.制定重油（HFO）加油管路冲洗程序。 2.开展重油加油管路冲洗程序的培训。 Closing Requirements: 1. Formulate HFO bunker line flushing procedure. 2. HFO bunker line flushing procedure training carried out. 预防措施: 加油作业前，对相关船员开展重油（HFO）加油管路冲洗程序培训。 Preventive Measure: HFO bunker line flushing procedure training carried out for related crews before bunkering. 12 描述：在操作测试过程中，燃油速闭阀未能有效关闭。触发（速闭阀）后，燃油供给压力维持在 0.55 兆 帕（MPa）；过滤器排出约 0.5 升燃油后，压力仍未变化。该问题已在检查期间整改完毕。 Description: During the operational test, the fuel-oil quick-closing valve failed to close effectively. Upon actuation, fuel supply pressure maintained 0.55 MPa; after ~0.5 litre oil drained from filter, pressure unchanged. Rectified during inspection. 根本原因：3 号发电机回油阀在测试过程中发生卡滞。 Root Cause: The return valve of NO.3 generator engine stuck during testing. 1. 产生的风险：紧急时无法切断燃油供给，若遇火灾，燃油持续输送会加剧火势；压力未降表明燃油仍泄 漏，可能引发管路喷油、环境污染，甚至爆炸风险。 1. Risk existed: Failure to cut off fuel supply in emergencies: if a fire occurs, continuous fuel delivery will intensify the fire; Unchanged pressure indicates ongoing fuel leakage, which may cause pipeline oil spray, environmental pollution, or even explosion risks. 关闭要求:
