Ensure alarm printer in normal condition. 2. Strengthen duty engineer’s supervision when taken over the watch. 17 描述：机舱围壁内 4 号机舱风机防火挡板在测试时无法完全关闭，与水平位置约有 5° 间隙。 经多次测试，系统气动执行机构的动作状况仍未改善。 该问题已在检查期间整改。 Description: The fire damper for Engine Room No.4 fan located in the engine room casing did not close completely when tested, around 5 degrees gap to the horizontal level. Repeated tests did not improve the performance of the pneumatic actuator used in the system. Rectified during inspection. 根本原因：内部防火网的固定铆钉脱落，导致防火网出现松脱。 Root Cause: due to the detachment of the internal fire proof net's fixed rivets, the fireproof net became loose. 产生的风险：防火挡板关闭不严，火灾时无法有效阻隔烟火蔓延，导致烟火窜入其他舱室，降低船舶防 火分隔效果，扩大事故风险。 Risk existed: Fire damper not fully closed fails to stop spread of fire and smoke effectively, reducing fire compartmentation effect and increasing accident risk. 关闭要求: 内部防火网已采用铆钉固定牢固。 Closing Requirements: Internal fire proof net's fixed with rivets. 预防措施: 加强监督、检查与测试工作。 Preventive Measure: Strengthen supervision, inspection and test. 18 描述：机舱前底舱压载水泵上方的热水管，有约 5 米长的保温层缺失 / 脱落。该问题已在检查期间整 改。 Description: A section of lagging approximately 5 meters on the hot water line located above ballast pumps in engine room bottom deck forward. Rectified during inspection. 根本原因：未按规定对机舱难触及区域的隔热层状态开展定期检查。 Root Cause: No regular inspection of lagging status in hard-to-reach areas of engine room. 产生的风险：热水管保温层缺失，易造成人员烫伤、热量损耗，同时可能产生冷凝水，影响机舱设备安 全与工作环境。 Risk existed: Missing lagging on hot water line may cause scalding, heat loss and condensed water, endangering equipment safety and working environment in engine room. 关闭要求: 确认隔热层的整改（更换）效果，检查热水管路，排查其泄漏 / 破损情况。 Closing Requirements: Confirm the rectification (replacement) effect of lagging, inspect hot water line to identify leakage/damage. 预防措施: 1.将机舱难触及区域隔热层的每周目视检查工作，纳入轮机部日常工作范畴。 2.每季度对机舱所有隔热层开展全面检查，排查是否存在油污浸渍、破损、泄漏情况。 3.船上应配备足量的隔热层备用材料，以便对出现油污浸渍、破损的部件进行即时更换。 Preventive Measure: 1. Incorporate weekly visual inspection of lagging in hard-to-reach areas of engine room into the engine department's daily work. 2.Conduct comprehensive inspection of all engine room lagging quarterly to identify oil impregnation/damage/leakage. 3.Keep sufficient spare lagging materials on board for immediate replacement of oil-impregnated/damaged parts. 19 描述：发现 5 号及 9 号货舱附近的两盏货灯灯罩损坏。 Description: Two cargo lights located near hold No.5 & 9 noted with cover damaged. 根本原因： 1.未按规定对货舱便携式及固定式货舱灯的工作状态开展定期检查。 2.货舱灯灯罩玻璃出现破损，未及时予以维修或更换。 3.甲板部的检查清单中，未针对货舱灯的维护工作设置专项检查项。 Root Cause: 1. No regular inspection of portable/fixed cargo hold light status. 2. Glass damage to cargo hold light covers not repaired/replaced in a timely manner. 3. No special inspection for cargo hold light maintenance in the deck department's inspection checklist. 产生的风险：灯罩破损易导致灯具进水、短路，引发触电或火灾风险，同时影响货舱作业照明，降低装 卸作业安全性。 Risk existed: Damaged lamp covers may cause water ingress and short circuits, leading to electric shock or fire risks. It also reduces cargo hold lighting and endangers handling safety. 关闭要求: 1.立即更换 5 号、9 号货舱的货舱灯。 2.对所有货舱灯开展全面检查，排查灯罩、灯泡及电缆存在的各类缺陷。 Closing Requirements: 1. No.5/9 cargo hold lights were renewed immediately. 2. Fully inspect all cargo hold lights to identify defects in covers, bulbs and cable. 预防措施: 1.制定专项检查清单，并定期开展检查与维护工作。 2.加强值班驾驶员的监督核查工作，对损坏的灯具立即予以更换。 Preventive Measure: 1. Make a checklist and inspection and maintenance regularly. 2. Strengthen duty officer’s supervision and renew the damaged light immediately. 20 描述：机舱车间内弧焊机的回路线用螺栓直接接在船体结构上，未配备工件连接夹的规范布设。 rising Description: Returning cable of ARC welding machine in the engine workshop was used to connected to the ship’s structure by the bolt. The arrangement of work piece connection clamp was not provided. 根本原因：不理解相关规定。 Root Cause: Don’t understand this rule. 产生的风险：线路因船舶摇晃、振动而松动，易造成短路、漏电或线路磨损引发火灾等风险。 Risk existed: Loosening of wires caused by the ship's rolling and vibration is likely to lead to risks such as short circuits, electric leakage, or fires triggered by wire abrasion. 关闭要求:修改回线连接以绕过船体，并安装一个直接连接到工件的夹具。 Closing Requirements: Modify the return wire connection to bypass the hull，and install a clamp that attaches directly to the work piece. 预防措施: 维护此回路连接并使用便携式电焊机。 Preventive Measure: Maintain this return wire connection and use portable welding machine. 21 描述：右舷舷梯锁紧螺母的安全销及锁紧螺栓末端螺纹存在锈蚀。 Description: Safe pin of lock nut and the end thread of locking bolt on the starboard side accommodation ladder found rusty. 根本原因：上个月 PMS 例行检查时，大副已发现问题并安排水手长处理。水手长仅完成了左舷舷梯的 除锈和加油工作，但忘记在右舷进行同样操作。大副在分配工作后未能进行后续复查和验证，导致工作 未能闭环管理。 Root Cause: During routine inspection as PMS last month, CO already found this issue and task to Bosun. Bosun only completed the de-rusting and greasing work on the port side accommodation ladder but forgot to perform the same work on S’Side accommodation ladder. CO failed to conduct a follow-up review and verification after assigning the work. leading to no closed-loop management of the task. 产生的风险：锈蚀会导致销栓失效，引发舷梯坍塌、人员受伤。 Risk existed: Rust may cause failure of lock pin/bolt, leading to accommodation ladder collapse, injury. 关闭要求:立即安排水手长完成除锈工作，并在右舷舷梯的锁紧螺栓螺纹末端涂抹足量润滑脂，同时更 换锁紧螺母的新安全销。 Closing Requirements: Immediately arrange the Bosun to complete de-rusting and apply sufficient grease the end thread of locking bolt and replace new safe pin of lock nut on the S’side accommodation ladder. 预防措施: 1. 建立明确的工作分配与确认制度。 2. 加强工作的闭环管理。 Preventive Measure: 1. Establish a clear work assignment and confirmation system. 2. Strengthen the closed-loop management of work. 22 描述：7 号货舱右舷前部用于调整承重的垫铁脱焊与基座结构分离。 Description: The metal shims which used for adjusting the height of bearing pad, located on the forward starboard side of Cargo Hold No.7, was detached from the base structure. 根本原因：金属垫片在初始安装时焊接强度不足，和/或由于长期振动及舱盖冲击导致的疲劳失效。 Root Cause: The metal shims insufficient welding strength during initial installation and/or fatigue failure caused by long-term vibration and hatch cover impact. 产生的风险：垫片脱落导致承座不稳、设备损坏，存在坍塌隐患。 Risk existed: Detached shims cause bearing pad instability, equipment damage, collapse hazard. 关闭要求: 1. 制作新的金属垫片，确保其尺寸与轴承座及底座结构表面完全吻合。 2. 清洁底座结构表面，将新金属垫片牢固焊接于底座结构。 3. 对焊缝进行无损检测和目视检查，确认垫片连接牢固且满足强度要求；进行水密性测试，确保焊接 不影响密封性能。 Closing Requirements: 1. Fabricate new metal shims and dimensions to ensure it fit the bearing pad and base structure surface thoroughly. 2. Clean the base structure surface, then weld the new metal shims firmly to the base structure. 3. Conduct a non-destructive test and visual inspection of the welded joint to confirm the shims are securely attached and meet strength requirements. Conduct a watertight test to confirm it no affect the sealing requirements. 预防措施: 更新货舱结构检查清单，将承重垫块垫片及其固定状态纳入定期检查项目，确保每个航次都 进行检查。 Preventive Measure: Update the cargo hold structural inspection checklist to include specific checks for the bearing pad shims and their fixation status, ensuring regular inspection during each voyage. 23 描述：在 5 号舱盖右舷前部发现约 10 厘米长的胶条变形。 Description: Deformation sealing rubber approximately 10cm in length was observed on the forward starboard side of hatch cover No.5. 根本原因：在更换 5 号舱盖密封橡胶时，该段约 10 厘米的密封橡胶未被完全压入安装槽，导致安装不 平整并随后变形。安装工作未严格按照标准程序执行，且对密封橡胶安装的最终检查不足，未能及时发 现未完全压入的问题。 Root Cause: During the replacement of the sealing rubber on hatch cover No.5, The approximately 10cm section of the sealing rubber was not fully pressed into the installation groove, resulting in an uneven installation and subsequent deformation of the sealing rubber. The installation work was not carried out in strict accordance with the standard procedure and the final inspection of the sealing rubber installation was insufficient, failing to identify the incomplete pressing issue in a timely manner. 产生的风险：胶条变形会导致货舱进水、造成货损、结构腐蚀等。 Risk existed: Deformation of the rubber seal will result in water ingress into the cargo hold, cargo damage, structural corrosion, etc. 关闭要求: 1. 移除已变形的密封橡胶段，彻底清洁安装槽道，确保无残留物或碎屑。 2. 重新安装密封橡胶，确保橡胶完全嵌入槽道内。 3. 对修复后的密封橡胶进行目视检查及水密性测试，确认其满足密封要求且无变形。 Closing Requirements: 1. Remove the deformed section of the sealing rubber, clean the installation groove thoroughly to ensure no residue or debris remains. 2. Re-install the sealing rubber, ensuring the all rubber fully in the groove. 3. Conduct a visual inspection and a watertight test on the repaired sealing rubber to confirm it meets the sealing requirements and is free of deformation. 预防措施: 1. 规范密封橡胶更换程序：明确密封橡胶需全长压入槽内的要求，并制定分步安装指南供甲板部船员 参考。 2. 加强安装后检查：要求在每次更换后进行 100%的目视检查，确认密封橡胶的平整度和安装完整性， 并将检查结果记录在舱盖维护保养日志中。 Preventive Measure: 1. Standardize the sealing rubber replacement procedure: Clarify the requirement that the entire length of the sealing rubber into the groove, and formulate a step-by-step installation guide for deck crew reference. 2. Strengthen post-installation inspection: require a 100% visual check of the sealing rubber flatness and installation completeness after each replacement. and record the inspection results in the hatch cover maintenance log. 24 描述：艏部右舷系泊站 M1 系泊绞车的刹车片顶紧螺栓，其螺纹与锁紧螺母均已锈蚀。 Description: The jack bolt of breaking brand installed for M1 mooring winch, located at the starboard side of forward mooring station, was corroded on the bolt thread and lock nut. 根本原因： 1. 缺乏对顶推螺栓的定期防腐蚀维护和检查。 2. 顶推螺栓和锁紧螺母材料为碳钢而非不锈钢，在海洋环境中抗腐蚀性能较差。 Root Cause: 1. Lack of regular anti-corrosion maintenance and inspection for the jack bolt. 2. The jack bolt and lock nuts are made of carbon steel not stainless steel, which has poor corrosion resistance in the marine environment. 产生的风险：顶紧螺栓螺纹与锁紧螺母锈蚀可能导致系泊绞车制动失效，引发船舶失控、系泊事故及人 员伤亡，严重危及船舶靠泊安全。 Risk existed: Corrosion of the jack bolt threads and lock nut may result in mooring winch brake malfunction, triggering vessel runaway, mooring incidents, personnel casualties, thereby severely jeopardizing berthing safety. 关闭要求: 1.立即申领 18 套不锈钢螺栓与螺母。 2.拆除已锈蚀的碳钢顶紧螺栓及锁紧螺母，更换为新的不锈钢顶紧螺栓与锁紧螺母，并涂抹润滑脂。 3.依据设备手册要求，调节顶紧螺栓，设定 2 毫米的工作间隙。 Closing Requirements: 1. Immediately raised requisition for 18sets stainless steel bolts & nuts . 2. Removed the corroded carbon steel jack bolt, lock nut. Replaced with new stainless steel jack bolts and lock nuts. Applied grease. 3. Adjusted the jack bolt to set a 2mm working clearance as required by the equipment manual. 预防措施: 1. 为所有系泊绞车刹车装置建立月度检查和维护计划，重点关注顶推螺栓、螺纹和锁紧螺母的锈蚀状 况，并验证 2 毫米的工作间隙，详细记录检查结果。 2. 为刹车装置备足不锈钢材质的顶推螺栓和锁紧螺母备件，以确保在发生锈蚀或损坏时能及时更换。 Preventive Measure: 1. Establish monthly inspection and maintenance schedule for all mooring winch breaking devices, focusing on checking the corrosion condition of jack bolts, threads and lock nuts, as well as verifying the 2mm working clearance, and recording the inspection results in detail. 2. Prepare sufficient spare parts of stainless steel jack bolts and lock nuts for the breaking devices to ensure timely replacement in case of corrosion or damage. 25 描述：应急消防泵未配备防护装置。 Description: The protection guard was not provided on the emergency fire pump. 根本原因：防护罩在上次检查时被拆下，忘记重新安装，被遗落在角落并已生锈。 Root Cause: The protective cover was removed during last inspection and forget to reinstall，it was left in a corner and has rusted. 产生的风险：未设防护装置易引发意外触碰、设备损坏，不符合安全规范，危及消防作业安全。 Risk existed: Lack of protection guard may cause accidental contact, equipment damage, or failure to meet safety regulations, and endangering fire-fighting safety. 关闭要求:用镀锌板制作新的保护罩并安装。 Closing Requirements: Make a new protect cover using galvanized sheet metal and install it. 预防措施: 张贴通知，提醒所有人每次检查和测试后需重新安装防护罩。 Preventive Measure: Put up a notice to remind everyone to refit the guard after every inspection and testing. 26 描述：舵机室内的钢板垂直存放且未有效固定。 Description: Steel plate in the steering gear room stored in vertical position without properly secured. 根本原因：忽视了链条和花篮螺丝的松动，未能及时将其紧固。 Root Cause: Overlook the loosening of the chains and turnbuckles，and failed to tighten them in time. 产生的风险：钢板未有效固定易倾倒，造成人员受伤、设备损坏。 Risk existed: Without properly secured the steel plates may topple over, causing personnel injuries, equipment damage. 关闭要求: 使用角钢，并用大型螺栓固定。 Closing Requirements: Using angle steel secured with large bolt. 预防措施: 加强例行检查，并确保物品使用后螺栓立即被紧固。 Preventive Measure: Strengthen routine inspection and ensure bolts are tightened immediately after use. 27 描述：电瓶间水密胶条槽的右上角外缘发现锈蚀，且缺失约 3 厘米。 Description: Outer edge of Battery room Door sealing rubber channel found corroded on the top right corner with approximately 3cm missing. 根本原因：对蓄电池室风雨密门密封橡胶槽的例行检查不够仔细，导致未能及时发现右上角早期的腐蚀 状况。 Root Cause: During routine inspection of the battery room weather door sealing rubber channel was not conducted carefully, resulting in the failure to detect early corrosion at the top right corner in a timely manner. 产生的风险：胶条槽锈蚀缺失导致水密失效，引发进水、有害气体积聚、火灾爆炸风险。 Risk existed: Corrosion and loss of the rubber channel cause loss of watertight integrity, leading to water ingress, gas accumulation, fire explosion risks. 关闭要求: 1. 将右上角锈蚀缺损的密封橡胶槽道切除，制作新分段并焊接就位。 2. 更换密封橡胶，并进行光照检漏测试，确保其水密性。 Closing Requirements: 1. Cut out the corroded and missing section of the sealing rubber channel at the top right corner, Fabricated a new section and welding. 2. Renew the sealing rubber, and preformed a light leakage test to ensure water tightness. 预防措施: 1.对所有风雨密门进行更加仔细和详细的例行检查，以及时发现腐蚀或损坏的早期迹象。 2.加强船员培训，强调细致检查和及时整改缺陷的重要性，以保持蓄电池室等关键处所的安全和完整性。 Preventive Measure: 1. Conduct more careful and detailed routine inspections all weather doors, to detect early signs of corrosion or damage in a timely manner. 2. Strengthen crew training to emphasize the importance of meticulous inspection and prompt defect rectification, to maintain the safety and integrity of critical spaces such as the battery room. 28 描述：船舶于 2026 年 1 月 25 日驶离博凯港，核查机舱警报管理系统时，无舵机警报测试的证据及记录。 Description: Vessel departed Port De Boke on 25/Jan/2026, there was no evidence / record of steering gear alarms had been tested when reviewing the Engine Room Alarm Management system. 根本原因：离港前 12 小时以上未按公司系统进行舵机报警试验。 Root Cause: The steering gear alarm test is not performed according to the company system more than 12 hours before Departure. 产生的风险：未进行舵机警报测试可能导致故障无法及时发现，引发操舵失控、航行事故。 Risk existed: Failure to test steering gear alarms may result in undetected malfunctions, loss of steering control, navigational accidents. 关闭要求: 根据公司体系要求，已于 2026 年 3 月 22 日烟台港离港前完成舵机警报测试。 Closing Requirements: Steering gear alarm tested before departure YANTAI PORT 22/MAR/2026 according to the company system. 预防措施: 对办公室与工程师加强关于船舶开航前 12 小时内 SHIP-05-04-07 检查表与舵机操作测试的培 训。 Preventive Measure: Strengthen the offices and engineers training about SHIP-05-04-07 Checklist & Test for Steering Gear Operation Within 12 Hours Before Departure. 29 描述：无证据表明气体检测仪在每次使用前进行功能测试。 Description: There was no evidence/ record of bump test had been carried out prior each usage. 根本原因：安全意识不够。 Root Cause: Safe awareness was not enough. 产生的风险：未对气体检测仪执行每次使用前功能测试，无法确认仪器传感器及报警功能有效，易导致 有毒、可燃气体泄漏无法及时预警，引发中毒、爆炸及人员伤亡等安全事故。 Risk existed: No functional test conducted on gas detectors before each use fails to verify the effectiveness of sensors and alarms, which may result in failure to detect toxic or flammable gas leaks timely, causing poisoning, explosion and casualties. 关闭要求: 全体船员进行撞击测试相关要求与程序的培训。 Closing Requirements: All crew training the requirement and procedure of bump test. 预防措施: 1. 加强关于碰撞试验相关要求和操作的安全意识培训。 2. 建立碰撞试验记录。 Preventive Measure: 1.Strength Safe awareness training about relevant requirement and operation of bump test. 2.Establish the record of bump test. 30 描述：船舶中桅房内的电焊机的回路线被固定在船体结构上。 Description: The return line of the welding machine located in the midship store was observed permanently connected to the ship structure 根本原因：缺乏焊机的安全使用意识。 Root Cause: Lack of awareness of the safe use of welding machine. 产生的风险：线路因船舶摇晃、振动而松动，易造成短路、漏电或线路磨损引发火灾等风险。 Risk existed: Loosening of wires caused by the ship's rolling and vibration is likely to lead to risks such as short circuits, electric leakage, or fires triggered by wire abrasion. 关闭要求: 已更换焊机回路线，并在船中部物料间安装接地夹具。 Closing Requirements: Renewed the return line & installed earth clamp of the welding machine at the midship store. 预防措施: 1. 加强机舱船员关于安全使用焊机的培训。 2. 向船队发送提醒，并要求符合< COSWP >。 Preventive Measure: 1.Strengthen ER crews training about the safe use of welding machine. 2.Forward reminder to fleet ship, and require compliance with the < COSWP > 31 描述：已认可的安全设备记录未及时更新，未能体现引航员软梯的材质、制造商以及其制造与测试所依 据的标准。 Description: The Record of Approved Safety Equipment was not updated to reflect the material, manufacturer, and the standard to which the pilot ladder was made and tested. 根本原因：更换新的引水梯后，船级社没有及时收到这一信息。 Root Cause: The information was not promptly notified to the classification society after the new pilot ladder was replaced. 产生的风险：记录未更新无法核实引航梯符合安全标准，易造成结构失效、人员坠落受伤，严重危及引 航员及船员安全。 Risk existed: Outdated records fail to verify pilot ladder compliance with safety standards, leading to potential structural failure, fall accidents, injuries , seriously endangering pilot and crew safety. 关闭要求: 我们已和验船师沟通确认，在下次年检时进行更新。 Closing Requirements: We have already communicated with the surveyor and will make the update during the next annual survey. 预防措施: 今后如遇安全设备更新方面的类似情况，我们将及时通知船级社更新并记录安全证书。 Preventive Measure: In the future, if there are any similar situations regarding the update of safety equipment, we will promptly notify the classification society to update and record the safety certificate. 32 描述： 1.船长及大副未接受过与本船实际型号相符的舱盖检查与维护专项培训，仅由公司管理人员开展过通用 培训。 2.公司安全管理体系（SMS）中未制定程序，以确保舱盖部件间隙测量每六个月定期进行。 Description: 1. The Master and Chief Officer had not undergone a hatch cover inspection and maintenance training course pertinent to the type installed on the vessel being inspected, the generic training were conducted by the Manager. 2. There was no procedure to ensure that the clearance measurements of hatch cover components are carried out regularly every six months in Managers SMS. 根本原因： 1. 由于原始制造商已破产且不再生产舱盖设备，仅开展了舱盖通用性培训。 2. 舱盖测量项目已纳入维护计划，但缺少制造商要求的间隙测试程序。 Root Cause: 1.Only general training on the hatch cover was conducted because the original manufacturer has gone bankrupt and no longer produces hatch cover equipment. 2.The hatch cover measurement has already been included in the maintenance plan, but clearance test required by the manufacturer is lack. 产生的风险：缺乏针对性舱盖培训易导致检查维护不当，引发进水货损；未规定半年间隙测量程序，易 产生结构隐患，违反体系要求。 Risk existed: Lack of targeted hatch cover training may lead to improper inspection and maintenance, causing water ingress and cargo damage. Absence of regular clearance measurement procedures results in potential structural issues, non-compliance with SMS requirements. 关闭要求: 1. 结合舱盖说明书，观看视频与 PPT 学习公司专项培训内容。 2. 依据舱盖说明书技术要求，对舱盖间隙等技术参数进行测试，结果正常，并更新了舱盖年度维护计 划。 Closing Requirements: 1. Watch the video and PPT to learn the special training content company with the hatch cover manual. 2. According to the technical requirements of the hatch cover manual, the technical parameters such as the hatch cover clearance were tested and found to be normal, and the annual maintenance plan for the hatch cover was updated. 预防措施: 1. 根据第 9A.2 章要求，针对舱盖开展专项培训，并为船长和大副更新安全管理体系培训。 2. 安全管理体系已完成修订，现要求所有船舶依据制造商提供的技术规格进行维护保养，包括接触面 间隙等项目。 Preventive Measure: 1.Conduct specialized training on hatch cover and updated SMS training for the master and chief mate in accordance with the requirements of chapter 9A.2 2. The SMS has been updated, and it requires all ships to undergo maintenance in accordance with the technical specifications provided by the manufacturers, including the clearance of contact surfaces, etc. 33 描述：2 号、3 号货舱共计 5 个快速锁紧楔子，分别加装了 3 个和 4 个金属垫片。 Description: Five quick-acting cleats on cargo hatch No.2 and No.3 were fitted with 3 metal washers and 4 metal washers respectively. 根本原因：对快速压紧器的相关规范要求缺乏认知和理解。 Root Cause: Lack of the awareness and knowledge of the requirements of quick-acting cleats. 产生的风险：锁紧楔子加装过多金属垫片易导致受力不均、舱盖锁闭不牢，引发进水货损，不符合安全 要求。 Risk existed: Excessive metal washers fitted on quick-acting cleats may cause uneven stress, insecure hatch cover locking, water ingress, cargo damage and non-compliance with safety requirements. 关闭要求: 拆除快速压紧器上多余的金属垫片。 Closing Requirements: Dismantle the more metal washers of the quick-acting cleats. 预防措施: 1. 依据《舱盖维护手册》要求，加强对快速压紧器规范的培训。 2. 完成全船快速压紧器检查，确保其安装与维护符合标准。 Preventive Measure: 1.Enhanced training on the requirements of quick-acting cleats according to the《Hatch Cover Maintenance》. 2.Inspected all quick-acting cleats onboard to ensure proper install and maintenance. 34 描述：船上安装的是不可分隔式绞车，但在进行绞车打滑点测试计算时，仅按第一层系缆绳进行核算， 未考虑系泊作业中实际常用的缆绳层数。 Description: The undivided winches were fitted on board, however, the first layer of mooring lines was used for the winch rendering test according to the formula adopted for the calculation, and the normal layer in use for most mooring operations was not considered for the calculation. 根本原因：对系泊绞车制动力测试理解不足。 Root Cause: Inadequate understanding of Mooring Winch Brake Rendering Power Test. 产生的风险： 绞车试验仅按第一层缆绳计算，未考虑实际作业层数，易导致超载、绞车故障、缆绳断裂、船舶靠泊失 控，严重危及系泊安全。 Risk existed: Using only the first layer of mooring lines for winch rendering test calculation without considering actual working layers may lead to overloading, winch failure, broken mooring lines, uncontrolled berthing, seriously threatening mooring safety. 关闭要求: 修改绞车松缆测试参数，并重新测试系泊绞车刹车松出性能。 Closing Requirements: Modify the parameters of winch rendering test and retest Mooring Winch Brake Rendering. 预防措施: 1. 加强甲板部与轮机部关于系泊绞车刹车释放测试的培训。 2. 安全管理体系（SMS）中的绞车刹车释放测试记录表已更新，测试将基于绞缆筒上的实际工作缆层 进行。 Preventive Measure: 1.Strengthen the offices and engineers training about the Mooring Winch Brake Rendering test. 2.The Winch Brake Rendering test form have been updated in SMS，the test want to base on the layers on mooring drum. 35 描述：机舱车间内的立式钻床未安装急停装置，车床也未配备防护挡板。 Description: The standing drill was not fitted with an emergency stop installation, also lathe machine was not provided with protective guards in the engine room workshop. 根本原因：对车床和立式钻床的安全使用缺乏认知。 Root Cause: Lack of awareness of the safe use of lathes and standing drill. 产生的风险：钻床无急停装置、车床无防护挡板，易引发机械缠绕、挤压伤害，造成严重人身伤亡，不 符合船舶安全规范。 Risk existed: Lack of emergency stop device on the standing drill and protective guards on the lathe may lead to mechanical entanglement, crushing injuries, serious personnel casualties and non-compliance with marine safety regulations. 关闭要求: 已安装机舱车间立式钻床的急停装置及车床防护罩。 Closing Requirements: Installed the emergency stop for standing drill and protective cover for lathe machine of ER workshop. 预防措施: 1. 加强机舱船员关于机床和立钻的安全使用培训。 2. 全船队需检查紧急停止装置，缺失或不符合要求的必须加装。 Preventive Measure: 1.Strengthen ER crews training about the safe use of lathes and standing drill. 2.All the fleet ship want to checked the emergency stop and install if unfit. 36 描述：机舱二层平台的热水井（级联柜）蒸汽回管路上发现存在临时修理。 Description: Temporary repair was observed on the Cascade Tank steam return line on the 2nd platform of the Engine Room. 根本原因：对机舱蒸汽管线的维护缺乏认知。 Root Cause: Lack of awareness of ER steam line maintenance. 产生的风险：蒸汽回管路采用临时修理易造成蒸汽泄漏、烫伤风险，加剧管路腐蚀及系统故障，危及人 员安全，不符合安全标准。 Risk existed: Temporary repair on the steam return line may result in steam leakage, scalding hazards, pipe corrosion, system failure, and non-compliance with safety standards, posing risks to personnel safety. 关闭要求:已更换热水井上方的蒸汽回水管路。 Closing Requirements: Renewed the steam return line above the Cascade tank. 预防措施: 1. 加强机舱蒸汽管路的检查，确保所有蒸汽管路状况良好。 2. 加强轮机部船员关于《机舱管理规则》与《锅炉安全操作规程》的培训。 Preventive Measure: 1.Enhanced inspection of the steam line of ER to ensure all steam line in good condition. 2. Strengthen ER crews training about Engine Room Rules and Boiler Safety Operation Instruction. 第二部分：数据分析 Part II – Data analysis 2026年第一季度有4艘船舶经历了RIGHTSHIP检查，共开具了36条缺陷。所涉及的方面如下： Four vessels underwent RIGHTSHIP inspections in the first quarter of 2026 and a total of 36 deficiencies were issued. The areas covered are as follows: 项目 item 缺陷 占比 体系相关 SMS 14 39% 燃油管理 fuel management 2 6% 舱盖和起重设备 hatch cover & lifting equipment 5 14% 系泊设备相关的 mooring equipment 4 11% 机舱相关 engineer room 10 28% 船壳和上层建筑 hull & superstructure 1 3% 第三部分：改进措施 Part III – Improvement Measures 根据上述分析，下述改进措施供大家参考 Based on the above analysis, the following improvement measures are provided for your reference:： 1. 强化体系文件专项培训，重点落实 SHIP-02-05 封闭处所进入安全规定、SHIP-02-21 锁闭挂牌 （LOTO）规定、SHIP-02-08 货舱作业安全规定，确保船员熟练掌握并严格执行。 Strengthen special training on SMS documents, focusing on SHIP-02-05 Safety Rules for Enclosed Space Entry, SHIP-02-21 Regulations on Lock-out and Tag-out (LOTO), and SHIP-02-08 Regulations on Operation in Cargo Holds, to ensure crew members master and strictly implement the requirements. 2. 依据 PRO-19 船舶预防性维护保养程序，完善全船设备维保方案并严格落地执行。 Formulate and rigorously implement the vessel’s equipment maintenance plan in accordance with PRO-19 Ship Preventive Maintenance Procedures. 3. 按照 PRO-10 船舶检查与监督程序常态化开展自查，重点核查封闭空间、应急设备、系泊系统、舱 盖结构及机舱关键部件；坚持举一反三，全船队同步排查同类缺陷，一次性闭环整改。 Conduct regular self-inspections in line with PRO-10 Ship Inspection & Supervision Procedure, with priority checks on enclosed spaces, emergency equipment, mooring systems, hatch cover structures, and key engine room components. Apply lessons learned to similar issues, carry out fleet-wide simultaneous checks, and complete rectification in one closed-loop cycle. 4. 严格执行工作闭环管理，规范任务分配、执行、复查与验证流程，杜绝漏项、未验证等问题。 Strictly enforce closed-loop work management, standardize the processes of task assignment, execution, review, and verification, and eliminate omissions and unvalidated operations.

shop was found the return line permanent connected to the ship’s structure. 根本原因： 1.船舶新建建造期间，工厂安装不当。 2.在后续的船舶交接验收以及日常机舱巡回检查中，忽略了隐藏的接地隐患。 Root Cause: 1.Improper factory installation during vessel new building construction. 2.Hidden earthing hazard overlooked during successive vessel take-over acceptance and regular engine room rounds. 产生的风险： 结构腐蚀，设备损坏，火灾爆炸 Risk existed: Structural corrosion, equipment damage, fire and explosion. 关闭要求: 1.拆除固定式接地装置，按照安全规范改装为可拆卸式接地电缆。 2.轮机长使用专用检查清单，对全船便携式电焊机接地装置开展全面检查，并整改所有同 类不合格项。 Closing Requirements: 1.Remove permanent fixed earthing connection and refit detachable movable earthing cables per safety specifications. 2.Chief Engineer completes full vessel inspection of all portable welding machine earthing circuits with dedicated inspection checklist and rectifies all identical non-conformities. 预防措施: 1.机舱值班人员将电气设备接地装置纳入日常巡查范围。 2.已在新船交接及试航验收清单中新增电焊机接地专项核查项，后续新造船均遵照执行。 Preventive Measure: 1.Engine room watchkeepers include electrical equipment earthing integrity within daily routine inspection scope. 2.New ship take-over and sea trial acceptance checklist supplemented with dedicated welding machine earthing verification item for future new buildings. 27 描述： 除6货舱舱舱盖装有 46 只自动围紧器外，其余各舱舱盖均配置 16 只，但部分围紧器卡 滞卡死，无法灵活活动。 Description: There were 16 pcs of auto cleats fitted on each hatch cover except No.6( 46 pcs),however Some of them were found seized in position not free to move. 根本原因： 船舶保养计划（PMS）存在缺陷，日常维护缺少定期活络作业。 Root Cause: Deficient planned maintenance system (PMS) routine servicing lacking periodic freeing and lubrication work. 产生的风险： 舱盖启闭困难，风浪天气舱盖密闭不良，海水渗入致货舱进水、货物受损。 Risk existed: Difficult hatch operation leads to poor watertightness, causing seawater ingress and cargo damage in heavy seas. 关闭要求: 船舶停靠舟山太平洋船厂期间，厂方人员采用可控加热 + 机械敲击方式拆解所有卡死围 紧器，完成彻底活络，现已操作灵活。 Closing Requirements: All seized cleats disassembled via controlled heating and mechanical tapping, fully freed and lubricated for smooth operational movement by yard staffs during ship at Zhou shan Paxocean shipyard. 预防措施: 1.自动舱盖围紧保养已纳入月度维护保养计划中，包含拆解、除锈及润滑活络作业。 2.水手长每周检查舱盖，发现缺陷立即上报部门长，并录入维护保养计划中。 Preventive Measure: 1.Automatic hatch cleat maintenance incorporated into monthly PMS schedule including disassembly, descaling and grease replenishment. 2.Bosun performs weekly hatch cover inspection; emerging defects reported promptly to department head and logged into PMS maintenance system. 28 描述： 4号舱盖右前密封条受压凹陷，实测凹陷深度16毫米、长度约2米；舱盖说明书规定凹陷 超 5毫米即需更换。 Description: Hatch cover no.4 starboard forward rubber packing was found over pressed measured with16mm deep and in a length of approximately 2mtrs, Hatch cover instruction manual the recommended to change if more than 5mm. 根本原因： 舱盖日常保养不到位，加之紧固螺栓紧力异常，致使橡胶条因受压过度而出现永久性变 形。 Root Cause: Poor routine hatch maintenance and abnormal preload of tightening bolts leading to permanent rubber deformation under excessive compression. 产生的风险： 密封失效，航行中海水渗入舱内，造成货物受潮受损。 Risk existed: Failed sealing causes seawater leakage and cargo wet damage at sea. 关闭要求: 1.船舶在舟山太平洋船厂期间，厂方人员拆除 4 货舱舱盖右前侧受压变形的旧橡胶条，对 橡胶槽进行除锈清洁，并安装全新橡胶条。 2.对受影响的舱盖螺栓进行调整；全船检查所有舱盖胶条压缩余量，对不合格部位现场调 整。 Closing Requirements: 1.The No.4 H/C starboard forward over pressed rubber packing removed, channel descaled &cleaned , the brans-new rubber packing installed by yard staffs during ship at Zhou shan Paxocean shipyard. 2.Calibrate bolt preload torque for affected hatch; full vessel survey of all hatch packing compression margin with on-site fine-tuning for out-of-spec units. 预防措施: 1.将橡胶条的压缩量测量纳入季度 PMS（计划保养系统）维护项目中。 2.水手长在开航前进行舱盖开关操作时，目视检查橡胶条状况，发现异常立即报告缺陷。 Preventive Measure: 1.Rubber packing compression measurement added into quarterly PMS maintenance items. 2.Bosun visually inspect packing condition during hatch opening/closing before departure with immediate defect reporting upon abnormality. 29 描述： 锅炉安全阀附近两处蒸汽管线隔热层缺失，缺失长度约 20 厘米。 Description: Two steam line near the boiler safety valve was found the lagging missing in a length of approximately 20cm. 根本原因： 机舱日常巡查存在疏漏，高温管路隔热层预防性保养工作不到位。 Root Cause: Oversight during engine room routine patrols and insufficient preventive maintenance for high-temperature pipeline insulation. 产生的风险： 高温管线裸露易烫伤人员，热量损耗加剧。 Risk existed: Exposed hot piping may cause personnel scald and excessive heat loss. 关闭要求: 破损处已重新完整包妥隔热层并固定牢靠；轮机长对机舱所有高温蒸汽管路开展全面检 查，集中修复隔热层。 Closing Requirements: Damaged piping fully re-insulated and secured in place; Chief Engineer conducts full engine room high-temperature steam pipe survey for centralized insulation repair. 预防措施: 1.机舱月度保养中增设蒸汽管路隔热层专项全面检查项目。 2.值班轮机员在日常巡查中，重点检查锅炉及主蒸汽管路隔热层完好状态。 Preventive Measure: 1.Monthly engine room maintenance includes dedicated full steam piping insulation inspection item. 2.Watch engineers prioritize integrity check of boiler and main steam line insulation during regular rounds. 30 描述： 已核查 2026年2月1日、2026年5月28日的引航卡和船长引水信息交换表资料，拖轮总缆 桩拉力、缆桩安全负荷、拖缆缆绳设计破断力数据未更新。 Description: Pilot card and MPX dated on 01/Feb/2026 & 28/May/2026reviewed, the tug total bollard pull, SWL of the bollard & LDBF of tug line were not updated. 根本原因： 值班驾驶员（OOW）未完整填写船长和引水交换信息，且未按要求执行交叉核对。 Root Cause: OOW were not properly filled in details of M&P exchange information, cross check was not followed. 产生的风险： 数据不准易靠离泊发生断缆、船舶碰撞。 Risk existed: Outdated data may lead to line broken, collision. 关闭要求: 此后须仔细核对并完整填写引航卡交接信息。 Closing Requirements: Hereafter, carefully check and complete the pilot card exchange information. 预防措施: 加强相关培训，严格落实交叉核查工作。 Preventive Measure: Strengthen training and carefully cross checking. 31 描述： 电子海图（ECDIS）上中止线标注错误，不可折返界线与应急抛锚区未标注。 Description: The Abort line was incorrectly marked on the ECDIS, the Line of non-return & contingency anchorage were not marked on the ECDIS. 根本原因： 1.开航前检查不到位。 2.航行安全规范意识不足。 Root Cause: 1.Inadequate Pre-departure Check. 2.Insufficient Awareness of Navigation Safety Specifications. 产生的风险： 关键航线缺失标注，危急时无法精准决策避险，易造成船舶搁浅、触礁。 Risk existed: Missing markings hinder emergency decision-making, risking grounding and stranding. 关闭要求: 1.依据最新海图、港口规章及航线计划导则，重新校准并修正电子海图（ECDIS）中止线 位置。 2.及时在电子海图标注不可折返线与应急锚地，保证全部安全界限线、应急锚地标绘准确、 完整，满足航行规范要求。 Closing Requirements: 1.Re-calibrate and correct the position of the abort line on ECDIS in strict accordance with the latest nautical charts, port regulations and passage planning guidelines. 2.Complete the marking of line of non-return and contingency anchorage on ECDIS timely, ensure all safety limit lines and emergency anchorage marks are accurate, complete and compliant with navigation requirements. 预防措施: 1.规范航次计划与电子海图作业。 2.强化船员相关培训与评估工作。 Preventive Measure: 1.Standardize Passage Planning & ECDIS Operation. 2.Strengthen Crew Training & Assessment. 32 描述： 公司演练计划表（附录二）未列入电子海图故障应急演练项目。 Description: ECDIS failure drills did not included in the company drill matrix (Appendix II). 根本原因： 船员不熟悉 RISQ 3.2 最新条款要求。 Root Cause: Not familiar with the new requirement of RISQ 3.2 by ship staff. 产生的风险： 船员缺乏实操训练，ECDIS 突发故障时处置不当，易引发搁浅。 Risk existed： Without relevant drills, improper response to ECDIS failure may result in grounding. 关闭要求: 将电子海图故障应急演练列入演练计划表，自即日起每三个月开展一次该项演练。 Closing Requirements: Add the ECDIS failure drill into the drill matrix, start to have such drill every 3 month from now on. 预防措施: 依照更新后的演习计划表执行该演习。 Preventive Measure: Follow the updated drill matrix to carry out panned drills. 33 描述： 经核准的安全设备记录未更新，缺少引水梯的材质、生产厂家及制造检验标准信息。 Description: The Record of Approved Safety Equipment was not updated to reflect the material, manufacturer, and the standard to which the pilot ladder was made and tested. 根本原因： 1.船员未对新更换引水梯的全部技术资料严格核验和完善建档。 2.船员日常安全检查与文件检查未包含引水梯技术资料的完整性。 Root Cause: 1.The ship staff fail to strictly verify and complete the full technical information of the newly replaced pilot ladder. 2.The ship’s staff safety inspection and document checking did not cover the completeness of pilot ladder technical records. 产生的风险： 资料缺失无法核查引水梯合规性，使用不合格引水梯易造成登离船人员坠落伤亡。 Risk existed： Incomplete records may lead to usage of non-compliant pilot ladder and cause pilot fall injury. 关闭要求: 立即收集引水梯全套技术文件，包含厂家资质证书、产品材质说明书、出厂试验报告， 待下次船级社检验时提交验船师审核确认。 Closing Requirements: Immediately collect the complete technical documents of the pilot ladder, including manufacturer qualification certificate, product material specification sheet, factory test report and submit to class surveyor to check and approve during next class survey. 预防措施: 1.优化文件管理制度：修订完善船上安全设备文件管理规程。 2.强化日常检查与审核：将安全设备技术资料完整性纳入船舶日常安全检查及月度内部审 项目中。 Preventive Measure: 1.Optimize Document Management System: Revise and improve the ship’s safety equipment file management procedures. 2.Strengthen Daily Inspection & Audit: Incorporate the completeness of safety equipment technical records into the ship’s daily safety inspection and monthly internal audit items. 34 描述： 1.压载控制室首尾吃水计显示数值错误：实测首吃水 13.9m，仪表显示 16.2m；实测首吃 水 12.4m，仪表显示 18.2m。 2.压载水阀维护与测试项目未纳入PMS中。 Description: 1.The fwd and aft draft gauge in the ballast control room were indicating wrong valve, at the time of inspection fwd draft was13.9M and draft gauge indicating 16.2 meters, fwd draft was12.4M and draft gauge indicating 18.2 meters. 2.The maintenance and testing of the ballast valves was not incorporated in the PMS. 根本原因： 1.日常未仔细检查吃水计。 2.不熟悉船舶维护系统（PMS）程序操作，检查工作不到位。 Root Cause: 1.Not carefully inspection the draft gauge in daily time. 2.The operation of PMS program is not familiar and the inspection is not in place. 产生的风险： 吃水读数失真、阀门缺少定期维保，易致压载调载失误，船舶出现横倾、超载、搁浅。 Risk existed： Incorrect draft reading and lack of valve maintenance may cause improper ballasting, resulting in vessel list, overloading or grounding. 关闭要求: 1.检修吃水标尺，使其恢复正常使用。 2.将回转台及其销轴纳入计划维护系统（PMS）。 Closing Requirements: 1.Repair the draft gauge and recover to normal working condition. 2.Add turn table and its pin into PMS. 预防措施: 学习和加强培训。 Preventive Measure: Learning and strengthen training. 35 描述： 船上配备非分离式绞缆机，但绞缆机刹车力测试仅按照计算公式采用第一层缆绳进行， 大多数的系泊作业实际使用缆绳层数未进行刹车力测试。 Description: The undivided winches were fitted on board, however, the first layer mooring line was used for the winch break rendering test according to the formula adopted for the calculation, and the normal layer in used for most mooring operations was not considered for the mooring winch break rendering test. 根本原因： 未正确理解刹车力测试的计算原理，本船正常层数不是第一层。 Root Cause: Not correctly understanding the principle of calculation break render capacity, the normal layer was not the first layer on our vessel. 产生的风险： 刹车测试与实际工况不符，系泊时刹车承载力不足，易出现断缆、船舶漂移碰撞。 Risk existed： Test condition inconsistent with actual operation may cause brake failure, rope breakage and vessel collision. 关闭要求: 结合系泊作业常规使用约 4 层缆绳的实际情况，重新计算所有系泊绞车的刹车力。 Closing Requirements: Considering the normal layer in use for most mooring operation about 4 layers and recalculate the rendering capacity for all mooring winch. 预防措施: 强化船上培训与检查，将本船系泊作业常规使用层数相关内容纳入船舶缆绳管理计划并 完成更新。 Preventive Measure: Strengthen training and inspection on board, add the normal layer used on board of most mooring operation and updated in ship’s mooring system management plan. 36 描述：

defect.inspected_item: 号辅机 1～6 号燃油泵周边发现约 2 升渗油。 2.3 号辅机 1～6 号燃油泵周边发现约 2 升渗油。 Description: .Approximately 2 ltrs of oil were observed around
defect.desc: .1 AE fuel oil pump No.1～No.6. 2.Approximately 2 ltrs of oil were observed around No.3 AE fuel oil pump No.1～No.6. 根本原因： 日常检查不够全面，未能及时发现并清理轻微渗油，造成泵体周边积油。 Root Cause: The routine daily inspection was not thorough enough, resulting in minor oil leakage not being detected and cleaned in a timely manner, causing accumulated oil around the pump casing. 产生的风险： 积聚燃油易遇高温起火，人员滑到。 Risk existed： Accumulated oil risks fire hazard and personnel slipping. 关闭要求: 1.立即彻底清理 1 号、3 号辅机燃油泵周边积油，保持该处整洁干燥。 2.对所有辅机燃油系统进行全面检查，确认无同类渗漏、积油情况。 Closing Requirements: 1.Immediately clean up all accumulated oil around No.1 and No.3 AE fuel oil pumps thoroughly and keep the surrounding area clean and dry. 2. Carry out a full inspection of all auxiliary engine fuel oil systems to confirm no similar leakage or oil accumulation exists. 预防措施: 1.加强机舱日常巡检，提升船员渗漏排查意识，做到轻微渗油、积油早发现、早处置。 2.始终保持机舱整洁达标，杜绝同类检查缺陷再次发生。 Preventive Measure: 1.Strengthen daily machinery space inspection and enhance crew’s awareness of leakage monitoring. Ensure minor oil seepage and oil accumulation are detected and disposed of at the early stage. 2.Maintain a clean machinery house standard at all times to avoid similar inspection defects. 37 描述： 船上已安装主机功率限制（EPL）；但驾驶台操纵手册未提现出功率限制情况下的船舶操 纵性能特性。 Description: The engine power limiter (EPL) was installed onboard the vessel; The maneuvering booklet on bridge has not been updated to reflect the vessel's performance characteristics under 'EPL-limited power' conditions. 根本原因： 干坞修理完工后未及时更新主机功率限制相关信息 Root Cause: Failure to update EPL-related information in a timely manner after dry docking-repair。 产生的风险： 驾驶员对船舶制动、旋回、加速能力等操纵边界预判偏差，极易在狭水道航行、靠离泊 作业、避碰处置及应急操作过程中引发碰撞、搁浅、浪损等水上交通安全事故。 Risk existed： Cause to misjudge the vessel's stopping, turning and acceleration capabilities, which highly risks collision, grounding, swash damage and other maritime safety accidents during narrow channel navigation, berthing/unberthing, collision avoidance and emergency operations. 关闭要求: 将更新后的主机功率限制相关信息加入到驾驶台操纵手册内 Closing Requirements: Update the EPL related information into the maneuvering booklet on bridge. 预防措施: 1. 针对船员高级船员开展 IMO 第 A.601 (15) 决议相关培训 2. 核查引航卡、驾驶台挂图及操纵小册子同步更新情况 3. 依据船舶安全管理体系建立闭环安全管理流程 Preventive Measure: 1. Training for officers regarding IMO Res.A601(15) 2. Check Pilot card、Wheelhouse Poster and Maneuvering Booklet synchronous update. 3. Form a closed-loop SMS management in accordance with SMS 38 描述： 尾甲板气瓶间内 5 只气瓶（3 只氧气瓶、2 只乙炔瓶），其下部固定卡箍未固定到位。 Description: At the cylinder locker on the poop deck, five cylinders (three oxygen, two acetylene) were observed the lower securing clamps not fixed in position at time of inspection. 根本原因： 缺乏检查与安全意识 Root Cause: Lack of inspection and safety awareness 产生的风险： 尾楼甲板气瓶间未固定的氧气瓶与乙炔瓶在船舶摇晃时易倾倒泄漏，引发燃爆、人员伤 亡事故。 Risk existed： Unsecured oxygen and acetylene cylinders in the poop deck cylinder locker are prone to toppling and gas leakage under vessel rolling, which may cause fire、 explosion、 marine casualties. 关闭要求: 立即紧固下方固定卡箍。 Closing Requirements: Fixed the lower securing clamps at once 预防措施: 1.全面检查船上所有气瓶的固定夹具完好状况。 2.对相关船员开展安全管理体系专项培训（比如：SHIP-02-02 工作场所的安全规定和 SHIP-02-06 热工作业的安全规定） Preventive Measure: 1. Inspect the condition of securing clamps for all gas cylinders on board. 2. Conduct SMS section training for relevant crew members(such as ：SHIP-02-02 Safety of Workplaces and SHIP-02-06 Safety of Hot Work.) 39 描述： 存放于首楼储物间的 2 个停用引水软梯，既没做清晰标识也没悬挂标签注明停用状态。 Description: Two out of service pilot ladders stowed in the forecastle store were neither clearly marked nor tagged to indicate their unserviceable status. 根本原因： 疏忽 Root Cause: Negligence in work. 产生的风险： 未标注或者悬挂停用状态的报废引航员软梯易被误用于登离船作业，引发人员高空坠落 伤亡。 Risk existed： Unmarked and untagged out of service pilot ladders are prone to misuse during embarkation and disembarkation operations, resulting in fatal fall casualties. 关闭要求: 在废弃引航梯张贴 “停用” 标识。 Closing Requirements: Do the “OUT OF USE” sign on abandoned pilot ladders. 预防措施: 1.船员加强在用与停用的区分及管理 2.核查其他设备是否张贴 “停用” 标识。 Preventive Measure: 1.Strengthen the identification and management of in use and not in use by crew members. 2.Check other equipment “OUT OF USE” mark. 40 描述： 检查发现主甲板上所有燃油柜、柴油柜和润滑油柜透气管口周围安装的集油槽，其透气 管头最低延伸管的出口低于集油槽（大约低 200 毫米），因此在恶劣天气条件下可能会 阻碍柜内真空压力的释放。 Description: The save-alls fitted around all fuel, diesel, and lubricating oil tank vents on main deck was noted that the lowest extension pieces outlet of the vent head was lower than the save-all (approx. 200mm deficiency), therefore this could obstruct the release of vacuum pressure within the tank during adverse weather conditions. 根本原因： 缺乏检查 Root Cause: Lack of inspection. 产生的风险： 恶劣工况下会堵塞透气通道、阻碍舱室压力平衡。 Risk existed： blocks tank vents, obstructs tank pressure balance under adverse weather conditions. 关闭要求: 对透气管头最低延伸管进行局部切断，使排出口高出对应的集油槽。 Closing Requirements: Partially cut down the lowest extension pipes of vent heads to raise their outlets above the corresponding save-alls. 预防措施: 对甲板所有油舱透气帽开展全面检查，确保透气管头最低延伸管的出气口高度高于集油 槽，保证透气通畅。 Preventive Measure: Carry out complete inspection for all oil tank vents on deck to ensure the outlets of the vent head’s lowest extension pipes are kept higher than the save-alls（easy to air flow in and out）. 41 描述： 约三分之一（54 个中的 6 个）舱盖滚轮限制器的橡胶缓冲垫表面被刷油漆（安装于 1-9 货舱舱口围轨道端部、以及舱口围平台中部位置）。 Description: Approximately one-third (6 out of 54) of the rubber buffer pads on the wheel stoppers (fitted at the coaming track ends and 加强甲板日常检查和甲板维护保养工作。 Preventive Measure: Enhance deck daily inspection and maintenance of deck work 42 描述： 检查发现：应急发电机是依靠单台启动马达；船上虽备有备用启动马达且上次测试时间 为 2025 年 12 月 6 日，但未按规范要求保持季度测试频率，无法确保其应急就绪状态。 Description: The emergency generator is reliant on a single starter motor. At the time of inspection, gyro reading: 269.6 degrees, magnetic compass reading:282.5, TMC: 282.5. 根本原因： 1.船员未充分认识定期 TMC 测试的重要性，未开展自查。 2.驾驶员航海设备维护与测试职责不清晰。 Root Cause: 1.The crew lacks awareness of 无法核实传输磁罗经精度，航行易出现航向偏差，威胁航行安全。 Risk existed： The accuracy of TMC cannot be verified, which may cause heading deviation and endanger navigation safety. 关闭要求: 立即对 TMC 开展功能测试，设备运行正常。 Closing Requirements: 加强新任驾驶员航海设备交接熟悉培训，使其掌握相关维护要求。 Preventive Measure: 1.Establish a clear testing schedule for the TMC within the SMS to ensure traceability. 2.Master shall strengthen routine oversight and inspection, passage plan and cross checked between the Admiralty Information Overlay (AIO) and T&P notice against the Weekly Notice to Mariners. 根本原因： 1.船员未遵守航次计划操作规程，规程要求手动录入临告和预告海图改正资料，并对照英 版海图信息叠加系统（AIO）与《每周航海通告》交叉核对。 2.驾驶员不熟悉英版海图信息叠加系统更新内容与每周航海通告的比对流程，仅依赖电子 系统，未开展人工复核。 Root Cause: 1.The crew did not follow the voyage planning procedure requiring manual entry of T&P corrections and cross-checking against AIO and Weekly Notices to Mariners. 2.Lack of familiarity with the process of comparing Admiralty Information Overlay (AIO) updates with weekly notices, leading to reliance solely on electronic systems without manual verification. 产生的风险： 增加搁浅、碰撞等航行风险。 Risk existed： Increase navigational risks such as grounding and collision. 关闭要求: 1.立即将全部未录入的临告和预告改正录入航次计划，并对英版海图信息叠加层、临告和 预告通告及最新每周航海通告完成全面交叉核对。 2.核实修正后的航次计划由船长批准，并向值班驾驶员完整讲解。 Closing Requirements: 1.Immediately entered all outstanding T&P corrections into the passage plan and performed a full cross-check between the AIO, T&P notices, and the latest Weekly Notices to Mariners. 2.Verified that the corrected passage plan was approved by the master and properly briefed to the watch keeping officers. 预防措施: 1.明确规定必须手工录入临告和预告改正，开航前留存交叉核对书面记录。 2.针对全体驾驶员开展专项培训，讲解英版海图信息叠加层、临告和预告通告、每周航海 通告的正确使用方法，并配套交叉核对实操练习。 Preventive Measure: 1.Explicitly mandate the manual entry of T&P corrections and require documented evidence of cross-checking prior to departure. 2.Provide targeted training for all navigating officers on the correct use of AIO, T&P notices, and Weekly Notices to Mariners, including practical exercises on cross-referencing. 46 描述： 船舶于2026年6月16日在烟台西港靠泊前，于4号锚地抛锚，但无论是在电子海图（ECDIS） 还是航次计划表格中，均未对航次计划进行修正。 Description: Vessel anchored at No.4 anchorage prior berthing Yantai west port on 16/Jun/2026, there was no passage plan amendment was prepared in both ECDIS and passage plan form. 根本原因： 船员未能意识到，靠泊前在指定锚地抛锚属于航次阶段变更，需要修正航次计划。 Root Cause: The crew did not recognize that anchoring at a designated anchorage prior to berthing constitutes a change in the voyage phase requiring an amended passage plan. 产生的风险： 导致航次计划不完整，增加船舶靠泊操作中的搁浅、碰撞等航行风险。 Risk existed： Result in an incomplete passage plan and increase the risk of grounding, collision, and other navigational hazards during berthing operations. 关闭要求: 1.立即编辑航次计划，覆盖 4 号锚地至烟台西港泊位全程航线，并同步录入 ECDIS 及纸 质航次计划表 2.核实该修正的航次计划并由船长批准，并在船舶驶往泊位前向所有值班驾驶员做了简要 通报。 Closing Requirements: 1.Immediately prepared a revised passage plan covering the route from the No.4 anchorage to the berth at Yantai West Port, and entered it into both ECDIS and the paper passage plan form. 2.Verified that the revised plan was approved by the master and briefed to all watch keeping officers before proceeding to berth. 预防措施: 1.在抵港前、抛锚前程序中增设强制检查项，确认航次发生变更时已完成航次计划修正。 2.以本次缺陷作为案例，针对全体驾驶员重新培训，讲解《国际海上人命安全公约》第五 章及公司安全管理体系中关于航次计划修正的相关要求。 Preventive Measure: 1.Include a mandatory checklist item in the pre-arrival and pre-anchoring procedures to confirm that the passage plan has been amended if the intended operation changes. 2.Provide refresher training to all navigating officers on the requirements for passage plan amendments as per SOLAS Chapter V and company SMS, using this deficiency as a case study. 47 描述： 电机员于 2026 年 6 月对各类机械和设备的马达和配电板进行了绝缘测试（涉及超过 100 件设备/机械），但上述作业均未签发上锁挂牌（LOTO）许可证或风险评估报告。 Description: The Electrical Engineer carried out meger test for motors and switchboard on various machinery and equipment in Jun 2026 ( over 100 equipment/machinery), however there was no LOTO permits/ Risk assessment issued for these jobs. 根本原因： 船员在执行上锁挂牌（LOTO）作业时安全意识不足，需进一步加强。 Root Cause: There is insufficient awareness of safety in the implementation scope of Lock out and Tag out operations, which needs to be enhanced. 产生的风险： 未签发上锁挂牌（LOTO）许可证和风险评估即进行大批量电气测试，导致安全隔离措施 缺失，显著增加人员触电、电弧灼伤及设备意外启动引发重伤事故的风险。 Risk existed： Without issuing LOTO permits or risk assessments leads to a lack of electrical isolation and safety controls, significantly increasing the risk of electric shock, arc flash, and unexpected equipment start-up, which could result in serious personnel injuries. 关闭要求: 组织全员学习船舶 SHIP-02-21 锁闭挂牌规定，要求电气作业期间严格遵守该程序，提升 相关安全意识。 Closing Requirements: Trained SHIP-02-21 Regulations on Lock out and Tag out& compliance with this procedure when election operation. Enhance awareness in this area. 预防措施: 1.设立监督，每日监督船员落实上锁挂牌作业流程，及时纠正违规行为。 2.通过真实案例剖析讲解，加深船员对上锁挂牌作业重要性的认知。 3.鼓励船员交流执行上锁挂牌作业中的经验与问题，定期对流程执行情况汇总分析。 Preventive Measure: 1.Set up supervision posts to importance of Lock out/Tag out. 3.Encourage crew members to share their experiences and problems in the execution of Lock out/Tag out, summarize and analyze the execution of procedures regularly. 48 描述： 压载水阀保养和测试没有纳入计划维护保养系统。 Description: The maintenance and testing of the ballast valves was not incorporated in the PMS. 根本原因： 检查工作不够细致到位。 Root Cause: Inspection work are not careful and meticulous. 产生的风险： 缺少计划性维护易造成压载阀故障失灵，影响压载水操作，存在船舶稳性风险。 Risk existed： Lack of maintenance may cause ballast valve malfunction, impair ballasting and endanger vessel stability. 关闭要求: 1.将压载水阀门测试项目录入 PMS。 2.压载水遥控阀门须按照 PMS 要求定期测试。 Closing Requirements: 1.Insert the valve tested items in PMS system. 2.Ballast remote valve tested at regular interval based PMS. 预防措施: 1.组织船员培训压载水遥控阀测试操作方法。 2.安排轮机人员依据PMS定期检查压载水遥控阀。 Preventive Measure: 1.Training crew how to test ballast remote valve at local. 2.Arrange engineer to regularly check the ballast remote valve according the PMS 49 描述： 1.在 6 号货舱后部左侧的舱盖上，观察到一段长约 30 厘米的插入式橡胶条。 2.5号货舱后部左侧的橡胶密封条，发现存在10~12毫米的凹槽/压痕（约为实际尺寸50±1 毫米的25%）。 Description: 1.An insert rubber packing piece with length approximately 30 cm was observed on hatch coverNo.6 Aft Port side. 2.Rubber packing of the cargo hold No. 5 on aft port side was noted with grooving 10~12mm (approximately 25% of actual size 50-+1 mm). 根本原因： 1.该缺陷大概率是舱盖启闭时舱盖与密封胶条发生摩擦、装卸货作业造成磨损、胶条长期 露天风吹雨淋，以及长时间受压出现压缩永久变形所导致。 2.甲板船员未按照船舶计划维护保养系统（PMS）和安全管理体系（SMS）开展定期检查 并进行规范保养。 Root Cause: 1.It is likely caused by friction between the hatch cover and the packing rubber during opening and closing operation or wear from cargo handling activities, or pronged exposure to the weather and compression set over time. 2.Officer crew are not carried out interval inspection and make a proper maintenance according the PMS and SMS. 产生的风险： 在恶劣海况下易发生货舱进水，造成货物湿损、船舶稳性恶化，并可能因积水影响船舶 航行安全。 Risk existed： Increasing the risk of cargo hold flooding in heavy weather, which may cause cargo damage, stability degradation, and potential navigational hazards due to accumulated water. 关闭要求: 1.拆除凹槽/压痕密封胶条，并且更换新密封胶条。 2.更换部分橡胶条并且长度超过一米。 Closing Requirements: 1.Remove the grooving rubber packing and install the new rubber packing. 2.Replace the part of that section of the rubber packing more than 1meters in length. 预防措施: 1.对舱盖所有密封胶条制定月度检查计划，定期检查胶条磨损、沟槽及破损情况。 2.检查胶条压缩变形程度、磨损程度以及固定状况，提前更换出现老化或严重磨损的密封 胶条。 3.组织船员开展舱盖规范操作与货物装卸流程培训，减少胶条受到不必要的摩擦。 Preventive Measure: 1.Implement a monthly routine inspection schedule for all hatch cover rubber packing and carry out checking for wear &grooving &damage in regular. 2.Checking compression set ,wear levels, and fastening condition, replacing any packing rubbers that show signs of aging or excessive wear proactively. 3.Provide training to crew members on proper hatch cover operation and cargo handling procedure to minimize unnecessary friction and impact on rubber packing. 50 描述： 机舱车间台钻与砂轮机未安装急停装置，且台钻未配备安全防护挡板。 Description: The Standing drill and insufficient awareness of safety . 产生的风险： 缺少防护及急停装置，操作时易发生机械卷入、割伤事故，存在人身伤害隐患。 Risk existed： Absence of guards and emergency stops may lead to mechanical entanglement and operator injuries. 关闭要求: crews training about the protective function that the protective guard can play. 2.Regularly test the emergency stop installation and check protective guard, if it is damaged, replace it in a timely manner. 51 描述： 肉库、鱼库制冷蒸发器出口管路结霜结冰。 Description: Ice accumulation was observed on the Evaporator outlet line in the meat room and fish room. 根本原因： 船员未执行定期检查，也未按要求做好规范保养。 Root Cause: Crew are not carried out interval inspection and make a proper maintenance. 产生的风险： 管路结冰阻碍制冷循环，库温失控易导致生鲜货物变质。 Risk existed： Ice blocks refrigeration circulation, out of control temperature spoils frozen provisions. 关闭要求: 及时清除积冰，并开展定期检查。 Closing Requirements: Defrost ice and checked regularly. 预防措施: 1.培训船员掌握除冰操作方法。 2.由值班轮机员检查肉库温度与结冰状况。 Preventive Measure: 1.Trained on the way to defrost ice. 2.Inspect the meat room temperature and ice condition by duty engineer. 52 描述： 没有客观证据表明，除船长和大副外，所有负责货物操作的驾驶员和普通船员均已接受 过关于载运固体散装危险及有害物质的正式操作培训。 Description: There was no objective evidence indicated that all officers and 该公司已对所有负责在载运散装固体危险有害物质船舶上从事货物装卸作业的高级船员 和普通船员开展了培训，但船上未留存其正式培训证书。 Root Cause: The company have conducted training for all officers and ratings responsible for cargo handling on ships carrying dangerous and hazardous substances in solid form in bulk. While their formal training certificate were not retained on board. 产生的风险： 船员缺乏危险货物作业正规培训，易引发散装固体危险货物装卸安全事故。 Risk existed： Insufficient formal training for seafarers may lead to safety accidents during cargo handling on ships carrying dangerous and hazardous substances in solid form in bulk. 关闭要求: 立即联系公司，要求其将正式培训证书发送至船上 Closing Requirements: Contact company immediately, require their formal training certificate to be send on board. 预防措施: 加强培训，认真研读 RISQ.2.7 条款，防止类似事件再次发生。 Preventive Measure: Strengthen training and carefully study the RISQ.2.7 clause to prevent similar case from happening again. 53 描述： 经批准的货船安全设备记录未予更新，未能反映船上现有引水员梯的相关信息。此外， 无证据表明负责释放和检查引水员梯的人员，已就引水员梯及其使用所涉及的检查要求、 法规和标准接受过定期培训。 Description: Record of Approved Cargo Ship Safety Equipment had not been updated to reflect the information of present pilot ladders on board the ship. - Update Record of Approved Cargo Ship Safety Equipment Timely; 2. In accordance with the company's training plan, strengthen the training for personnel responsible for the rigging and inspection of pilot ladders. 3. The pre-boarding pilot ladder training will be implemented in accordance with the new forms. Such quarterly onboard training will be carried out continuously in the future. 54 描述： 货舱污水井止回阀检修工作未纳入船舶计划维护保养系统中。 Description: Overhaul of cargo hold bilge non-return valves was not included in the planned maintenance system. 根本原因：轮机员在编制维护保养系统时，未能全面核查所有船舶重要管路设备，且货 舱舱底水止回阀的维护项目被遗漏，未在船上进行记录。 Root Cause: The engineer failed to fully verify all marine essential piping equipment when compiling the planned maintenance system, and maintenance items for cargo hold bilge non-return valves were omitted without being recorded onboard. 产生的风险： 货舱污水井止回阀未列入维保计划，存在污水倒灌风险。 Risk existed： Failure to include overhaul of cargo hold bilge non-return valves in PMS risks bilge water backflow. 关闭要求: 立即联系岸基管理部门，增设所有货舱舱底水止回阀的检修项目，并将止回阀 上次检修日期更新至船舶预防性维修系统（PMS）。（货舱舱底水止回阀上次检修日期： 2026 年 1 月 20 日） Closing Requirements: Immediately contact shore management department, add overhaul items of all cargo hold bilge non-return valves and update last non-return overhaul date into PMS.( cargo hold bilge non-return valve last overhaul date:20-JAN-2026) 预防措施: 对船员开展培训，强化计划保养体系的执行流程，认真学习安全管理体系的相 关条款，安排轮机管理人员定期对所有船舶设备维保项目进行全面盘点，杜绝同类疏漏 问题再次发生。 Preventive Measure: Training the crew Strengthen the procedure of planned maintenance system, carefully study relevant clauses of SMS, arrange engineering officers to conduct comprehensive inventory of all ship equipment maintenance items regularly to prevent similar omissions from recurring. 55 描述： 在 2026 年 1 月 31 日船厂安装一台开式脱硫塔。然而，没有证据表明该脱硫塔的维护保 养已在 PMS 中定期记录。 Description: An open loop type Exhaust Gas Cleaning System (scrubber system) was installed at shipyard on 31 Jan 2026. However no evidence indicated that maintenance of exhaust gas cleaning system was recorded periodically in the PMS. 根本原因： 脱硫塔安装完成后，船员未及时更新船舶维修保养体系（PMS），即便船舶废气清洗系 统（EGCS）的常规保养项目已录入船舶维修保养体系数据库，监管人员也未能监控并跟 踪新安装设备的维护保养工作是否在该体系中正常开展。 Root Cause: After scrubber installation finished, crew did not update PMS in time, even regular maintenance items for EGCS were added into PMS system database, but the Supervisory personnel failed to monitor and track whether the maintenance and upkeep of newly installed equipment were functioning in PMS properly. 产生的风险： 设备故障无法提前管控，存在废气排放超标风险。 Risk existed： May lead to equipment breakdown and excessive exhaust emission. 关闭要求: 立即联系岸上技术部门，确保废气清洗系统（EGCS）所有计划保养项目均在 计划保养系统（PMS）中正常执行，并补全船上此前已完成的所有保养记录。 Closing Requirements: Contact shore technical department at once, make sure all scheduled maintenance items of EGCS correct running in PMS, and filled back all previous maintenance records done onboard 预防措施: 开展船舶维修保养体系专项培训，全面核查并校验计算机化船舶维修保养体系 中的所有设备，认真研读《国际防止船舶造成污染公约》相关规定及公司维护保养规程， 杜绝同类缺陷重复出现。 Preventive Measure: Conduct specialized training on PMS, Fully check and verify all equipment in in the computerized PMS, carefully study MARPOL regulations and company maintenance procedures to avoid similar deficiencies repeating. 56 描述： 船上未配备厂家规定的、适用于该类型舱盖安全运行及计划性、故障维修所需的最新最 低推荐备件清单。 Description: An up-to-date list of the minimum recommended spare parts for the safe operation and to support both planned and corrective maintenance of type of hatch cover, as specified by the manufacturer was not available on board. 根本原因：工作中存在疏忽，对舱盖备件的重要性认识不足，未能及时检查各类备件的 数量并更新库存清单。 Root Cause: Negligence at work, insufficient understanding of the importance of hatch cover spare parts, failure to promptly inspect the quantity of each spare part and update the inventory list in a timely manner. 产生的风险： 缺少舱盖原厂最新必备备件清单，维保抢修无参考依据，影响舱盖安全使用。 Risk existed： Absence of manufacturer’s latest recommended spare parts list for hatch covers hinders maintenance and endangers hatch cover safety. 关闭要求: 依据舱口图纸及说明书要求，编制舱口备件清单，按照清单所列项目及时向厂 家申领所需备件，并妥善管理，确保备件随时可用。 Closing Requirements: on the hatch drawings and instruction manual requirements, prepare a list of hatch spare parts, promptly request the required spares from the manufacturer according to the list items, and properly manage them to ensure they are always readily available. 预防措施: 对船员开展培训以提升其安全意识，使其认识到舱口盖备件对开启与关闭作业的重要性。 制定定期检查管理表，确保舱口盖备件的数量充足、质量合格，并保证其在需要时随时 可用。按流程申领备件并妥善管理，确保备件始终处于待命可用状态。 Preventive Measure: Training the crew to enhance their awareness, making them realize the significance of the hatch cover spare parts for the opening and closing operations. Prepare a regular inspection management table to ensure the quantity and quality of the hatch cover spare parts, and make sure they are always available when needed. Apply for spare parts and manage them properly to ensure they are always ready for use. 57 描述： 船上所有在用系泊缆绳均未加装防磨护具。 Description: All mooring ropes in use onboard were not covered with chafe protections. 根本原因：船员对系缆防护的认知不足，在系缆管理方面的学习也不到位。他们未能认 识到系缆防护对系泊安全的重要性，对检查表问卷未做好充分准备，并且未按照检查要 求开展作业。 Root Cause: The crew had insufficient awareness of mooring line protection and inadequate learning in mooring line management. They failed to recognize the importance of mooring line protection for mooring safety and did not prepare adequately for the checklist questionnaire. They also did not operate in accordance with the inspection requirements. 产生的风险： 系泊缆无防磨保护，易磨损断裂引发系泊安全事故。 Risk existed： All mooring ropes in use onboard were not covered with chafe protections. 关闭要求: Closing Requirements: Install protective covers on all 16 in-use mooring lines on the ship. 预防措施: 增强系缆防护意识，定期开展培训，学习船舶系缆管理方案，并根据船上系缆 防护套的状况及时申领新的系缆防护套。 Preventive Measure: Enhance the awareness of mooring line protection, conduct regular training, study the ship mooring line management plan and promptly apply for new mooring line protection covers based on the condition of the mooring line protection covers on board. 58 描述： 机舱工作间固定式钻机未按船上安全作业守则第 20.3 条要求设置紧急停止装置。 Description: The fixed drill machine in the engine room workshop was not provided with a means of emergency stop as required by COSWP Regulation 20.3. 根本原因：工作人员对《商船良好工作做法》中规定的车间设备相关安全规章缺乏足够 了解，未对安全防护装置开展定期检查，且忽视了紧急停止功能的重要性。 Root Cause: Crew members lack sufficient understanding safety regulations regarding the workshop equipment specified in the COSWP, fail to conduct regular inspections on safety protection devices, and disregard the importance of emergency stop functions. 产生的风险： 机舱钻机缺少急停装置，误操作时无法快速停机，易引发机械伤人事故。 Risk existed： Lack of emergency stop device for engine room drill may cause mechanical injury accidents. 关闭要求: 立即联系船舶管理公司采购部门，为船舶提供合格的应急停止装置。安装完成 后，已进行全面功能测试并确认该装置运行正常。 Closing Requirements: Immediately contact ship management office procurement department to supply qualified emergency stop device to vessel. Upon completion of installation, full function test was carried out and confirmed the device operates properly. 预防措施: 对相关工作人员开展培训，强化所有车间机械设备的每周巡检计划，深入学习 《商船良好工作做法》第 20.3 条，消除安全隐患。 Preventive Measure: Trained related crew and strengthen weekly inspection schedule for all workshop machinery, thoroughly study COSWP Regulation 20.3, and eliminate potential safety hazards. 59 描述： 焚烧炉废油泵电机损坏且已被拆解。 Description: Incinerator was found with waste oil pump motor defective and dismantled. 根本原因：废油泵电机内部绕组因绝缘老化发生意外烧毁，导致电机在运行过程中突然 故障。 Root Cause: The internal winding of waste oil pump motor suffered unexpected burnout caused by aging insulation, resulting in sudden motor breakdown during operation. 产生的风险： 焚烧炉废油泵电机故障拆解，无法正常处理污油，存在油污处置违规风险。 Risk existed： Defective and dismantled waste oil pump motor renders incinerator unusable and causes illegal oily waste disposal risks. 关闭要求: 立即联系公司，更换本港船上供应的合格废油泵电机，替换故障电机，并开展 焚烧炉运行测试，使其恢复正常运行。 Closing Requirements: Contact company immediately, the qualified waste oil pump electric motor supplied on board at current port, replaced defective electric motor, and carried out incinerator running test to restore normal operation. 预防措施: 这台旧电机已送至岸上服务商处进行线圈重绕，现已修复完毕并作为备用机组 留存。 Preventive Measure: The old motor has been sent to the shore service provider for coil rewinding. It has been repaired and kept as a spare unit. 60 描述：主配电板上的 220V 馈电板绝缘电阻读数偏低，测得值为 0.7 兆欧。 Description: Main switchboard was found with 220V feeder panel low insulation resistance with reading of 0.7MOhm. 根本原因：责任人员未按要求对 220 伏馈电线的绝缘状况开展定期检查，而此类检查本 应能发现灯具底座密封不严的问题。该缺陷是在右舷外侧的一盏室外照明灯具上被发现 的。 Root Cause: Responsible officer failed to conduct regular inspections of the insulation condition of the 220V feeder as required, which would have revealed inadequate sealing at the base of a light fitting. The defect was found on an exterior lighting fixture outside the starboard. 产生的风险：可能导致漏电短路，引发触电及电气火灾。 Risk existed： May cause electric leakage, short circuit, electric shock and electrical fire. 关闭要求: 查明故障原因，清除灯具内部潮气，加强灯座密封，并反复测量绝缘电阻，直 至其恢复至正常水平。 Closing Requirements: Identify the fault cause, removed moisture inside the lamp, reinforced the seal of the lamp base, and measured the insulation resistance repeatedly until it returns to normal level. 预防措施: 对船员进行专项培训，仔细审查安全管理体系（SMS）规定，加强电气设备的 维护，并定期检查和加强室外电缆的密封性能，以避免再次发生类似的违规情况。 Preventive Measure: Carry out special training for crew, carefully review SMS regulations, Strengthen the maintenance of electrical equipment, and regularly inspect and reinforce the sealing performance of outdoor electric cables to avoid similar non-compliance again. 61 描述： 船舶最近一次船对船作业于 2026 年 5 月 7 日在几内亚卡姆萨港完成，无证据表明本 次作业组织者或现场主管填写完成船对船作业检查表。 Description: Last STS operation was completed on 07 May 2026 at Kamsar, Guinea, however no evidence indicated that STS Questionnaire had been completed by either the STS Organiser or the STS Unit Manager 根本原因：该船船员对 RISQ.17.11 的了解不足，未能按照 RISQ 中规定的要求进行 STS 作业。 Root Cause: The crew members of the ship lacked sufficient knowledge of RISQ.17.11 and failed to conduct the STS operations in accordance with the requirements specified in RISQ. 产生的风险： 未填船对船作业专项检查表，存在货物撒漏、缆绳断裂、船体碰撞与港口检查缺陷风险 Risk existed： Incomplete STS questionnaire for transfer operation, resulting in cargo spillage、mooring line breakage、vessel collision and detention during port inspection. 关闭要求: 加强培训，并仔细研读 RISQ.17.11 条款，以防止类似情况再次发生。 Closing Requirements: Strengthen training and carefully study the RISQ.17.11 clause to prevent similar case from happening again. 预防措施: 定期对船员进行培训，在每次 STS 作业前开展培训，以确保船舶为 STS 作业 做好充分准备；由 STS 组织者或 STS 单位经理填写 STS 问卷。 Preventive Measure: Carry out regular training for the crew, conduct training before each STS operation to ensure that the ship is well-prepared for STS operation, Complete STS Questionnaire by either the STS Organizer or the STS Unit Manager. 第二部分：数据分析 Part II – Data analysis 2026 年第二季度有 8 艘船舶经历了 RIGHTSHIP 检查，共开具了 61 条缺陷。所涉及的方面如下： Four vessels underwent RIGHTSHIP inspections in the second quarter of 2026 and a total of 61 deficiencies were issued. The areas covered are as follows: 数量 比例 基本信息 General Information 证书和人事管理 Certification and Personnel Management 1 2% 航行安全 navigation 9 15% 体系相关 ISM System 16 26% 防污染相关 Pollution Prevention and Control 5 8% 燃油管理 Fuel Management 1 2% 舱盖和起重设备 Hatch Cover and Lifting Appliances 8 13% 系泊设备 Mooring Operations 5 8% 机舱 Machinery Space 12 20% 船壳和上层建筑 General Appearance - Hull and Superstructure 2 3% 船员健康和福利 Health and Welfare of Seafarers 1 2% 船对船作业 Ship To Ship Operation 1 2% 2026年第二季度RIGHTSHIP缺陷分布图 RIGHTSHIP Defect Distribution Chart for the Second Quarter of 2026 3% 2%2%2% 15% 20% 8% 26% 13% 8% 2% 证书和人事管理 航行安全 Certification and Personnel Management navigation 体系相关 防污染相关 ISM System Pollution Prevention and Control 燃油管理 舱盖和起重设备Hatch Cover and Lifting Appliances Fuel Management 系泊设备Mooring Operations 机舱 Machinery Space 第三部分：改进措施 Part III – Improvement Measures 根据上述分析，下述改进措施供大家参考： Based on the above analysis, the following improvement measures are provided for your reference： 1. 完善 PMS 预防性维护体系文件 Complete and optimize PMS system documents 依据《PRO-19 船舶预防性维护保养程序》，将脱硫系统、压载阀组、舱盖全套配件、等设备新增至月 度 / 季度维保清单，明确测量、活络、更换、测试周期并完善记录表单。 In accordance with PRO-19 Ship Preventive Maintenance Procedures, add exhaust gas scrubber systems, ballast valve sets, full hatch cover fittings into monthly & quarterly maintenance checklists, clarify cycles for measurement, lubrication, renewal and function test, and complete relevant record forms. 2. 落实上锁挂牌作业安全管控 Enforce mandatory lockout & tagout (LOTO) safety control for all work 应严格执行《SHIP-02-21 锁闭挂牌管理规定》。若热工作业、封闭空间作业同步开展电气维修或断电 作业，须同步签发相应作业许可证，严格落实能源隔离（LOTO）措施，并完整留存审批及作业全过程 记录。 The provisions of the SHIP-02-21 Regulations on Lock out and Tag out shall be strictly implemented. If electrical maintenance or power outage operations are carried out simultaneously with hot work or enclosed space operations, corresponding work permits shall be issued at the same time, energy isolation (LOTO) measures shall be strictly implemented, and complete records of the entire approval and operation process shall be retained. 3. 规范航海及 ECDIS 标准化管控 Standardize navigation and ECDIS management 遵照《SHIP-05-01 船舶航行制度与航次计划程序》统一船队 ECDIS 航线命名、标识规范；明确 UKC 富余水深分段计算标准，航次变更、锚泊调整需同步更新纸质航次计划与电子航线，完整标注安全等深 线、中止线、应急锚地等关键界线。 Follow SHIP-05-01 Navigation Regulation and Voyage Plan Procedure to unify vessel-wide standards for ECDIS route naming and marking; clarify graded UKC calculation criteria. Any voyage alteration or anchorage adjustment requires simultaneous update of paper passage plan and ECDIS tracks, with full marking of safety contour, abort line, contingency anchorage and other critical boundaries. 4. 分层开展专项船员实操培训 Carry out tiered practical training for seafarers 依据《PRO-14 船员培训控制程序》，针对 RightShip 高频缺陷分甲板、机舱、驾驶岗位开展专项实操 培训：舱盖维保、LOTO 能源隔离、ECDIS 规范操作、MARPOL 防污染、引航梯检验管理；同步补齐 固体散装危险货物、设备备件台账管理相关培训并留存考核记录。 In line with PRO-14 Crew Training Control Procedure, deliver targeted practical training for deck, engine and navigation officers based on recurrent RightShip deficiencies, covering hatch cover maintenance, LOTO energy isolation, standardized ECDIS operation, MARPOL pollution prevention and pilot ladder inspection. Complete supplementary training on solid bulk dangerous goods and spare parts ledger management with assessment records filed. 5. 搭建岸船一体化闭环监督体系 Establish closed-loop shore-vessel supervision system 依托《PRO-10 船舶检查、监督程序》建立长效管控：海务 / 机务定期登轮检查；固化“缺陷整改→体 系文件修订→全员培训宣贯→登轮复核验证”全流程闭环管理机制。 Rely on the PRO-10 Ship Inspection and Supervision Procedures to establish a long-term control mechanism: regular on-board inspections by marine and technical superintendents; consolidate the whole-process closed-loop management mechanism of " rectification of defects → revision of system documents → training and publicity for all personnel → on-board review and verification".
