(V) 2026 年第二季度 Rightship 检查数据统计分析报告 Statistical analysis report of Rightship inspection defect data in the second quarter-2026 第一部分: 第二季度 Rightship 检查缺陷数据统计 Part I：Statistics ofRightship inspection defect data in the second quarter. 1 描述： 船尾甲板氧气间内 2 个氧气瓶（每瓶容量 40L）固定不充分，仅用尼龙带与其他气瓶松散 绑扎。 Description: Two oxygen cylinders (Capacity 40 Liters each) in the oxygen bottle room on the poop deck were inadequately secured, being loosely lashed with a nylon belt alongside other cylinders. 根本原因分析： 1.未按照维护保养计划（PMS）对气瓶进行充分的日常检查。 2.船员对体系中气瓶的存储要求理解不充分。 Root Cause Analysis: 1.Inadequate routine inspection of gas cylinder securing as per PMS schedule. 2.Insufficient crew awareness of SMS requirements for gas cylinder storage. 产生的风险： 1.气瓶倾倒，碰撞可导致瓶阀断裂，造成人员冲击伤，冻伤。 2.氧气瓶毗邻机舱，生活区，一旦发生火灾，会严重威胁船舶结构安全和船员生命安全。 3.气瓶碰撞可能造成气瓶损坏报废，同时可能损坏周边其它设备。 Risk existed: 1.If the gas cylinder falls over or collides, the cylinder valve may break, causing impact injured and frostbite to personnel. 2.Oxygen cylinders located adjacent to the engine room or living quarters pose a serious threat to the structural safety of the ship and the lives of the crew in case of a fire. 3.Collison of gas cylinder may cause the cylinders to be damaged and scrapped, and may also damage other surrounding equipment. 关闭要求: 1.现制作了新的夹具，并对气瓶重新进行固定，以确保符合安全规范要求。 2.加强全体船员对安全管理体系的培训与学习。 Closing Requirements: 1.A new clamp was fabricated on-site and the gas cylinder has been re-secured to ensure safety compliance. 2.Strengthen the training and learning of the Safety Management System for all crew members. 预防措施： 1.将气瓶固定装置检查增加至月度检查清单中。 2.组织船员进行气瓶安全及安全管理体系中的要求的培训。 3.由机务主管在登船检查时进行验证。 Preventive Action: 1.Added gas cylinder securing check to monthly inspection checklist. 2.Conducted crew training on gas cylinder safety and SMS requirements. 3.Superintendent to verify during visit. 2 描述： 用于船岸通行的舷梯未能延伸至岸上地面。为填补舷梯和码头之间的空隙，在舷梯的下 平台加装一个短跳板，但是该跳板梯在岸端的滚轮缺失。跳板梯整体已按放安全网，并 完成相关的风险评估。 Description: The accommodation ladder used for access between vessel and shore did not reach a soild surface ashore. To close the gap between the vessel accommodation ladder and the wharf, a short gangway was attached to the lower platform of ladder, whereas the rollers at the landing end at the short ladder were missing. A safety net was rigged for the entire setup, and a relevant risk assessment for the vessel-side arrangement was in place. 根本原因分析： 1.港口规定禁止舷梯直接放放置在码头上。 2.使用临时跳板梯时，使用之前没有进行检查，未能发现梯子下平台滚轮缺失。 3.当舷梯无法放至码头时，缺乏验证临时登船设施安全性的程序。 Root Cause Analysis: 1.Port regulations prohibited the accommodation ladder from resting directly on the dock. 2.A temporary gangway was used to bridge the gap, but a pre-use inspection failed to identify missing rollers on the temporary platform. 3.Noformal procedure existed for verifying the safety of temporary boarding arrangements when the ladder cannot reach the dock. 产生的风险： 1.易造成人员坠落、伤亡的风险；存在导致船舶滞留或者罚款，影响装卸货的风险。 Risk existed: 1.Risk of personnel falls, injuries or fatalities; risk of ship detention or fines, which may affect cargo loading and unloading operation. 关闭要求: 1.已为临时跳板配齐并正确安装了滚轮，整套登船设施现已安全并符合规定。 Closing Requirements: 1.Rollers have been supplied and correctly installed on the temporary gangway. The entire boarding arrangement is now safe and compliant. 预防措施: 1. 已制定舷梯无法放置岸上时，采用替代登船设施的程序。 2. 使用临时跳板梯时，必须强制完成使用前检查和风险评估。 3. 已启用专用的登船设施检查清单，使用前核查跳板梯的滚轮，结构及安全状况。 Preventive Action: 1. A formal procedure has been established for alternative boarding arrangements when the ladder cannot reach the dock. 2. A mandatory pre-use inspection and risk assessment must be completed before using any temporary gangway. 3. A dedicated checklist for boarding arrangements has been implemented to verify rollers, structure, and safety condition before use. 3 描述： 船上垃圾存储容量不足（《垃圾管理计划》要求配备 14 个 0.2 立方米的垃圾桶，而船尾 甲板仅配备 12 个 0.2 立方米垃圾桶），船尾 3 个垃圾桶已装满并溢出，且桶盖未完全关 闭。另外，大约 1.0 立方米的各类垃圾被装在 2 两个聚丙烯袋中，露天存放于尾甲板。同 时发现垃圾桶固定不充分，绑扎松弛。该船最后一次向岸上设施处理垃圾时间为 2026 年 2 月 14 日。 Description: The vessel had insufficient garbage storage capacity (required as per garbage management plan 14 nos drums of 0.2 m3 each, whereas actually provided 12 nos drums of 0.2 m3 each on the poop deck).Three storage drums (capacity about 0.2 m3 each) were found overfilled and their lids left partially open at storage location on the poop deck. In addition, approximately 1.0 m3 of assorted garbage was stored in two polypropylene bags on the open poop deck (S). The garbage storage drums were also noted to be inadequately secured with loose lashings. The vessel had last disposed the garbage to the shore facility on 14 Feb 2026. 根本原因分析： 1.垃圾桶数量没有按照垃圾管理计划进行配备。 2.日常垃圾收集，压缩及监控工作执行不到位。 3.垃圾桶的存放与固定方式不符合要求。 Root Cause Analysis: 1. Garbage drums quantity not maintained as per Garbage Management Plan. 2. Ineffective daily garbage collection, compacting and monitoring. 3. Improper storage and securing of garbage drums. 产生的风险： 1.影响船舶安全与卫生，易造成海洋污染。 Risk existed: 1.It affects the safety and sanitation of the ship, and may easily cause marine pollution. 关闭要求: 1. 已将垃圾同数量补充至规定数量。 2. 对所有垃圾进行分类，压缩并妥善存放。 3. 已用适合的绑扎件固定所有垃圾桶，并盖好桶盖。 Closing Requirements: 1. Replenished garbage drums to required quantity. 2. Sorted, compacted and properly stowed all garbage. 3. Secured all drums with proper lashing and closed covers. 预防措施: 1.日常巡检检查表新增垃圾站检查项目。 2.针对 MARPOL 附则 V 及《垃圾管理计划》组织船员培训。 3.机务主管登轮时核查垃圾数量与状况。 Preventive Action: 1. Added garbage station check to daily patrol checklist. 2. Conducted crew training on MARPOL Annex V and Garbage Management Plan. 3. Superintendent to verify quantity and condition during visit. 4 描述： 各货舱舱口围顶部的内侧舱口边缘（1-5 舱受影响）被发现存在腐蚀和减薄情况，而 8,9 舱被观察到有部分换新。 Description: The inboard hatch rims at the various cargo holds coaming top were found to be corroded and thinned (cargo holds 1 to 5 were affected), whereas cargo holds 8 and 9 were observed partially renewed. 根本原因分析： 1. 未按照维护计划要求对舱口围板进行结构检查。 2. 防腐保护和油漆维护保养工作不到位。 3. 日常巡视检查未能及时发现结构减薄。 Root Cause Analysis: 1. Routine structural inspection of hatch coaming not performed as per PMS. 2. Insufficient corrosion protection and coating maintenance. 3. Structural thinning not detected during routine rounds. 产生的风险： 1.降低货舱舱口围结构强度，导致舱盖水密性失效。 Risk existed: 1.Reduce the structural strength of the cargo hold coaming ,resulting in the failure of the hatch cover’s watertight integrity. 关闭要求: 1.对腐蚀区域进行清洁，除锈及修复处理。 2.更换腐蚀的舱口围板边缘，恢复结构设计的厚度。 3.涂刷防腐油漆，完成修复工作。 4.制定专项维护保养计划，完成对1-5号货舱舱口板边缘的修复及换新，防腐保护工作。 Closing Requirements: 1. Cleaned, de-rusted and repaired corroded areas. 2. Renewed corroded coaming rims and restored structural thickness. 3. Applied anti-corrosive coating and completed repair. 4. Formulated a special maintenance plan and schedule to carry out repair, renewal and corrosion protection work for No.1, 2, 3, 4, 5 cargo hold coaming rims in the near term. 预防措施: 1. 严格执行维护保养计划中的防腐相关要求. 2. 将其纳入老龄船强化检查项目。 Preventive Action: 1. Strictly implemented PMS for corrosion protection. 2. Included in enhanced inspection program for aging vessels. 5 描述： 各货舱舱口围处多个止回排水阀防火冒（约 17 个）被发现与各自的拉锁脱离。 Description: Several fire caps (about 17 in number) for the non-return drain valves at various cargo hold coamings were observed detached from their respective valve lanyards. 根本原因分析： 1.备件管控和库存检查不足。 2.对止回阀和防火帽缺乏系统性检查。 Root Cause Analysis: 1.Insufficient spare parts control and inventory check. 2.Lack of systematic inspection for drain valves and fire caps. 产生的风险： 影响货舱消防安全，易造成止回阀作用失效造成还说倒灌货舱，造成货损或破坏船舶稳 性。 Risk existed: It impairs the fire safety of the cargo holds, and may cause failure of the non-return valves ,resulting in seawater backflow in to the holds, cargo may damage, or compromise of the ship’s stability. 关闭要求: 1. 紧急为所有的排水阀配齐并安装了 24 个防火帽。 2. 确认所有的防火帽安装到位，并通过拉锁固定。 3. 更新备件库存与相关的记录。 Closing Requirements: 1. Urgently supplied and fitted 24 fire caps on all drain valves. 2. Verified all caps in place and secured with lanyards. 3. Updated spare parts inventory and records. 预防措施: 1. 将防火帽检查纳入日常安全检查项目。 2. 优化提高备件预测与订购程序。 Preventive Action: 1. Added fire caps check to timely safety inspection. 2. Improved spare parts forecasting and ordering procedure. 6 描述： 发现尾甲板中间两台缆车的刹车带的可见区域已减薄磨损少于原始厚度的一半。 Description: The visible areas of the brake lining of two mooring winches located at the mid-ship on the poop deck were found thinned down to less than half of the original thickness. 根本原因分析： 1. 未按照维护保养计划的要求测量刹车带的厚度。 2. 未对磨损厚度进行定期记录。 3. 日常检查中未发现该缺陷。 Root Cause Analysis: 1. Brake lining thickness not measured as per PMS requirements. 2. No periodic recording of wear thickness. 3. Defect not detected during routine inspection. 产生的风险： 刹车带磨损减薄会导致系泊缆车制动力不足，甚至失效，引发断缆，船舶漂移，碰撞吗 偶等事故，严重威胁系泊作业安全和人员生命安全。 Risk existed: Thinned brake lining will cause insufficient or even lost braking torque of the mooring winches, leading to broken mooring lines , ship drifting, and collision with the berth, seriously endangering mooring operation safety and crew safety. 关闭要求: 1. 使用经认可 的新备件更换磨损的刹车带。 2. 测量并记录新的刹车带的厚度，结果符合要求。 3. 完成刹车力测试，结果满意合格。 Closing Requirements: 1. Replaced worn brake linings with new approved parts. 2. Measured and recorded new thickness; meets standard. 3. Completed functional brake test; satisfactory. 预防措施: 1. 执行落实刹车带厚度测量和记录工作。 2. 针对甲板部人员开展了刹车带磨损判断标准的培训。 3. 加强对系泊缆车刹车带的定期检查和测量工作。 Preventive Action: 1. Implemented brake lining thickness measurement and recording. 2. Conducted training for deck crew on brake wear criteria. 3. Strengthen the regular inspection and measurement of the mooring winch brake linings. 7 描述： 经检查发现，尾甲板右侧舷梯附近的一台便携式起重机系固不充分，绑扎松弛。在检查 期间已报告完成了绑扎整改。 Description: A portable mobile crane located near the accommodation ladder on the poop deck (S) was found inadequately secured with loose lashing. It was reported that the lashings were rectified during the inspection. 根本原因分析： 1. 设备使用后未严格按规定执行固定程序。 2. 开航前检查未覆盖包括可移动设备。 3. 临时设备绑扎的监督管理不到位。 Root Cause Analysis 1. Securing procedure not properly followed after use. 2. Pre-departure inspection did not cover movable equipment. 3. Insufficient supervision of ad-hoc equipment lashing. 产生的风险： 绑扎松弛的便携式起重机会以造成位移，倾倒，易造成设备损坏，人员受伤。 Risk existed: The loosely secured portable crane may shift, topple and resulting equipment damage or causing the injuries to personnel. 关闭要求: 1. 已立即按照公司安全管理体系及绑扎规定，对便携式移动起重机进行重新绑扎，并妥 善，牢固固定。 2. 已针对全体船员开展可移动设备固定于绑扎的安全管理体系要求专项培训，内容包括 操作流程，风险意识及开航前检查标准。 Closing Requirements: 1. The portable mobile crane was immediately re-lashed and secured properly and firmly in compliance with company’s SMS and lashing regulations. 2. A comprehensive safety training was conducted for all crew on SMS requirements for securing and lashing of movable equipment, covering procedures, risk awareness, and pre-departure inspection criteria. 预防措施: 1. 将可移动设备固定检查项目增加至开航前检查表。 2. 针对船员开展设备绑扎及安全管理体系要求的专项培训。 3. 加强开航前的主管现场抽查工作。 Preventive Action: 1. Added movable equipment securing to pre-departure checklist. 2. Conducted crew training on equipment lashing and SMS requirements. 3. Enhanced supervisor spot-check before departure. 8nature 描述： 在审核船岸安全检查表时发现，检查表中未包含装卸工人熟悉应急程序的相关内容，无 证据证明每班完成了针对货舱进入程序的船岸检查表验证工作。 Description: Upon reviewing the ship/ shore safety check list, it was noted that the stevedore familiarization section with emergency procedure was not included in the check list, and there were no evidence showed that the verification of ship-shore checklist against cargo hold entry procedure was carried out every watch. 根本原因分析： 未能有效执行船岸安全程序的要求。 Root Cause Analysis: Insufficient implementation of the requirements for ship-shore safety procedures. 产生的风险： 1.存在装卸工人不熟悉船舶应急设备程序，一旦发生意外，无法正确响应，导致人员伤亡 的风险。 2.每班未能验证货舱进入程序，可能导致气体检测，通风等安全措施失效，引发人员伤亡。 Risk existed: 1.Stevedores unfamiliar with the ship’s emergency procedures may fail to respond correctly during cargo holds operation, leading to casualties. 2.Failure to verify the cargo hold entry procedure every watch may result invalid gas detection and ventilation measures , causing casualties. 关闭要求: 1.立即修订检查表，新增加装卸工人应急程序熟悉情况的检查项目。 2.对所有值班班次，每小时检查一次货舱进入程序的执行情况。 3.与装卸工人开展联合安全简会，明确应急程序的要求。 Closing Requirements: 1.Revise the checklist immediately, add stevedore familiarization section with emergency procedures. 2.Verify cargo hold entry procedures hourly for all watch shifts. 3.Conduct joint safety briefing with stevedores and emergency procedures. 预防措施: 1.在装货前召开船岸联合安全会议，核查检查表执行情况及装卸工人的培训情况。 2.培训并监督值班人员，在港口货物操作作业期间按要求正确执行船岸安全程序。 3.加强船舶安全管理体系的学习与落实。 Preventive Action: 1.Hold a pre-loading joint ship-shore safety meeting to review checklist compliance and stevedore training status. 2.Train and supervise the duty crew to properly carry out ship-shore safety procedure as required during cargo operations in port. 3.Strengthen learning ship management system. 9 描述： 检查时发现，船上配备 1 台 PS245 型和 1 台 GX-8000 型气体检测仪，两款仪器均具备检 测 氧气（O2）,甲烷（CH4）,一氧化碳（CO）和硫化氢（HS）的功能，仅只有 GX-8000 型气体检测仪内置采样泵，而且船上未配备其它额外的手动采样管。 Description: At the time of the inspection, it was noted that 1set PS245 and 1 set GX-8000 gas detector with function to detect O2 , CH4 , CO and H2S were onboard , only the GX-8000 gas detector was fitted with build in pump and no any other extra manual pipe were provided for the ship also. 根本原因分析： 缺少一台气体检测仪，而且未及时补充备用气体检测仪。 Root Cause Analysis: Lost one gas detector and No supplementary gas detector in time. 产生的风险： 无内置采样泵的气体检测仪无法对货舱及封闭空间进行深层气体采样，若设备故障，将 失去主动检测能力，易引发缺氧，中毒或爆炸等事故，威胁作业人员安全。 Risk existed: The gas detector without build-in pump cannot perform deep gas sampling in cargo holds or enclosed space, if pumped detector fails, will lose the active sampling capability , which may lead to hypoxia, poisoning or explosion accident, endangering the lives of personnel. 关闭要求: 1.加装一台带内置采样泵的气体检测仪。 2.按照制造厂商说明完成年度校准，并将校准证书留存在船上。 Closing Requirements: 1.Install one additional gas detector with built-in sampling pump. 2.Complete annual calibration in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions and retain calibration certificates on board. 预防措施: 1.根据记录清单加强监督与检查。 2.加强对 SOLAS 相关规定的学习。 Preventive Action: 1.Strengthen supervise and inspection according to record list. 2.Strengthen study the SOLAS regulation requirements. 10 描述： 检查时，船级社出具的直升机平台强度确认函未在船备查。 Description: The strength confirmation letter of helipad from class not available at the time of the inspection. 根本原因分析： 1. 对法规要求的理解不充分。 2. 遗漏相关证书。 Root Cause Analysis: 1. Lack sufficient understanding the regulation requirements. 2. left out the certificate. 产生的风险： 无船级社出具的直升机平台强度确认函，无法确认平台结构强度符合安全要求，直升机 起降坑发生平台坍塌，变形，引发坠毁，人员伤亡事故。 Risk existed: Without the strength confirmation letter of the helipad issued by the classification society, the structural strength of platform cannot be confirmed to meet safety requirements. The platform may collapse or deform during helicopter takeoff and landing ,causing crashes and casualties. 关闭要求: 按照法规要求，向 NK 船级社申请 SOF 证书。 Closing Requirements: Request SOF certificate from NK according to the regulation requirements. 预防措施: 1.加强监督与检查。 2.加强对法规要求的学习。 Preventive Action: 1. Strengthen supervision and inspection. 2. Strengthen study the regulation requirements. 11 描述： 船尾甲板右侧一救生圈，其连接救生圈和自亮灯的救生绳破损，长度约 20cm。 Description: One lifebuoy fitted on the starboard side of the aft poop deck has a deterioration painter line connecting the lifebuoy to the self-igniting light, approx. 20cm in length. 根本原因分析： 1.日常检查不到位。 2.维护保养缺失。 3.船员安全意识不足，能力欠缺。 Root Cause Analysis: 1. Inadequate routine inspection. 2. Lack of preventive maintenance. 3. Insufficient crew awareness and competent. 产生的风险： 救生绳破损可能导致自亮灯脱落或救生圈抛投失效，落水人员在夜间无法被定位，直接 降低生还概率，引发伤亡事故。 Risk existed: The damaged painter line may cause the self-igniting light to fall off or the lifebuoy to fail during deployment, making it impossible to locate personnel overboard at night and directly reducing the chance of survival, leading to casualties. 关闭要求: 1.立即更换链接救生圈与自亮灯的浮索。 2.确保浮索配置到位并符合规则要求。 Closing Requirements: 1.Immediate replacement of the painter line connecting the lifebuoy to the self-igniting light. 2.Ensure the painter line on site and compliance restoration. 预防措施: 1.严格按照公司安全管理体系执行检查。 2.加强对救生设备和消防设备检查的监督和管理。 Preventive Action: 1.Carry out inspection in strict accordance with the company’s SMS. 2.Strength supervision and management for LSA & FFE inspection. 12 描述： 在检查中发现，右锚止链器与锚链轮之间锚链有扭转。 Description: At the time of the inspection , it was noted that the starboard anchor chain to be twisted between stopper and wildcat. 根本原因分析： 1.起锚时锚链偏角过大。 2.锚链轮严重腐蚀，导致锚链方向翻转。 Root Cause Analysis: 1.The anchor chain deviated at an excessive angle when the anchor was being heaved. 2.The chain wheel was severely corroded, causing the chain to reverse its direction. 产生的风险： 1.锚链扭转会产生剪切应力，加速锚链链环磨损断裂，导致锚设备失效。 2.扭转的锚链易卡阻在锚链轮或止链器内，影响应急抛锚操作，延误处置时机。 Risk existed: 1.Twisted anchor chain will generate additional shear stress, accelerating wear and fracture of chain links, leading to anchor equipment failure. 2.The twisted chain is prone to jamming in the wildcat or stopper, affecting emergency anchoring operation, delaying response time and amplifying accident consequences. 关闭要求: 使用锚机放出锚链，并用撬杠和钢板将锚链方向复位。 Closing Requirements: Use the windlass to release the anchor chain and use a crowbar and steel plate to reverse the direction of the anchor chain. 预防措施: 1.起锚时使用车舵配合调整锚链角度。 2.下次坞修时对锚链轮进行维护保养。 Preventive Action: 1.Use the engine and rudder adjust the chain angle when heaving anchor. 2.Maintenance and servicing of the chain wheel during dock downtime. 13 描述： C 层甲板两个机舱通风机备拆解送岸修理，未关闭会议前未能复位安装。 Description: Two engine room blowers on C deck were disassembled for shore repairing , prior to close meeting was not installed back. 根本原因分析： 因船舶震动，防火风闸轴与铜套发生磨损，间隙增大，导致风闸轴下沉。 Root Cause Analysis: Because of ship vibration, fire fan damper shaft ground the copper bushing clearance grew and fire damper shaft sank. 产生的风险： 1.机舱通风机缺失导致机舱通风不足，油气浓度升高，热量积聚，极易引发火灾或爆炸事 故。 2.高温无法散发会造成机舱设备过热失效，影响船舶动力系统，导致船舶失去操纵能力， 威胁航行安全。 Risk existed: 1.The lack of engine room blowers leads to insufficient ventilation, increase oil-gas concentration and heat accumulation, which may easily cause fire or explosion accidents. 2.Failure to dissipate high temperature will cause overheating failure of engine room equipment, affecting the ship’s power system, leading to loss of maneuverability and threatening navigation safety. 关闭要求: 拆解风闸并送车间修理，更换防火风闸轴及铜套，修理后复装。 Closing Requirements: Dismantled damper and sent to workshop, renewed fire damper shaft & copper bushing ,Fitted it back once recondition was completed. 预防措施: 加强日常检查，加注润滑油，降低轴系震动。 Preventive Action: Strengthen routine checked, and fill grease for bushing, reduce shaft vibration. 14 描述： 机舱底层平台上，连接主海水泵与主柴油机空气冷却器及滑油冷却器的两端海水管路已 被拆除，由岸上服务队进行修理，计划在船离港前完成复位安装。 Description: 2 sections of sea water line from main sea water pump to main engine air cooler and lub oil cooler in engine room bottom platform were dismantled for repair by shore service team, plan to installed back before vessel departure. 根本原因分析： 海水管路因腐蚀造成泄漏。 Root Cause Analysis: Sea water pipe leaking due to corrosion. 产生的风险： 1.海水管路拆除导致主机冷却系统终端，主机过热会引发拉缸，烧瓦灯故障，造成主机停 机，船舶失去动力。 2.滑油冷却失效会导致油温过高，润滑失效，加剧设备磨损，同时可能引发滑油自然，导 致机舱火灾。 3.若维修安装延误，船舶无法按时离港，造成船期延误，影响正常营运。 Risk existed: 1.The removal of sea water lines interrupts the main engine cooling system, overheating of the engine may cause serious failures such as cylinder scoring and bearing seizure ,leading to main engine shutdown ,the ship will lose power. 2.Failure of lubricating oil cooling will result in height oil temperature and insufficient lubrication ,accelerating equipment wear and potentially causing spontaneous combustion of lubricating oil, leading to engine room fire accident. 3.If the repair and installation are delayed , the ship will not be able to depart on schedule, facing risks of schedule delay, charter party breach, disrupting normal operation. 关闭要求: 由岸基维修队更换新的海水管路。 Closing Requirements: Renewed new sea pipe by shore team. 预防措施: 1.降低 MGPS 的运行电流。 2.加强日常保养。 Preventive Action: 1.Decreased the MGPS running current. 2.Strengthen routine inspection. 15 描述： 检查时发现，位于空调间内的澄清热水循环泵，其压盖密封处存在漏水现象，漏水速率 约为每秒 3 滴。 Description: The hot water circulating pump for the clarifier located in the AHU room was observed leaking water from gland seal at a rate of approximately 3 drops per second. 根本原因分析： 对热水循环泵的检查存在疏忽。 Root Cause Analysis: Negligence for inspection for hot water circle pump. 产生的风险： 压盖密封漏水可能导致热水滴入空调间内的电器设备，引发短路，漏电，进而造成电器 设备烧毁或火灾，威胁船舶安全。 Risk existed: The water leakage from the gland seal may cause hot water to drip into electrical equipment in the AHU room, leading to short circuit and electric leakage, which in turn may cause electrical equipment burn out or fire, endangering the safety of the ship. 关闭要求: 立即压紧轴封，以较少泄漏。 Closing Requirements: Fasten the gland packing immediately for reduction leakage. 预防措施: 加强对所有设备的检查工作。 Preventive Action: Strengthen inspection for all equipment。 16 描述： 在 3 舱和 4 舱之间的甲板右侧桅房内发现 1 台电动抛光机，1 台电动角磨机和 1 台电动切 割机均未安装安全防护罩。 Description: In the deck store on the starboard side of the main deck between No.3 and No.4 cargo holds, one electric buffing machine, one electric grinder and one electric cutter were found without safety guards fitted. 根本原因分析： 1.船员没有严格遵守船舶安全操纵程序 2.船员缺乏船舶安全操作程序的培训。 Root Cause Analysis: 1.Crew failed to strictly follow ship Safe Operations procedures. 2.Lack of Safe Operations procedures training for crew. 产生的风险： 1.无防护罩的电动工具在使用时，砂轮，切割片等部件高速旋转，一旦破裂，碎片飞溅， 易造成人员严重割伤。 2.抛光，打磨作业会产生大量金属火花，无防护张时，火花不受控制飞溅，若附近有易燃 物，极易引发火灾。 Risk existed: 1.When using power tools without safety guards, the high-speed rotating parts may break or fragment may fly out, easily causing cuts burns, leading serious mechanical injury accidents. 2.Sparks generated by polishing and grinding will splash uncontrollably, easily igniting flammable materials in the store room, causing fire accidents. 关闭要求: 1.加强监督管理。 2.每日工前会上强调相关要求。 Closing Requirements: 1.Strengthen supervision. 2.Emphasized at toolbox meeting every day. 预防措施: 1.加强对全体船员的船舶安全操作程序培训。 2.加强船舶管理体系的学习。 Preventive Action: 1.Strengthen training for all crew members about ship Safe Operations. 2.Strengthen learning ship management system. 17 JOY 描述： 船上未明确规定电子海图显示与信息系统（ECDIS）航线的命名与标识规则。该系统内保 存的航线名称高度相似（如 “V07B1”“V007B3”“V07B3”），且无清晰标识可显示检查时 正在使用的具体航线。纸质航行计划中提及的 “V007”，与检查时电子海图显示与信息系 统内的航线命名不相符。 Description: ECDIS route naming and identification were not clearly defined on board. Routeson the ECDIS were saved with similar titles (e.g. “V07B1”, “V007B3”, “V07B3”),and no clear identification was available to show which route was in use at thetime of inspection. The paper passage plan referenced “V007”, which was not aligned with the route naming on the ECDIS at the time of inspection. 根本原因： 船员对安全管理体系（SMS）中有关电子海图显示与信息系统（ECDIS）航线的标准化命 名、核查及使用要求缺乏足够熟悉，导致出现不合规操作，且未在电子海图航线与纸质 航行计划之间开展定期核查。 Root Cause: The crew lacked adequate familiarity with the requirements of the SMS concerning the standardised naming, verification, and use of ECDIS routes, leading to non-compliant practices, with no regular verification between the ECDIS route and paper passage plan. 产生的风险： 存在航行安全隐患，ECDIS 中航线命名不规范，标识不清，易导致值班驾驶员无用航线， 造成偏航，误入危险水域，引发搁浅，碰撞等事故；同时纸质航次计划于电子航线命名 不匹配，无法形成有效交叉验证，航行过程中失去安全校核保障。 Risk existed: There are navigation safety risks, the non-standard route naming and unclear identification in ECDIS may lead to the watch officer misusing routes, resulting in deviation from the planned track, entering dangerous waters, and causing accidents such as grounding and collision. Meanwhile, the mismatch between the paper passage plan and ECDIS route naming fails to form effective cross-verification, losing the safety check guarantee during navigation. 关闭要求: 已根据安全管理体系（SMS）要求进行修正，并针对船上所有甲板部高级船员开展专项 培训，内容涉及与电子海图显示与信息系统（ECDIS）航线管理相关的船舶安全管理体系 程序，包括命名规范、航线核查以及交接要求。 Closing Requirements: Corrected according to the SMS requirement and Conduct a targeted training session for all deck officers on the vessel’s SMS procedures related to ECDIS route management, including naming standards, route verification and handover requirements. 预防措施: 严格执行统一的航线命名标准，杜绝随意命名现象。定期核对纸质与电子航线信息，确 保二者保持一致。定期清理冗余的电子海图显示与信息系统航线，规范在用航线标注工 作。定期开展船员培训，强化日常作业管控。主管部门实施日常监督，并将其纳入安全 检查管理范畴。 Preventive Measure: Strictly implement unified route naming standards to avoid random naming. Regularly check paper and electronic route information to ensure consistency. Regular clean up redundant ECDIS routes and standardize in-use route marking. Conduct regular crew training and strengthen daily operation control. Master implements daily supervision and includes it is safely inspection management. 18 描述： 氧气/乙炔气体系统已于 2026 年 4 月 20 日完成年度第三检验；但是船上无法提供氧气乙 炔减压阀的制造日期，也无相关记录证明已按照制造商要求进行更新/更换，且船上未存 放制造商的操作/维护指南。 Description: The OX/AC gas system had received annual third-party inspection 20 Apr 2026; however, the manufacturing dates of the AC and OX regulators were not known, no records were available to verify renewal in accordance with manufacturer requirements, and no manufacturer’s guidance was available on board. 根本原因： 工作人员不熟悉调节器背面数字钢印所代表的生产厂家含义，因此不清楚调节器的生产 日期。 Root Cause: The crew not familiar with the manufacture’s meaning represented by the digital steel printing on the back of the regulators, so the production date of the regulators is not familiar. 产生的风险： 存在严重的安全隐患，氧气、乙炔减压阀无制造日期，无更换记录，无法确认是否超期 服役，易出现泄漏，压力失控，引发火灾或爆炸事故， 同时船上无制造厂商的操作维护 指南，船员造作无标准依据，进一步放大安全的风险。 Risk existed: There are serious safety risk, the manufacturing dates of the oxygen/acetylene regulators are unknown and no renewal records are available, making it impossible to confirm whether they have exceeded their service life, which may lead to leakage, pressure loss, fire or explosion accidents. Meanwhile, the lack of manufacture’s operation and maintenance guidance on board leaves crew without standard operating references, further amplifying safety risks. 关闭要求: 通过查询相关信息，了解调节器背后数字所代表的含义，并对机舱部全体船员开展相关 知识培训。 Closing Requirements: Through the query information to know the meaning of the digital representative behind the regulators, and train all the crew of engine department related knowledge. 预防措施: 为监管机构做好记录，其中应包含制造商的生产日期和有效期，以便在监管设备到期前 提前进行更换。 Preventive Measure: Make a record for the regulators, including the manufacture’s production date and expiry date, so that the regulators can be replaced in advanced before the expiration of the regulators. 19 描述： 船上无相关记录能够证明，已对舱盖的垫铁，定位块和止动块进行了间隙测量，在检查 期间发现仅对锁紧器和舱盖围板的间隙进行了检查。 Description: There were no records available to verify that clearance measurements for bearing pads, locators and stoppers had been carried out, with inspections observed limited to cleats and hatch cover skirt clearance. 根本原因： 船员对舱口盖检查的安全管理体系（SMS）要求缺乏充分理解，导致检查范围不完整， 遗漏了对承压垫板、定位器及止动器的间隙测量工作。该船现有的舱口盖检查记录不完 整，未能全面反映所需维保项目的检查范围。 Root Cause: The crew lacked full understanding of the SMS requirements for hatch cover inspection, resulting in incomplete inspection scope that omitted clearance measurements for bearing pads, locators and stoppers. The vessel’s existing hatch cover inspection records were incomplete and did not fully reflect the scope of required maintenance items. 产生的风险： 维护保养缺失，PSC、船级社检验会直接开缺陷。 Risk existed: Lack of maintenance will directly result in deficiencies being issued during PSC and classification society inspections. 关闭要求: 立即完成船上所有舱盖支承垫板、定位器及止动器的间隙测量工作，并核实所有间隙均 符合制造商技术规范。补充并归档完整的舱盖检验记录，其中应包含所有测量数值与检 验日期，以备后续核查。针对甲板部船员开展专题培训，内容涵盖舱盖维护与检验要求 的全部范畴。 Closing Requirements: Immediately complete the clearance measurements for all hatch cover bearing pads, locators and stoppers on board, and verify that all clearances comply with the manufacturer’s specifications. Supplement and archive the complete hatch cover inspection records, including all measured values and inspection dates, for future verification. Conduct a targeted training session for deck crew on the full scope of hatch cover maintenance and inspection requirements. 预防措施: 制定一份符合安全管理体系（SMS）要求的标准化舱口盖检查清单，清单需涵盖所有必 检项目（承压垫板、定位器、止动器、系缆扣、舱口围板间隙），并定期更新；同时按 照制造商推荐的周期，对承压垫板、定位器及止动器进行定期间隙测量。为甲板船员制 定年度安全管理体系培训计划并开展考核，确保其全面熟悉舱口盖检查流程及记录保存 要求。 Preventive Measure: Implement a standardized, SMS-compliant hatch cover inspection checklist, which includes all required items (bearing pads, locators, stoppers, cleats, hatch skirt clearances) and is updated regularly, with periodic clearance measurements for bearing pads, locators and stoppers scheduled in accordance with the manufacturer’s recommended intervals. Conduct annual SMS training plan and assessment for deck crew to ensure full familiarity with hatch cover inspection procedures and record-keeping requirements. 20 描述： 1.第 8,9 货舱的尾倒缆绞缆机齿轮油观察窗因表面被油漆或环氧树脂覆盖，已无法观察油 位。 2.船首楼右舷外侧的一台绞缆机，齿轮箱观察窗处存在漏油现象，油液已扩散并污染了下 方机壳。 Description: 1-Mooring winches for aft spring lines at Cargo Holds No.8 and No.9 were observed with the gear oil sight glasses not visible, with the surfaces coated/covered with paint or epoxy. 2-One mooring winch at the forecastle, starboard side outer position, was observed with oil leakage from the gearbox sight glass, with oil spreading and contaminating the casing below. 根本原因： 船员对液压甲板机械操作及管理规定中的安全管理体系（SMS）要求缺乏充分理解，未 开展检查工作，且船员未能及时发现问题。 Root Cause: The crew lacked full understanding of the SMS requirements for Hydraulic deck machinery operation and management regulations. Lack inspection and crew don’t find timely. 产生的风险： 应急操作时绞缆机失效风险。 Risk existed: Risk of mooring winch failure during emergency operation. 关闭要求: 1. 清理 8 号与 9 号货舱之间系泊绞车齿轮箱油位观察窗上的油漆。 2. 检查并维护右舷艏楼系泊绞车齿轮箱观察窗，清理系泊绞车表面的油污。 Closing Requirements: 1.To clean the paint on the oil level sight glass of the mooring winch gear box between cargo hold NO.8 and NO.9. 2.Inspect and maintain the forecastle mooring winch gear box sight glass of the starboard side, clean the oil stains on the mooring winch surface. 预防措施: 1.开展相关培训：学习公司船舶安全管理体系文件 SHIP-06-15：液压甲板机械操作与管 理规定。学习公司船舶安全管理体系文件 SHIP-08-12：锚机及系泊设备检验、试验与维 护。 2.今后定期检查，发现问题及时处理。 Preventive Measure: 1.Do relevant training: Study the company SMS SHIP-06-15: Hydraulic deck machinery operation and management regulations. Study the company SMS SHIP-08-12: Windlass and Mooring Equipment Inspection, Test & Maintenance. 2.Check regularly in the future, find problems to deal with in time. 21 描述： 检查发现，应急发电机房内 220V 配电板的绝缘低，报警值设置为 0.5Mohm，水手长仓库 内 220V 照明配电板的绝缘低，报警值设置为 0.4Mohm。检查时测得，该 220V 照明配电 板的绝缘电阻约为 1Mohm。 Description: Insulation low alarm settings were observed set at 0.5 MOhm for the 220 V panel in the emergency generator room and 0.4 MOhm for the 220 V lighting distribution board in the bosun store. The insulation resistance on the 220 V lighting distribution board was observed at approximately 1 MOhm at the time of inspection. 根本原因： Root Cause: The crew lacked full understanding of the SMS requirements for Ship Electrical Equipment Management Precautions and lack of inspection. 产生的风险： 易引发电气短路、打火，诱发火灾。 Risk existed: It is prone to causing electrical short circuits and sparks, which may trigger fires. 关闭要求: 将 220V 电源绝缘报警值设定为规定的 0.2 兆欧。 并检查了船舶桅灯的绝缘状况，重新进行了水密处理，目前状态良好。 Closing Requirements: Set the insulation alarm value of 220V power supply to the specified 0.2 MΩ And checked the insulation condition of the mast light of the ship, and made watertight treatment again, now in good condition. 预防措施: 学习公司 SMS SHIP-08-05：船舶电气设备管理注意事项。了解绝缘过低故障的成因、解 决措施，以及电气设备管理中后续维护的要点。 Preventive Measure: Study the company SMS SHIP-08-05: Ship Electrical Equipment Management Precautions. Learn the cause of low insulation failure and the solution and the main points of future maintenance in electrical equipment management. 22 描述： SKY 核查发现，该轮烟台港靠泊富余水深（UKC）测算情况：船舶吃水 18.2 米，依据船舶安 全管理体系（SMS）规定，港内航行最低富余水深为吃水的 10%（1.82 米），船舶进港 时实际富余水深满足该项要求。但引水登船点错误套用了开敞海域富余水深计算公式： 开敞海域富余水深标准为吃水的 20%（3.64 米），而该处实际富余水深仅 1.88 米，未 达标，测算记录却仍勾选 “合格（YES）”。 Description: Inspection verified the UKC calculation for berthing at Yantai. With a draft of 18.2 m, the SMSrequires a minimum navigating in port UKC of 10% of draft (1.82 m), and the vessel’s actual UKC whileentering port satisfied this requirement. However, the open sea UKC calculation form was used for the pilotboarding point. The required open sea UKC is 20% of draft (3.64 m), whereas the actual UKC was 1.88 m,falling short of the standard. The calculation was still recorded as "YES ". 根本原因： 1.负责人对安全管理体系（SMS）SHIP-05-01 规定的富裕水深计算要求不熟悉。 2.旧版龙骨下富余水深计算表格未单独标注港内、开阔海域对应的计算系数，无区分提示， 存在固有设计缺陷，易造成人为误用。 Root Cause: 1.PIC lacked proficiency with company SMS procedure SHIP-05-01 governing graded under keel clearance calculation requirements. 2.Legacy UKC calculation form fails to separately mark calculation coefficients for in-port / open sea, lacking distinguishing prompts, with inherent design defects prone to human misuse. 产生的风险： 记录虚假勾选合格，存在搁浅、船体受损。 Risk existed: Falsely recorded as compliant, bringing risks of grounding, hull damage. 关闭要求: 1.船长组织一个专项甲板部门培训关于“安全管理体系（SMS）SHIP-05-01 规定的富裕 水深”在 2026 年 5 月 28 日（培训记录签字），说明 UKC 计算依据在港内是船舶静态最 大吃水 10%，在深水区域是船舶静态最大吃水 20%。 2.富余水深计算表格已升级至 V03 版本，内嵌自动计算公式，可按水域类型自动区分参 数，消除人工计算误差。已回收所有作废的 V02 版本表格并统一销毁，相关处置记录留 存船上。 3.后续从烟台港开航的航次，均使用新版龙骨下富余水深计算表格，核算结果经核查符合 规范要求。 Closing Requirements: 1.Master organized a dedicated full deck department training on SMS SHIP-05-01 dated 28 May 2026 (supported by signed training record), clarifying 10% in-port and 20% open-water UKC calculation criteria. 2.UKC calculation form upgraded to Revision V03 with embedded automatic formulas enabling auto parameter differentiation per water zone to eliminate manual calculation errors. All obsolete V02 forms collected for scrapping with disposal record kept onboard. 3.Subsequent departure voyages from Yantai adopt updated forms for under keel clearance calculation with verified compliant computation results. 预防措施: 1.所有 UKC 数据执行双重录入操作，并在最终确认前对所有参数进行交叉核对。 2.船长每周随机抽查至少三份 UKC 计算文件，由独立审核人签名后归档。 3.修订后的计算表格纳入 SMS 文件；岸基海务主管每月对表格执行情况进行随机抽查。 Preventive Measure: 1.Dual-entry practice enforced for all UKC data with cross-check of all parameters before finalization. 2.Master randomly audits minimum three UKC calculation documents weekly with independent review signature for filing. 3.Revised calculation form incorporated into controlled SMS documents; shore-based marine superintendent conducts monthly random inspection on form implementation. 23 描述： 检查期间对 ECDIS 中的航行计划进行了审核。根据船舶航行程序，ECDIS 的安全设置 ——浅水等深线、安全等深线、安全水深和深水——分三个阶段进行调整。然而，在 ECDIS 的计划航线/航路上，以及航行计划中，并未显示任何专用标记或符号来标明这些设置应 进行更改的位置或转向点。同样，根据船舶航行程序，“前视和环视”设置也分为三个 阶段，但在 ECDIS 的计划航线/航路上，以及航行计划中，也未显示任何专用标记或符 号来标明这些设置应进行更改的位置或转向点。 Description: The passage plan in the ECDIS was reviewed during the inspection, the ECDIS safety settings —shallow contour, safety contour, safety depth, and deep water—are adjusted in three distinct stages A/P vessel’s navigation procedure. However, no dedicated marks or symbols are displayed on the planned route/passage in ECDIS and the passage plan to indicate the positions or waypoints where these setting changes should be made. A/P Vessel’s Navigation procedure, there were three stages of Look ahead and lookaround settings, However, no dedicated marks or symbols are displayed on the planned route/ passage in ECDIS and the passage plan to indicate the positions or waypoints where these setting changes should be made. 根本原因： 1.负责人不熟悉安全管理体系文件 SHIP-05-18 关于电子海图系统操作程序。 2.标准的航次计划模板未设置必填栏用以标注电子海图系统参数修改位置，且安全管理体 系中未明确相关执行要求。 Root Cause: 1.PIC non-familiar with SMS SHIP-05-18 governing ECDIS operational procedures. 2.Standard voyage plan template has no mandatory field to indicate ECDIS parameter modification positions, lacking specified implementation requirement in SMS. 产生的风险： 关键点位无标注，航行参数切换遗漏，易导致船舶搁浅和碰撞。 Risk existed: Missing marks may result in missed parameter adjustment and subsequent vessel grounding and collision. 关闭要求: 1.船长于 2026 年 5 月 28 日为全体驾驶员开展了 ECDIS 专项培训，明确了三个阶段报警 标准及强制标注要求。 2.烟台至舟山航行计划中补充了参数变更所需的坐标；针对港口、近岸及开阔海域分别配 置了分段安全水深、前视及扇形区报警参数并在 ECDIS 航线上添加了相应标记。 Closing Requirements: 1.Master delivered full deck officer ECDIS specialized training on 28 May 2026 specifying three-zone alarm standards and mandatory marking requirements. 2.Coordinates for parameter changes supplemented to Yantai-Zhoushan voyage plan; corresponding markers added on ECDIS route with segmented safety depth, look-ahead and sector alarm configuration for port, coastal and open sea sectors. 预防措施: 1.航行计划模板已修订，新增了[ECDIS 参数修改位置]的必填栏，要求填写相应的坐标标 注。 2.离港前会议包含 ECDIS 参数配置的交叉核对项目；二副编制计划，由大副负责验证。 3.船上每月进行航行审核；岸基部门对 ECDIS 配置执行不定期的远程抽查。 Preventive Measure: 1.Voyage plan template revised to add mandatory field titled [ECDIS Parameter Modification Positions] with required coordinate notation during voyage planning. 2.Pre-departure meeting includes cross-verification item for ECDIS configuration; Second Officer compiles plan verified by Chief Officer. 3.Monthly onboard navigation audit conducted; shore side performs unscheduled remote ECDIS configuration spot-checks. 24 描述： 检查期间已核查动火作业许可证、封闭空间进入许可证，但船上上锁挂牌（LOTO）未并 入作业许可（PTW）管理体系。 Description: The Hot work permit, enclosed space entry permit was reviewed during the inspection, however, The Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) was not integrated with the Permit to Work (PTW) system on board. 根本原因： 1.现有 SHIP-02-05-01 项下的作业许可（PTW）检查表不完整，安全管理体系（SMS）文 件中未规定强制性的上锁/挂牌（LOTO）验证条款。 2.船员在能源隔离方面规定的上锁/挂牌要求培训不足。 Root Cause: 1.Existing PTW checklist under SHIP-02-05-01 is incomplete with no stipulated LOTO mandatory verification clauses within SMS documentation. 2.Crew receives insufficient training on regulatory lockout/tagout requirements for energy isolation. 产生的风险： 易因设备意外启动引发机械伤害、火灾爆炸等人身伤亡事故。 Risk existed: It may lead to accidental startup of equipment, resulting in mechanical injury, fire and explosion casualties. 关闭要求: 1.热工作业及进入封闭空间作业许可文件已更新至 3.0 版/8.0 版，新增挂牌上锁隔离、 电气挂牌锁定相关勾选项；已回收所有空白旧版许可，统一启用新版表格。
